Fields.Description: PartySubID value within an underlying instrument party repeating group. Same values as PartySubID (523)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingInstrumentPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of underlying InstrumentPartySubID (1053) value. Same values as PartySubIDType (803)

Fields.Name: BidSwapPoints
Fields.Description: The bid FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far bid forward points - near offer forward point". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

Fields.Name: OfferSwapPoints
Fields.Description: The offer FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far offer forward points - near bid forward points". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

Fields.Name: LegBidForwardPoints
Fields.Description: The bid FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

Fields.Name: LegOfferForwardPoints
Fields.Description: The offer FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

Fields.Name: SwapPoints
Fields.Description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

Fields.Name: MDQuoteType
Fields.Description: Identifies market data quote type.

Fields.Name: LastSwapPoints
Fields.Description: For FX Swap, this is used to express the last market event for the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer in a fill or partial fill. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

Fields.Name: SideGrossTradeAmt
Fields.Description: The gross trade amount for this side of the trade. See also GrossTradeAmt (381) for additional definition.

Fields.Name: LegLastForwardPoints
Fields.Description: The forward points for this leg's fill event. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

Fields.Name: LegCalculatedCcyLastQty
Fields.Description: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency for this leg. Can be derived from LegQty and LegLastPx.

Fields.Name: LegGrossTradeAmt
Fields.Description: The gross trade amount of the leg. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when LegLastQty and other quantity fields are express in terms of contract size.

Fields.Name: MaturityTime
Fields.Description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

Fields.Name: RefOrderID
Fields.Description:
The ID reference to the order being hit or taken.
For pre-trade credit/risk limit check process, this is the reference to the placed order, quote request or quote for the credit/risk limit check.

Fields.Name: RefOrderIDSource
Fields.Description: Used to specify the source for the identifier in RefOrderID(1080). This can be an identifier provided in order depth market data when hitting (taking) a specific order or to identify what type of order or quote reference is being provided when seeking credit limit check. In the context of US CAT this can be used to identify related orders and quotes which are parent, previous, or manual orders or quotes. Previous relates to orders changing their unique system assigned order identifier.

Fields.Name: SecondaryDisplayQty
Fields.Description: Used for reserve orders when DisplayQty applies to the primary execution market (e.g.an ECN) and another quantity is to be shown at other markets (e.g. the exchange). On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

Fields.Name: DisplayWhen
Fields.Description: Instructs when to refresh DisplayQty (1138).

Fields.Name: DisplayMethod
Fields.Description: Defines what value to use in DisplayQty (1138). If not specified the default DisplayMethod is "1"

Fields.Name: DisplayLowQty
Fields.Description: Defines the lower quantity limit to a randomized refresh of DisplayQty.

Fields.Name: DisplayHighQty
Fields.Description: Defines the upper quantity limit to a randomized refresh of DisplayQty.

Fields.Name: DisplayMinIncr
Fields.Description: Defines the minimum increment to be used when calculating a random refresh of DisplayQty. A user specifies this when he wants a larger increment than the standard provided by the market (e.g. the round lot size).

Fields.Name: RefreshQty
Fields.Description: Defines the quantity used to refresh DisplayQty.

Fields.Name: MatchIncrement
Fields.Description: Allows orders to specify a minimum quantity that applies to every execution (one execution could be for multiple counter-orders). The order may still fill against smaller orders, but the cumulative quantity of the execution must be in multiples of the MatchIncrement.

Fields.Name: MaxPriceLevels
Fields.Description: Allows an order to specify a maximum number of price levels to trade through. Only valid for aggressive orders and during continuous (autoexecution) trading sessions. Property lost when order is put on book. A partially filled order is assigned last trade price as limit price. Non-filled order behaves as ordinary Market or Limit.

Fields.Name: PreTradeAnonymity
Fields.Description: Allows trader to explicitly request anonymity or disclosure in pre-trade market data feeds. Anonymity is relevant in markets where counterparties are regularly disclosed in order depth feeds. Disclosure is relevant when counterparties are not normally visible.

Fields.Name: PriceProtectionScope
Fields.Description: Defines the type of price protection the customer requires on their order.

Fields.Name: LotType
Fields.Description: Defines the lot type assigned to the order.

Fields.Name: PegPriceType
Fields.Description: Defines the type of peg.

Fields.Name: PeggedRefPrice
Fields.Description: The value of the reference price that the order is pegged to. PeggedRefPrice + PegOffsetValue (211) = PeggedPrice (839) unless the limit price (44, Price) is breached. The values may not be exact due to rounding.

Fields.Name: PegSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Defines the identity of the security off whose prices the order will peg. Same values as SecurityIDSource (22)

Fields.Name: PegSecurityID
Fields.Description: Defines the identity of the security off whose prices the order will peg.

Fields.Name: PegSymbol
Fields.Description: Defines the common, 'human understood' representation of the security off whose prices the order will Peg.

Fields.Name: PegSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Security description of the security off whose prices the order will Peg.

Fields.Name: TriggerType
Fields.Description: Defines when the trigger will hit, i.e. the action specified by the trigger instructions will come into effect.

Fields.Name: TriggerAction
Fields.Description: Defines the type of action to take when the trigger hits.

Fields.Name: TriggerPrice
Fields.Description: The price at which the trigger should hit.

Fields.Name: TriggerSymbol
Fields.Description: Defines the common, 'human understood' representation of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

Fields.Name: TriggerSecurityID
Fields.Description: Defines the identity of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

Fields.Name: TriggerSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Defines the identity of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic. Same values as SecurityIDSource (22).

Fields.Name: TriggerSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Defines the security description of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

Fields.Name: TriggerPriceType
Fields.Description: The type of price that the trigger is compared to.

Fields.Name: TriggerPriceTypeScope
Fields.Description: Defines the type of price protection the customer requires on their order.

Fields.Name: TriggerPriceDirection
Fields.Description: The side from which the trigger price is reached.

Fields.Name: TriggerNewPrice
Fields.Description: The Price that the order should have after the trigger has hit. Could be applicable for any trigger type, but must be specified for Trigger Type 1.

Fields.Name: TriggerOrderType
Fields.Description: The OrdType the order should have after the trigger has hit. Required to express orders that change from Limit to Market. Other values from OrdType (40) may be used if appropriate and bilaterally agreed upon.

Fields.Name: TriggerNewQty
Fields.Description: The Quantity the order should have after the trigger has hit.

Fields.Name: TriggerTradingSessionID
Fields.Description: Defines the trading session at which the order will be activated.

Fields.Name: TriggerTradingSessionSubID
Fields.Description: Defines the subordinate trading session at which the order will be activated.

Fields.Name: OrderCategory
Fields.Description: Defines the type of interest behind a trade (fill or partial fill).

Fields.Name: NoRootPartyIDs
Fields.Description: Number of RootPartyID (1117), RootPartyIDSource (1118), and RootPartyRole (1119) entries

Fields.Name: RootPartyID
Fields.Description: PartyID value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyID (448)

Fields.Name: RootPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: PartyIDSource value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyIDSource (447)

Fields.Name: RootPartyRole
Fields.Description: PartyRole value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyRole (452)

Fields.Name: NoRootPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of RootPartySubID (1121) and RootPartySubIDType (1122) entries

Fields.Name: RootPartySubID
Fields.Description: PartySubID value within a root parties component. Same values as PartySubID (523)

Fields.Name: RootPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of RootPartySubID (1121) value. Same values as PartySubIDType (803)

Fields.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Fields.Description: Specified how the TradeCaptureReport(35=AE) should be handled by the respondent.

Fields.Name: OrigTradeHandlingInstr
Fields.Description: Optionally used with TradeHandlingInstr = 0 to relay the trade handling instruction used when reporting the trade to the marketplace. Same values as TradeHandlingInstr (1123)

Fields.Name: OrigTradeDate
Fields.Description: Used to preserve original trade date when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

Fields.Name: OrigTradeID
Fields.Description: Used to preserve original trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

Fields.Name: OrigSecondaryTradeID
Fields.Description: Used to preserve original secondary trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

Fields.Name: ApplVerID
Fields.Description: Specifies the service pack release being applied at message level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release

Fields.Name: CstmApplVerID
Fields.Description: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the message level. Enumerated field

Fields.Name: RefApplVerID
Fields.Description: Specifies the service pack release being applied to a message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID

Fields.Name: RefCstmApplVerID
Fields.Description: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the session level.

Fields.Name: TZTransactTime
Fields.Description: Transact time in the local date-time stamp with a TZ offset to UTC identified

Fields.Name: ExDestinationIDSource
Fields.Description: The ID source of ExDestination

Fields.Name: ReportedPxDiff
Fields.Description: Indicates that the reported price that is different from the market price. The price difference should be stated by using field 828 TrdType and, if required, field 829 TrdSubType

Fields.Name: RptSys
Fields.Description: Indicates the system or medium on which the report has been published

Fields.Name: AllocClearingFeeIndicator
Fields.Description: ClearingFeeIndicator(635) for Allocation, see ClearingFeeIndicator(635) for permitted values.

Fields.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Fields.Description: Specifies the service pack release being applied, by default, to message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID

Fields.Name: DisplayQty
Fields.Description: The quantity to be displayed . Required for reserve orders. On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

Fields.Name: ExchangeSpecialInstructions
Fields.Description: Free format text string related to exchange.

Fields.Name: MaxTradeVol
Fields.Description: The maximum order quantity (as expressed by TradeVolType(1786)) that can be submitted for a security.

Fields.Name: NoMDFeedTypes
Fields.Description: The number of feed types and corresponding book depths associated with a security

Fields.Name: MatchAlgorithm
Fields.Description: The types of algorithm used to match orders in a specific security. Possilbe value types are FIFO, Allocation, Pro-rata, Lead Market Maker, Currency Calender.

Fields.Name: MaxPriceVariation
Fields.Description: The maximum price variation of an execution from one event to the next for a given security. Expressed in absolute price terms.

Fields.Name: ImpliedMarketIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates that an implied market should be created for either the legs of a multi-leg instrument (Implied-in) or for the multi-leg instrument based on the existence of the legs (Implied-out). Determination as to whether implied markets should be created is generally done at the level of the multi-leg instrument. Commonly used in listed derivatives.

Fields.Name: EventTime
Fields.Description: Specific time of event. To be used in combination with EventDate [866]

Fields.Name: MinPriceIncrementAmount
Fields.Description: Minimum price increment amount associated with the MinPriceIncrement ( tag 969). For listed derivatives, the value can be calculated by multiplying MinPriceIncrement by ContractValueFactor(231).

Fields.Name: UnitOfMeasureQty
Fields.Description: Used to indicate the quantity of the underlying commodity unit of measure on which the contract is based, such as, 2500 lbs of lean cattle, 1000 barrels of crude oil, 1000 bushels of corn, etc. UnitOfMeasureQty is required for UnitOfMeasure(996) Variable Quantity UOMs enumerations. Refer to the definition of UnitOfMeasure(996) for more information on the use of UnitOfMeasureQty.

Fields.Name: LowLimitPrice
Fields.Description: Allowable low limit price for the trading day. A key parameter in validating order price. Used as the lower band for validating order prices. Orders submitted with prices below the lower limit will be rejected

Fields.Name: HighLimitPrice
Fields.Description: Allowable high limit price for the trading day. A key parameter in validating order price. Used as the upper band for validating order prices. Orders submitted with prices above the upper limit will be rejected

Fields.Name: TradingReferencePrice
Fields.Description: Reference price for the current trading price range usually representing the mid price between the HighLimitPrice and LowLimitPrice. The value may be the settlement price or closing price of the prior trading day.

Fields.Name: SecurityGroup
Fields.Description: An exchange specific name assigned to a group of related securities which may be concurrently affected by market events and actions.

Fields.Name: LegNumber
Fields.Description: Allow sequencing of Legs for a Strategy to be captured

Fields.Name: SettlementCycleNo
Fields.Description: Settlement cycle in which the settlement obligation was generated

Fields.Name: SideCurrency
Fields.Description: Used to identify the trading currency on the Trade Capture Report Side

Fields.Name: SideSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Used to identify the settlement currency on the Trade Capture Report Side

Fields.Name: ApplExtID
Fields.Description: The extension pack number associated with an application message.

Fields.Name: CcyAmt
Fields.Description: Net flow of Currency 1

Fields.Name: NoSettlDetails
Fields.Description: Used to group Each Settlement Party

Fields.Name: SettlObligMode
Fields.Description: Used to identify the reporting mode of the settlement obligation which is either preliminary or final

Fields.Name: SettlObligMsgID
Fields.Description: Message identifier for Settlement Obligation Report

Fields.Name: SettlObligID
Fields.Description: Unique ID for this settlement instruction.

Fields.Name: SettlObligTransType
Fields.Description: Transaction Type - required except where SettlInstMode is 5=Reject SSI request

Fields.Name: SettlObligRefID
Fields.Description: Required where SettlInstTransType is Cancel or Replace

Fields.Name: SettlObligSource
Fields.Description: Used to identify whether these delivery instructions are for the buyside or the sellside.

Fields.Name: NoSettlOblig
Fields.Description: Number of settlement obligations

Fields.Name: QuoteMsgID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for a quote message.

Fields.Name: QuoteEntryStatus
Fields.Description: Identifies the status of an individual quote. See also QuoteStatus(297) which is used for single Quotes.

Fields.Name: TotNoCxldQuotes
Fields.Description: Specifies the number of canceled quotes

Fields.Name: TotNoAccQuotes
Fields.Description: Specifies the number of accepted quotes

Fields.Name: TotNoRejQuotes
Fields.Description: Specifies the number of rejected quotes

Fields.Name: PrivateQuote
Fields.Description: Specifies whether a quote is public, i.e. available to the market, or private, i.e. available to a specified counterparty only.

Fields.Name: RespondentType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of respondents requested.

Fields.Name: MDSubBookType
Fields.Description: Describes a class of sub book, e.g. for the separation of various lot types. The Sub Book Type indicates that the following Market Data Entries belong to a non-integrated Sub Book. Whenever provided the Sub Book must be used together with MDPriceLevel and MDEntryPositionNo in order to sort the order properly. Values are bilaterally agreed.

Fields.Name: SecurityTradingEvent
Fields.Description: Identifies an event related to a SecurityTradingStatus(326). An event occurs and is gone, it is not a state that applies for a period of time.

Fields.Name: NoStatsIndicators
Fields.Description: Number of statistics indicator repeating group entries

Fields.Name: StatsType
Fields.Description: Type of statistics

Fields.Name: NoOfSecSizes
Fields.Description: The number of secondary sizes specifies in this entry

Fields.Name: MDSecSizeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of secondary size.

Fields.Name: MDSecSize
Fields.Description: A part of the MDEntrySize(271) that represents secondary interest as specified by MDSecSizeType(1178).

Fields.Name: ApplID
Fields.Description: Identifies the application with which a message is associated. Used only if application sequencing is in effect.

Fields.Name: ApplSeqNum
Fields.Description: Data sequence number to be used when FIX session is not in effect

Fields.Name: ApplBegSeqNum
Fields.Description: Beginning range of application sequence numbers

Fields.Name: ApplEndSeqNum
Fields.Description: Ending range of application sequence numbers

Fields.Name: SecurityXMLLen
Fields.Description: The length of the SecurityXML(1185) data block.

Fields.Name: SecurityXML
Fields.Description: XML definition for the security.

Fields.Name: SecurityXMLSchema
Fields.Description: The schema used to validate the contents of SecurityXML(1185).

Fields.Name: RefreshIndicator
Fields.Description: Set by the sender to tell the receiver to perform an immediate refresh of the book due to disruptions in the accompanying real-time feed 'Y' - Mandatory refresh by all participants 'N' - Process as required

Fields.Name: Volatility
Fields.Description: Annualized volatility for option model calculations

Fields.Name: TimeToExpiration
Fields.Description: Time to expiration in years calculated as the number of days remaining to expiration divided by 365 days per year.

Fields.Name: RiskFreeRate
Fields.Description: Interest rate. Usually some form of short term rate.

Fields.Name: PriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Used to express the UOM of the price if different from the contract. In futures, this can be different for cross-rate products in which the price is quoted in units differently from the contract

Fields.Name: PriceUnitOfMeasureQty
Fields.Description: Used to express the UOM Quantity of the price if different from the contract. In futures, this can be different for physically delivered products in which price is quoted in a unit size different from the contract, i.e. a Cattle Future contract has a UOMQty of 40,000 and a PriceUOMQty of 100.

Fields.Name: SettlMethod
Fields.Description: Settlement method for a contract or instrument. Additional values may be used with bilateral agreement.

Fields.Name: ExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: Type of exercise of a derivatives security

Fields.Name: OptPayoutAmount
Fields.Description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

Fields.Name: PriceQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: Method for price quotation

Fields.Name: ValuationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of valuation method applied.

Fields.Name: ListMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates whether instruments are pre-listed only or can also be defined via user request

Fields.Name: CapPrice
Fields.Description: Used to express the ceiling price of a capped call

Fields.Name: FloorPrice
Fields.Description: Used to express the floor price of a capped put

Fields.Name: NoStrikeRules
Fields.Description: Number of strike rule entries. This block specifies the rules for determining how new strikes should be listed within the stated price range of the underlying instrument

Fields.Name: StartStrikePxRange
Fields.Description: Starting price for the range to which the StrikeIncrement applies. Price refers to the price of the underlying

Fields.Name: EndStrikePxRange
Fields.Description: Ending price of the range to which the StrikeIncrement applies. Price refers to the price of the underlying

Fields.Name: StrikeIncrement
Fields.Description: Value by which strike price should be incremented within the specified price range.

Fields.Name: NoTickRules
Fields.Description: Number of tick rules. This block specifies the rules for determining how a security ticks, i.e. the price increments at which it can be quoted and traded, depending on the current price of the security

Fields.Name: StartTickPriceRange
Fields.Description: Starting price range for specified tick increment

Fields.Name: EndTickPriceRange
Fields.Description: Ending price range for the specified tick increment

Fields.Name: TickIncrement
Fields.Description: Tick increment for stated price range. Specifies the valid price increments at which a security can be quoted and traded

Fields.Name: TickRuleType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of tick rule which is being described

Fields.Name: NestedInstrAttribType
Fields.Description: Code to represent the type of instrument attribute

Fields.Name: NestedInstrAttribValue
Fields.Description: Attribute value appropriate to the NestedInstrAttribType field

Fields.Name: LegMaturityTime
Fields.Description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMaturityTime
Fields.Description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

Fields.Name: DerivativeSymbol
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for Symbol(55)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSymbolSfx
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SymbolSfx(65)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSecurityID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityID(48)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityIDSoruce(22)

Fields.Name: NoDerivativeSecurityAltID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for NoSecurityAltID(454)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSecurityAltID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityAltID(455)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSecurityAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityAltIDSource(456)

Fields.Name: SecondaryLowLimitPrice
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of LowLimitPrice(1148)

Fields.Name: MaturityRuleID
Fields.Description: Allows maturity rule to be referenced via an identifier so that rules do not need to be explicitly enumerated

Fields.Name: StrikeRuleID
Fields.Description: Allows strike rule to be referenced via an identifier so that rules do not need to be explicitly enumerated

Fields.Name: LegUnitOfMeasureQty
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of UnitOfMeasureQty(1147)

Fields.Name: DerivativeOptPayAmount
Fields.Description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount

Fields.Name: EndMaturityMonthYear
Fields.Description: Ending maturity month year for an option class

Fields.Name: ProductComplex
Fields.Description: Identifies an entire suite of products for a given market. In Futures this may be "interest rates", "agricultural", "equity indexes", etc.

Fields.Name: DerivativeProductComplex
Fields.Description: Refer to ProductComplex(1227)

Fields.Name: MaturityMonthYearIncrement
Fields.Description: Increment between successive maturities for an option class

Fields.Name: SecondaryHighLimitPrice
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of HighLimitPrice(1149)

Fields.Name: MinLotSize
Fields.Description: Minimum lot size allowed based on lot type specified in LotType(1093)

Fields.Name: NoExecInstRules
Fields.Description: Number of execution instructions

Fields.Name: CommRate
Fields.Description: The commission rate when Commission(12) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". If the rate is a percentage, use the decimalized form, e.g. "0.05" for a 5% commission or "0.005" for 50 basis points.

Fields.Name: NoLotTypeRules
Fields.Description: Number of Lot Type Rules

Fields.Name: NoMatchRules
Fields.Description: Number of Match Rules

Fields.Name: NoMaturityRules
Fields.Description: Number of maturity rules in MarurityRules component block

Fields.Name: NoOrdTypeRules
Fields.Description: Number of order types

Fields.Name: CommUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The commission rate unit of measure.

Fields.Name: NoTimeInForceRules
Fields.Description: Number of time in force techniques

Fields.Name: SecondaryTradingReferencePrice
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for TradingReferencePrice(1150)

Fields.Name: StartMaturityMonthYear
Fields.Description: Starting maturity month year for an option class

Fields.Name: FlexProductEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate if a product or group of product supports the creation of flexible securities

Fields.Name: DerivFlexProductEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Refer to FlexProductEligibilityIndicator(1242)

Fields.Name: FlexibleIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate a derivatives security that can be defined using flexible terms. The terms commonly permitted to be defined by market participants are expiration date and strike price. FlexibleIndicator is an alternative CFICode(461) Standard/Non-standard attribute.

Fields.Name: TradingCurrency
Fields.Description: Used when the trading currency can differ from the price currency

Fields.Name: DerivativeSecurityXMLLen
Fields.Description: Refer to definition SecurityXMLLen(1184)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSecurityXML
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of SecurityXML(1185)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSecurityXMLSchema
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of SecurityXMLSchema(1186)

Fields.Name: NoDerivativeInstrumentParties
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of NoParties(453)

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrumentPartyID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PartyID(448)

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrumentPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PartyIDSource(447)

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrumentPartyRole
Fields.Description: REfer to definition of PartyRole(452)

Fields.Name: NoDerivativeInstrumentPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for NoPartySubIDs(802)

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrumentPartySubID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for PartySubID(523)

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrumentPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for PartySubIDType(803)

Fields.Name: DerivativeExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: Type of exercise of a derivatives security

Fields.Name: MarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Identifies the market segment

Fields.Name: MarketID
Fields.Description: Identifies the market

Fields.Name: MaturityMonthYearIncrementUnits
Fields.Description: Unit of measure for the Maturity Month Year Increment

Fields.Name: MaturityMonthYearFormat
Fields.Description: Format used to generate the MaturityMonthYear for each option

Fields.Name: StrikeExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: Expiration Style for an option class:

Fields.Name: SecondaryPriceLimitType
Fields.Description: Describes the how the price limits are expressed

Fields.Name: PriceLimitType
Fields.Description: Describes the how the price limits are expressed.

Fields.Name: ExecInstValue
Fields.Description: Indicates execution instructions that are valid for the specified market segment

Fields.Name: NoTradingSessionRules
Fields.Description: Allows trading rules to be expressed by trading session

Fields.Name: NoMarketSegments
Fields.Description: Number of Market Segments on which a security may trade.

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrAttribType
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of InstrAttribType(871)

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrAttribValue
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of InstrAttribValue(872)

Fields.Name: DerivativePriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for PriceUnitOfMeasure(1191)

Fields.Name: DerivativePriceUnitOfMeasureQty
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PriceUnitOfMeasureQty(1192)

Fields.Name: DerivativeSettlMethod
Fields.Description: Settlement method for a contract or instrument. Additional values may be used with bilateral agreement.

Fields.Name: DerivativePriceQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PriceQuoteMethod(1196)

Fields.Name: DerivativeValuationMethod
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of ValuationMethod(1197).

Fields.Name: DerivativeListMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates whether instruments are pre-listed only or can also be defined via user request

Fields.Name: DerivativeCapPrice
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of CapPrice(1199)

Fields.Name: DerivativeFloorPrice
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of FloorPrice(1200)

Fields.Name: DerivativePutOrCall
Fields.Description: Indicates whether an option contract is a put, call, chooser or undetermined.

Fields.Name: ListUpdateAction
Fields.Description: If provided, then Instrument occurrence has explicitly changed

Fields.Name: ParentMktSegmID
Fields.Description: Reference to a parent Market Segment. See MarketSegmentID(1300)

Fields.Name: TradingSessionDesc
Fields.Description: Trading Session description

Fields.Name: TradSesUpdateAction
Fields.Description: Specifies the action taken for the specified trading sessions.

Fields.Name: RejectText
Fields.Description: Identifies the reason for rejection.

Fields.Name: FeeMultiplier
Fields.Description: This is a multiplier that Clearing (Fee system) will use to calculate fees and will be sent to the firms on their confirms.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegSymbol
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for Symbol(55)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegSymbolSfx
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SymbolSfx(65)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegSecurityID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityID(48)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityIDSource(22)

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingLegSecurityAltID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for NoSecurityAltID(454)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegSecurityAltID
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityAltID(455)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegSecurityAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for SecurityAltIDSource(456)

Fields.Name: ApplReqID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for request

Fields.Name: ApplReqType
Fields.Description: Type of Application Message Request being made.

Fields.Name: ApplResponseType
Fields.Description: Used to indicate the type of acknowledgement being sent.

Fields.Name: ApplTotalMessageCount
Fields.Description: Total number of messages included in transmission.

Fields.Name: ApplLastSeqNum
Fields.Description: Application sequence number of last message in transmission

Fields.Name: NoApplIDs
Fields.Description: Specifies number of application id occurrences

Fields.Name: ApplResendFlag
Fields.Description: Used to indicate that a message is being sent in response to an Application Message Request. It is possible for both ApplResendFlag and PossDupFlag to be set on the same message if the Sender's cache size is greater than zero and the message is being resent due to a session level resend request

Fields.Name: ApplResponseID
Fields.Description: Identifier for the Applicaton Message Request Ack

Fields.Name: ApplResponseError
Fields.Description: Used to return an error code or text associated with a response to an Application Request.

Fields.Name: RefApplID
Fields.Description: Reference to the unique application identifier which corresponds to ApplID(1180) from the Application Sequence Group component

Fields.Name: ApplReportID
Fields.Description: Identifier for the Application Sequence Reset

Fields.Name: RefApplLastSeqNum
Fields.Description: Application sequence number of last message in transmission.

Fields.Name: LegPutOrCall
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a leg option contract is a put, call, chooser or undetermined.

Fields.Name: TotNoFills
Fields.Description: Total number of fill entries across all messages. Should be the sum of all NoFills(1362) in each message that has repeating list of fill entries related to the same ExecID(17). Used to support fragmentation.

Fields.Name: FillExecID
Fields.Description: Refer to ExecID(17). Used when multiple partial fills are reported in single Execution Report. ExecID and FillExecID should not overlap,

Fields.Name: FillPx
Fields.Description: Price of Fill. Refer to LastPx(31).

Fields.Name: FillQty
Fields.Description: Quantity of Fill. Refer to LastQty(32).

Fields.Name: LegAllocID
Fields.Description: The AllocID(70) of an individual leg of a multileg order.

Fields.Name: LegAllocSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Identifies settlement currency for the leg level allocation.

Fields.Name: TradSesEvent
Fields.Description: Identifies an event related to a TradSesStatus(340). An event occurs and is gone, it is not a state that applies for a period of time.

Fields.Name: MassActionReportID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier of Order Mass Cancel Report or Order Mass Action Report message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN)

Fields.Name: NoNotAffectedOrders
Fields.Description: Number of not affected orders in the repeating group of order ids.

Fields.Name: NotAffectedOrderID
Fields.Description: OrderID(37) of an order not affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

Fields.Name: NotAffOrigClOrdID
Fields.Description: ClOrdID(11) of an order not affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

Fields.Name: MassActionType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of action requested

Fields.Name: MassActionScope
Fields.Description: Specifies scope of Order Mass Action Request.

Fields.Name: MassActionResponse
Fields.Description: Specifies the action taken by counterparty order handling system as a result of the action type indicated in MassActionType of the Order Mass Action Request.

Fields.Name: MassActionRejectReason
Fields.Description: Reason Order Mass Action Request was rejected

Fields.Name: MultilegModel
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of multileg order. Defines whether the security is pre-defined or user-defined. Note that MultilegModel(1377)=2(User-defined, Non-Securitized, Multileg) does not apply for Securities.

Fields.Name: MultilegPriceMethod
Fields.Description: Code to represent how the multileg price is to be interpreted when applied to the legs. (See Volume : "Glossary" for further value definitions)

Fields.Name: LegVolatility
Fields.Description: Specifies the volatility of an instrument leg.

Fields.Name: DividendYield
Fields.Description: The continuously-compounded annualized dividend yield of the underlying(s) of an option. Used as a parameter to theoretical option pricing models.

Fields.Name: LegDividendYield
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for DividendYield(1380).

Fields.Name: CurrencyRatio
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency ratio between the currency used for a multileg price and the currency used by the outright book defined by the leg. Example: Multileg quoted in EUR, outright leg in USD and 1 EUR = 0,7 USD then CurrencyRatio = 0.7

Fields.Name: LegCurrencyRatio
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency ratio between the currency used for a multileg price and the currency used by the outright book defined by the leg. Example: Multileg quoted in EUR, outright leg in USD and 1 EUR = 0,7 USD then LegCurrencyRatio = 0.7

Fields.Name: LegExecInst
Fields.Description: Refer to ExecInst(18) Same values as ExecInst(18)

Fields.Name: ContingencyType
Fields.Description: Defines the type of contingency.

Fields.Name: ListRejectReason
Fields.Description: Identifies the reason for rejection of a New Order List message. Note that OrdRejReason(103) is used if the rejection is based on properties of an individual order part of the List.

Fields.Name: NoTrdRepIndicators
Fields.Description: Number of trade reporting indicators

Fields.Name: TrdRepPartyRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of party for trade reporting. Same values as PartyRole(452).

Fields.Name: TrdRepIndicator
Fields.Description: Specifies whether the trade should be reported (or not) to parties of the provided TrdRepPartyRole(1388). Used to override standard reporting behavior by the receiver of the trade report and thereby complements the PublTrdIndicator( tag1390).

Fields.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates if a trade should be or has been published via a market publication service. The indicator governs all publication services of the recipient. Replaces PublishTrdIndicator(852).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegOptAttribute
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of OptAttribute(206)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of SecurityDesc(107)

Fields.Name: MarketReqID
Fields.Description: Unique ID of a Market Definition Request message.

Fields.Name: MarketReportID
Fields.Description: Market Definition message identifier.

Fields.Name: MarketUpdateAction
Fields.Description: Specifies the action taken for the specified MarketID(1301) + MarketSegmentID(1300).

Fields.Name: MarketSegmentDesc
Fields.Description: Description or name of Market Segment

Fields.Name: EncodedMktSegmDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMktSegmDesc(1324) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedMktSegmDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MarketSegmDesc(1396) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MarketSegmDesc field.

Fields.Name: ApplNewSeqNum
Fields.Description: Used to specify a new application sequence number.

Fields.Name: EncryptedPasswordMethod
Fields.Description: Enumeration defining the encryption method used to encrypt password fields. At this time there are no encryption methods defined by FPL.

Fields.Name: EncryptedPasswordLen
Fields.Description: Length of the EncryptedPassword(1402) field

Fields.Name: EncryptedPassword
Fields.Description: Encrypted password - encrypted via the method specified in the field EncryptedPasswordMethod(1400)

Fields.Name: EncryptedNewPasswordLen
Fields.Description: Length of the EncryptedNewPassword(1404) field

Fields.Name: EncryptedNewPassword
Fields.Description: Encrypted new password - encrypted via the method specified in the field EncryptedPasswordMethod(1400)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLegMaturityTime
Fields.Description: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

Fields.Name: RefApplExtID
Fields.Description: The extension pack number associated with an application message.

Fields.Name: DefaultApplExtID
Fields.Description: The extension pack number that is the default for a FIX session.

Fields.Name: DefaultCstmApplVerID
Fields.Description: The default custom application version ID that is the default for a session.

Fields.Name: SessionStatus
Fields.Description: Status of a FIX session

Fields.Name: Nested4PartySubIDType
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PartySubIDType(803)

Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PartySubID(523)

Fields.Name: Nested4PartyRole
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PartyRole(452)

Fields.Name: LegLastQty
Fields.Description: Fill quantity for the leg instrument

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: Type of exercise of a derivatives security

Fields.Name: LegExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: Type of exercise of a derivatives security

Fields.Name: LegPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for PriceUnitOfMeasure(1191)

Fields.Name: LegPriceUnitOfMeasureQty
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PriceUnitOfMeasureQty(1192)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingUnitOfMeasureQty
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of UnitOfMeasureQty(1147)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Refer to definition for PriceUnitOfMeasure(1191)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPriceUnitOfMeasureQty
Fields.Description: Refer to definition of PriceUnitOfMeasureQty(1192)

Fields.Name: ApplReportType
Fields.Description: Type of report

Fields.Name: SideExecID
Fields.Description: When reporting trades, used to reference the identifier of the execution (ExecID) being reported if different ExecIDs were assigned to each side of the trade.

Fields.Name: OrderDelay
Fields.Description: Time lapsed from order entry until match, based on the unit of time specified in OrderDelayUnit. Default is seconds if OrderDelayUnit is not specified. Value = 0, indicates the aggressor (the initiating side of the trade).

Fields.Name: OrderDelayUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit in which the OrderDelay(1428) is expressed

Fields.Name: VenueType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of venue where a trade was executed

Fields.Name: RefOrdIDReason
Fields.Description: The reason for updating the RefOrdID

Fields.Name: OrigCustOrderCapacity
Fields.Description: The customer capacity for this trade at the time of the order/execution. Primarily used by futures exchanges to indicate the CTICode (customer type indicator) as required by the US CFTC (Commodity Futures Trading Commission).

Fields.Name: RefApplReqID
Fields.Description: Used to reference a previously submitted ApplReqID (1346) from within a subsequent ApplicationMessageRequest(MsgType=BW)

Fields.Name: ModelType
Fields.Description: Type of pricing model used

Fields.Name: ContractMultiplierUnit
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of multiplier being applied to the contract. Can be optionally used to further define what unit ContractMultiplier(tag 231) is expressed in.

Fields.Name: LegContractMultiplierUnit
Fields.Description: "Indicates the type of multiplier being applied to the contract. Can be optionally used to further define what unit LegContractMultiplier(tag 614) is expressed in.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingContractMultiplierUnit
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of multiplier being applied to the contract.
Fields.Elaboration: Can be optionally used to further define what unit UnderlyingContractMultiplier(436) is expressed in.

Fields.Name: DerivativeContractMultiplierUnit
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of multiplier being applied to the contract. Can be optionally used to further define what unit DerivativeContractMultiplier(tag 1266)is expressed in.

Fields.Name: FlowScheduleType
Fields.Description: The industry standard flow schedule by which electricity or natural gas is traded. Schedules may exist by regions and on-peak and off-peak status, such as "Western Peak".

Fields.Name: LegFlowScheduleType
Fields.Description: The industry standard flow schedule by which electricity or natural gas is traded. Schedules exist by regions and on-peak and off-peak status, such as "Western Peak".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFlowScheduleType
Fields.Description: The industry standard flow schedule by which electricity or natural gas is traded. Schedules exist by regions and on-peak and off-peak status, such as "Western Peak".

Fields.Name: DerivativeFlowScheduleType
Fields.Description: The industry standard flow schedule by which electricity or natural gas is traded. Schedules exist by regions and on-peak and off-peak status, such as "Western Peak".

Fields.Name: FillLiquidityInd
Fields.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled

Fields.Name: SideLiquidityInd
Fields.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

Fields.Name: NoRateSources
Fields.Description: Number of rate sources being specified.

Fields.Name: RateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX, the reference source to be used for the FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: RateSourceType
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the rate source specified is a primary or secondary source.

Fields.Name: ReferencePage
Fields.Description:
Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When RateSource(1446) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: RestructuringType
Fields.Description: A category of CDS credit event in which the underlying bond experiences a restructuring. Used to define a CDS instrument.

Fields.Name: Seniority
Fields.Description: Specifies which issue (underlying bond) will receive payment priority in the event of a default. Used to define a CDS instrument.
Fields.Elaboration: The payment priority is this: Senior Secured (SD), Senior (SR), Senior Non-Preferred (SN), Subordinated (SB), Mezzanine (MZ), Junior (JR).

Fields.Name: NotionalPercentageOutstanding
Fields.Description: Indicates the notional percentage of the deal that is still outstanding based on the remaining components of the index. Used to calculate the true value of a CDS trade or position.

Fields.Name: OriginalNotionalPercentageOutstanding
Fields.Description: Used to reflect the Original value prior to the application of a credit event. See NotionalPercentageOutstanding(1451).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingRestructuringType
Fields.Description: See RestructuringType(1449)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSeniority
Fields.Description: See Seniority(1450)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNotionalPercentageOutstanding
Fields.Description: See NotionalPercentageOutstanding(1451)

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOriginalNotionalPercentageOutstanding
Fields.Description: See OriginalNotionalPercentageOutstanding(1452)

Fields.Name: AttachmentPoint
Fields.Description: Lower bound percentage of the loss that the tranche can endure.

Fields.Name: DetachmentPoint
Fields.Description: Upper bound percentage of the loss the tranche can endure.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAttachmentPoint
Fields.Description: See AttachmentPoint(1457).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDetachmentPoint
Fields.Description: See DetachmentPoint(1458).

Fields.Name: NoTargetPartyIDs
Fields.Description: Identifies the number of target parties identified in a mass action.

Fields.Name: TargetPartyID
Fields.Description: PartyID value within an target party repeating group.

Fields.Name: TargetPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: PartyIDSource value within an target party repeating group. Same values as PartyIDSource (447)

Fields.Name: TargetPartyRole
Fields.Description: PartyRole value within an target party repeating group. Same values as PartyRole (452)

Fields.Name: SecurityListID
Fields.Description: Specifies an identifier for a Security List

Fields.Name: SecurityListRefID
Fields.Description: Specifies a reference from one Security List to another. Used to support a hierarchy of Security Lists.

Fields.Name: SecurityListDesc
Fields.Description: Specifies a description or name of a Security List.

Fields.Name: EncodedSecurityListDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedSecurityListDesc (tbd) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedSecurityListDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the SecurityListDesc (1467) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the SecurityListDesc field.

Fields.Name: SecurityListType
Fields.Description: Specifies a type of Security List.

Fields.Name: SecurityListTypeSource
Fields.Description: Specifies a specific source for a SecurityListType. Relevant when a certain type can be provided from various sources.

Fields.Name: NewsID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for a News message

Fields.Name: NewsCategory
Fields.Description: Category of news mesage.

Fields.Name: LanguageCode
Fields.Description: The national language in which the news item is provided.

Fields.Name: NoNewsRefIDs
Fields.Description: Number of News reference items

Fields.Name: NewsRefID
Fields.Description: Reference to another News message identified by NewsID(1474).

Fields.Name: NewsRefType
Fields.Description: Type of reference to another News(35=B) message item.

Fields.Name: StrikePriceDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how the strike price is determined at the point of option exercise. The strike may be fixed throughout the life of the option, set at expiration to the value of the underlying, set to the average value of the underlying , or set to the optimal value of the underlying.

Fields.Name: StrikePriceBoundaryMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the strike price relative to the underlying price at the point of option exercise.

Fields.Name: StrikePriceBoundaryPrecision
Fields.Description: Used in combination with StrikePriceBoundaryMethod to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPriceDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how the underlying price is determined at the point of option exercise. The underlying price may be set to the current settlement price, set to a special reference, set to the optimal value of the underlying during the defined period ("Look-back") or set to the average value of the underlying during the defined period ("Asian option").

Fields.Name: OptPayoutType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of valuation method or payout trigger for an in-the-money option.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEvents
Fields.Description: Number of complex event occurrences.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of complex event.

Fields.Name: ComplexOptPayoutAmount
Fields.Description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an event. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPrice
Fields.Description: Specifies the price at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the ComplexEventType(1484).

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the event price relative to the underlying price at the point the complex event outcome takes effect as determined by the ComplexEventPriceTimeType.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPriceBoundaryPrecision
Fields.Description: Used in combination with ComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPriceTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies when the complex event outcome takes effect. The outcome of a complex event is a payout or barrier action as specified by the ComplexEventType(1484).

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies the condition between complex events when more than one event is specified. Multiple barrier events would use an "or" condition since only one can be effective at a given time. A set of digital range events would use an "and" condition since both conditions must be in effect for a payout to result.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventDates
Fields.Description: Number of complex event date occurrences for a given complex event.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventStartDate
Fields.Description: Specifies the start date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options ComplexEventStartDate must always be less than or equal to ComplexEventEndDate.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventEndDate
Fields.Description: Specifies the end date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options ComplexEventEndDate must always be greater than or equal to ComplexEventStartDate.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventTimes
Fields.Description: Number of complex event time occurrences for a given complex event date The default in case of an absence of time fields is 00:00:00-23:59:59.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventStartTime
Fields.Description: Specifies the start time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective. ComplexEventStartTime must always be less than or equal to ComplexEventEndTime.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventEndTime
Fields.Description: Specifies the end time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective. ComplexEventEndTime must always be greater than or equal to ComplexEventStartTime.

Fields.Name: StreamAsgnReqID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the stream assignment request provided by the requester.

Fields.Name: StreamAsgnReqType
Fields.Description: Type of stream assignment request.

Fields.Name: NoAsgnReqs
Fields.Description: Number of assignment requests.

Fields.Name: MDStreamID
Fields.Description: The identifier or name of the price stream.

Fields.Name: StreamAsgnRptID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier of the stream assignment report provided by the respondent.

Fields.Name: StreamAsgnRejReason
Fields.Description: Reason code for stream assignment request reject.

Fields.Name: StreamAsgnAckType
Fields.Description: Type of acknowledgement.

Fields.Name: RelSymTransactTime
Fields.Description: See TransactTime(60)

Fields.Name: PartyDetailsListRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for PartyDetailsListRequest.

Fields.Name: SideTradeID
Fields.Description: Used to represent the trade ID for each side of the trade assigned by an intermediary.

Fields.Name: SideOrigTradeID
Fields.Description: Used to capture the original trade id for each side of a trade undergoing novation to a standardized model.

Fields.Name: NoRequestedPartyRoles
Fields.Description: Number of requested party roles.

Fields.Name: RequestedPartyRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type or role of party that has been requested.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailsListReportID
Fields.Description: Identifier for the PartyDetailsListReport and the PartyDetailsListUpdateReport.

Fields.Name: RequestResult
Fields.Description: Result of a request as identified by the appropriate request ID field

Fields.Name: TotNoParties
Fields.Description: Total number of PartyListGrp returned.

Fields.Name: DocumentationText
Fields.Description: A sentence or phrase pertenant to the trade, not a reference to an external document. E.g. "To be registered with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Acid Rain Division, SO2 Allowance Tracking System"

Fields.Name: NoPartyRelationships
Fields.Description: Number of party relationships.

Fields.Name: PartyRelationship
Fields.Description: Used to specify the type of the party relationship.

Fields.Name: NoPartyDetailAltID
Fields.Description: Number of party alternative identifiers.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailAltID
Fields.Description: An alternate party identifier for the party specified in PartyDetailID(1691)

Fields.Name: PartyDetailAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of the PartyDetailAltID(1517) value.

Fields.Name: NoPartyDetailAltSubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of party detail alternate sub-identifiers.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailAltSubID
Fields.Description: Sub-identifier for the party specified in PartyDetailAltID(1517).

Fields.Name: PartyDetailAltSubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of PartyDetailAltSubID(1520) value.

Fields.Name: DifferentialPrice
Fields.Description: Used to specify the differential price when reporting the individual leg of a spread trade. Both leg price and differential price may be provided on such a report. Note that MultiLegReportingType(442) will be set to 2 (Individual leg of a multi-leg security) in this case. Also used in pricing Trade at Settlement (TAS) and Trade At Marker (TAM) contracts for which the value is the negotiated currency offset either at settlement (TAS) or at time specified in the product definition (TAM). The final contract price is specified in LastPx(31).

Fields.Name: TrdAckStatus
Fields.Description: Used to indicate the status of the trade submission (not the trade report)

Fields.Name: PriceQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Default currency in which the price is quoted. Defined at the instrument level. Used in place of Currency (tag 15) to express the currency of a product when the former is implemented as the FX dealt currency.

Fields.Name: EncodedDocumentationTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedDocumentationText(1527) field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPriceQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Default currency in which the price is quoted. Defined at the instrument level. Used in place of Currency (tag 15) to express the currency of a product when the former is implemented as the FX dealt currency.

Fields.Name: EncodedDocumentationText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the DocumentationText(1513) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the DocumentationText(1513) field.

Fields.Name: LegPriceQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Default currency in which the price is quoted. Defined at the instrument level. Used in place of Currency (tag 15) to express the currency of a product when the former is implemented as the FX dealt currency.

Fields.Name: NoRiskLimitTypes
Fields.Description: Number of risk limits with associated warning levels.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitType
Fields.Description: Used to specify the type of risk limit amount or position limit quantity or margin requirement amounts.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the risk limit amount.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCurrency
Fields.Description: Used to specify the currency of the risk limit amount.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitPlatform
Fields.Description: The area to which risk limit is applicable. This can be a trading platform or an offering.

Fields.Name: NoRiskInstrumentScopes
Fields.Description: Number of risk instrument scopes.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeOperator
Fields.Description: Operator to perform on the instrument(s) specified

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSymbol
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified symbol. See Symbol(55) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSymbolSfx
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified symbol suffix. See SymbolSfx(65) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityID
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security identifier. See SecurityID(48) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security identifier source. See SecurityIDSource(22) field for description.

Fields.Name: NoInstrumentScopeSecurityAltID
Fields.Description: Number of alternate security identifier for the specified InstrumentScopeSecurityID(1538).

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityAltID
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security alternate identifier. See SecurityAltID(455) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security alternate identifier source. See SecurityAltIDSource(456) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeProduct
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified instrument product category. See Product (460) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeProductComplex
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified product complex. See ProductComplex(1227) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityGroup
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security group. See SecurityGroup(1151) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeCFICode
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified CFICode. See CFICode(461) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityType
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security type. See SecurityType(167) field for description).

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecuritySubType
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security sub-type. See SecuritySubType(762) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeMaturityMonthYear
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified maturity month and year. See MaturityMonthYear(200) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeMaturityTime
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified maturity time. See MaturityTime(1079) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeRestructuringType
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified restructuring type. See RestructuringType(1449) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSeniority
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified seniority type. See Seniority(1450) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopePutOrCall
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to puts or calls. See PutOrCall(201) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeFlexibleIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to securities that can be defined using flexible terms or not. See FlexibleIndicator(1244) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeCouponRate
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified coupon rate. See CouponRate(223) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security description. See SecurityDesc(107) field for description.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSettlType
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified settlement type. See SettlType(63) field for description.

Fields.Name: RiskInstrumentMultiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to the transaction amount for comparison with risk limits. Default if not specified is 1.0.

Fields.Name: NoRiskWarningLevels
Fields.Description: Number of risk warning levels.

Fields.Name: RiskWarningLevelPercent
Fields.Description: Percent of risk limit at which a warning is issued.

Fields.Name: RiskWarningLevelName
Fields.Description: Name or error message associated with the risk warning level.

Fields.Name: NoRelatedPartyDetailID
Fields.Description: Number of related party detail identifiers.

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailID
Fields.Description: Party identifier for the party related to the party specified in PartyDetailID(1691).

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of the RelatedPartyDetailID(1563).

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type or role of the RelatedPartyDetailID(1563) specified.

Fields.Name: NoRelatedPartyDetailSubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of related party detail sub-identifiers.

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailSubID
Fields.Description: Sub-identifier for the party specified in RelatedPartyID(1563).

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailSubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of RelatedPartyDetailSubID(1567) value.

Fields.Name: NoRelatedPartyDetailAltID
Fields.Description: Number of related party detail alternate identifiers.

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailAltID
Fields.Description: An alternate party identifier for the party specified in RelatedPartyID(1563).

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of the RelatedPartyDetailAltID(1570) value.

Fields.Name: NoRelatedPartyDetailAltSubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of related party detail alternate sub-identifiers.

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailAltSubID
Fields.Description: Sub-identifier for the party specified in RelatedPartyDetailAltID(1570).

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailAltSubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of RelatedPartyDetailAltSubID(1573) value.

Fields.Name: SwapSubClass
Fields.Description: The sub-classification or notional schedule type of the swap.

Fields.Name: DerivativePriceQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Default currency in which the price is quoted. Defined at the instrument level. Used in place of Currency (tag 15) to express the currency of a product when the former is implemented as the FX dealt currency.

Fields.Name: SettlRateIndex
Fields.Description: In an outright or forward commodity trade that is cash settled this is the index used to determine the cash payment.

Fields.Name: EncodedEventTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedEventText(868) fied.

Fields.Name: EncodedEventText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the EventText(868) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the EventText(868) field.

Fields.Name: SettlRateIndexLocation
Fields.Description: This is an optional qualifying attribute of SettlRateIndex(1577) such as the delivery zone for an electricity contract.

Fields.Name: OptionExpirationDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the option expiration.

Fields.Name: NoSecurityClassifications
Fields.Description: Number of Security Classifications.

Fields.Name: SecurityClassificationReason
Fields.Description: Allows classification of instruments according to a set of high level reasons. Classification reasons describe the classes in which the instrument participates.

Fields.Name: SecurityClassificationValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the product classification value which further details the manner in which the instrument participates in the class.

Fields.Name: PosAmtReason
Fields.Description: Specifies the reason for an amount type when reported on a position. Useful when multiple instances of the same amount type are reported.

Fields.Name: NoLegPosAmt
Fields.Description: Number of TrdInstrmtLegPosAmt values.

Fields.Name: LegPosAmt
Fields.Description: Leg position amount.

Fields.Name: LegPosAmtType
Fields.Description: Type of leg position amount.

Fields.Name: LegPosCurrency
Fields.Description: Leg position currency.

Fields.Name: LegPosAmtReason
Fields.Description: Specifies the reason for an amount type when reported on a position. Useful when multiple instances of the same amount type are reported.

Fields.Name: LegQtyType
Fields.Description: Type of quantity specified in LegQty field. LegContractMultiplier (614) is required when LegQtyType = 1 (Contracts). LegUnitOfMeasure (tag 999) and LegTimeUnit (tag 1001) are required when LegQtyType = 2 (Units of Measure per Time Unit). LegQtyType can be different for each leg.

Fields.Name: DiscountFactor
Fields.Description: Used to calculate the present value of an amount to be paid in the future.

Fields.Name: ParentAllocID
Fields.Description: Contains the IndividualAllocId (tag 467) value of the allocation that is being offset as a result of a new allocation. This would be an optional field that would only be populated in the case of an allocation of an allocation (as well as any subsequent allocations). This wouldn’t be populated for an initial allocation since an allocation id is not supplied on default (initial) allocations.

Fields.Name: LegSecurityGroup
Fields.Description: Represents the product group of a leg.This is useful in conveying multi-leg instruments where the legs may participate in separate security groups.

Fields.Name: PositionContingentPrice
Fields.Description: Risk adjusted price used to calculate variation margin on a position.

Fields.Name: ClearingTradePrice
Fields.Description: Alternate clearing price

Fields.Name: SideClearingTradePrice
Fields.Description: Alternate clearing price for the side being reported.

Fields.Name: SideClearingTradePriceType
Fields.Description: Indicates to recipient whether trade is clearing at execution prices LastPx(tag 31) or alternate clearing prices SideClearingTradePrice(tag 1597).

Fields.Name: SidePriceDifferential
Fields.Description: Price Differential between the front and back leg of a spread or complex instrument.

Fields.Name: FIXEngineName
Fields.Description: Provides the name of the infrastructure component being used for session level communication. Normally this would be the FIX Engine or FIX Gateway product name.

Fields.Name: FIXEngineVersion
Fields.Description: Provides the version of the infrastructure component.

Fields.Name: FIXEngineVendor
Fields.Description: Provides the name of the vendor providing the infrastructure component.

Fields.Name: ApplicationSystemName
Fields.Description: Provides the name of the application system being used to generate FIX application messages. This will normally be a trading system, OMS, or EMS.

Fields.Name: ApplicationSystemVersion
Fields.Description: Provides the version of the application system being used to initiate FIX application messages.

Fields.Name: ApplicationSystemVendor
Fields.Description: Provides the vendor of the application system.

Fields.Name: NumOfSimpleInstruments
Fields.Description: Represents the total number of simple instruments that make up a multi-legged security. Complex spread instruments may be constructed of legs which themselves are multi-leg instruments.

Fields.Name: SecurityRejectReason
Fields.Description: Identifies the reason a security definition request is being rejected.

Fields.Name: InitialDisplayQty
Fields.Description: Used to convey the initially requested display quantity specified in DisplayQty(1138) on order entry and modification messages in ExecutionReport message. Applicable only in ExecutionReport message where DisplayQty(1138) is the currently displayed quantity and the requested display quantity of the order also needs to be conveyed. The values of the two fields are different as soon as the order is partially filled and also after a refresh of the order whenever DisplayMethod(1084) is not 1=Initial.

Fields.Name: ThrottleStatus
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a message was queued as a result of throttling.

Fields.Name: NoThrottles
Fields.Description: Indicates number of repeating groups to follow.

Fields.Name: ThrottleAction
Fields.Description: Action to take should throttle limit be exceeded.

Fields.Name: ThrottleType
Fields.Description: Type of throttle.

Fields.Name: ThrottleNoMsgs
Fields.Description: Maximum number of messages allowed by the throttle. May be a rate limit or a limit on the number of outstanding requests.

Fields.Name: ThrottleTimeInterval
Fields.Description: Value of the time interval in which the rate throttle is applied.

Fields.Name: ThrottleTimeUnit
Fields.Description: Units in which ThrottleTimeInterval is expressed. Uses same enumerations as OrderDelayUnit(1429).

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeSecurityExchange
Fields.Description: Used to limit instrument scope to specified security exchange. See SecurityExchange(207) field for description.

Fields.Name: StreamAsgnType
Fields.Description: The type of assignment being affected in the Stream Assignment Report.

Fields.Name: NoThrottleMsgType
Fields.Description: Number of ThrottleMsgType fields.

Fields.Name: ThrottleMsgType
Fields.Description: The MsgType (35) of the FIX message being referenced.

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeEncodedSecurityDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) InstrumentScopeEncodedSecurityDesc (1621) field

Fields.Name: InstrumentScopeEncodedSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the InstrumentScopeSecurityDesc (1556) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the InstrumentScopeSecurityDesc field.

Fields.Name: FillYieldType
Fields.Description: Yield Type, using same values as YieldType (235)

Fields.Name: FillYield
Fields.Description: Yield Percentage, using same values as Yield (236)

Fields.Name: NoMatchInst
Fields.Description: Number of Instructions in the <MatchingInstructions> repeating group.

Fields.Name: MatchInst
Fields.Description: Matching Instruction for the order.

Fields.Name: MatchAttribTagID
Fields.Description: Existing FIX field to be applied as a matching criteria to the instruction, bilaterally agreed between parties.

Fields.Name: MatchAttribValue
Fields.Description: Value of MatchAttribTagID(1626) on which to apply the matching instruction.

Fields.Name: TriggerScope
Fields.Description: Defines the scope of TriggerAction(1101) when it is set to "cancel" (3).

Fields.Name: ExposureDuration
Fields.Description: This is the time in seconds of a "Good for Time" (GFT) TimeInForce. Positive integer value which represents the time is seconds in which the new order remains active in the market before it is automatically cancelled (e.g. expired). Bi-lateral agreements will dictate the maximum value of this field. It is assumed that most systems will impose a max limit of 86,400 seconds (i.e. 24 hours). For Quotes: The period of time a quoted price is tradable(i.e. on-the-wire) before it becomes indicative (i.e. off-the-wire).

Fields.Name: NoLimitAmts
Fields.Description: The number of limit amount entries.

Fields.Name: LimitAmtType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of limit amount expressed in LastLimitAmt(1632) and LimitAmtRemaining(1633).

Fields.Name: LastLimitAmt
Fields.Description: The amount that has been drawn down against the counterparty for a given trade. The type of limit is specified in LimitAmtType(1631). Bilateral agreements dictate the units and maximum value of this field.

Fields.Name: LimitAmtRemaining
Fields.Description: The remaining limit amount available between the counterparties. The type of limit is specified in LimitAmtType(1631). Bilateral agreements dictate the units and maximum value of this field.

Fields.Name: LimitAmtCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency that the limit amount is specified in. See Currency(15) for additional description and valid values.

Fields.Name: MarginReqmtInqID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier of the MarginRequirementInquiry.

Fields.Name: NoMarginReqmtInqQualifier
Fields.Description: Number of margin requirement inquiry qualifiers.

Fields.Name: MarginReqmtInqQualifier
Fields.Description: Qualifier for MarginRequirementInquiry to identify a specific report.

Fields.Name: MarginReqmtRptType
Fields.Description: Type of MarginRequirementReport.

Fields.Name: MarginClass
Fields.Description: Identifier for group of instruments with similar risk profile.

Fields.Name: MarginReqmtInqStatus
Fields.Description: Status of MarginRequirementInquiry.

Fields.Name: MarginReqmtInqResult
Fields.Description: Result returned in response to MarginRequirementInquiry.

Fields.Name: MarginReqmtRptID
Fields.Description: Identifier for the MarginRequirementReport message.

Fields.Name: NoMarginAmt
Fields.Description: Number of margin requirement amounts.

Fields.Name: MarginAmtType
Fields.Description: Type of margin requirement amount being specified.

Fields.Name: MarginAmt
Fields.Description: Amount of margin requirement.

Fields.Name: MarginAmtCcy
Fields.Description: Currency of the MarginAmt(1645).

Fields.Name: NoRelatedInstruments
Fields.Description: Number of related instruments

Fields.Name: RelatedInstrumentType
Fields.Description: The type of instrument relationship

Fields.Name: RelatedSymbol
Fields.Description: Ticker symbol of the related security. Common "human understood" representation of the security.

Fields.Name: RelatedSecurityID
Fields.Description: Related security identifier value of RelatedSecurityIDSource(1651) type.

Fields.Name: RelatedSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies class or source of the RelatedSecurityID (1650) value.

Fields.Name: RelatedSecurityType
Fields.Description: Security type of the related instrument.

Fields.Name: RelatedMaturityMonthYear
Fields.Description: Expiration date for the related instrument contract.

Fields.Name: CoveredQty
Fields.Description: Used to specify the portion of the short contract quantity that is considered covered (e.g. used for short option position).

Fields.Name: MarketMakerActivity
Fields.Description: Indicates market maker participation in security.

Fields.Name: NoInstrumentScopes
Fields.Description: Number of instrument scopes.

Fields.Name: NoRequestingPartyIDs
Fields.Description: Number of requesting party identifiers.

Fields.Name: RequestingPartyID
Fields.Description: Party identifier for the requesting party.

Fields.Name: RequestingPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of the RequestingPartyID(1658) value.

Fields.Name: RequestingPartyRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type or role of the RequestingPartyID(1658) specified.

Fields.Name: NoRequestingPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of requesting party sub-identifiers.

Fields.Name: RequestingPartySubID
Fields.Description: Sub-identifier for the party specified in RequestingPartyID(1658).

Fields.Name: RequestingPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of RequestingPartySubID(1662) value.

Fields.Name: EncodedRejectTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedRejectText(1665) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedRejectText
