Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the RejectText(1328) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the RejectText(1328) field.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the PartyRiskLimitsRequest

Fields.Name: RiskLimitReportID
Fields.Description: Identifier for the PartyRiskLimitsReport

Fields.Name: NoRequestedRiskLimitType
Fields.Description: Number of risk limit types requested.

Fields.Name: NoRiskLimits
Fields.Description: Number of risk limits for different instrument scopes.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitID
Fields.Description: Unique reference identifier for a specific risk limit defined for the specified party.

Fields.Name: NoPartyDetails
Fields.Description: Number of party details.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailStatus
Fields.Description: Indicates the status of the party identified with PartyDetailID(1691).

Fields.Name: MatchInstMarketID
Fields.Description: Identifies the market to which the matching instruction applies.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Qualifies the value of PartyDetailRole(1693).

Fields.Name: RelatedPartyDetailRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Qualifies the value of RelatedPartyRole(1565)

Fields.Name: NoPartyUpdates
Fields.Description: Number of party updates.

Fields.Name: NoPartyRiskLimits
Fields.Description: Number of party risk limits.

Fields.Name: EncodedOptionExpirationDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedOptionExpirationDesc(1697) field.

Fields.Name: SecurityMassTradingStatus
Fields.Description: Identifies the trading status applicable to a group of instruments.

Fields.Name: SecurityMassTradingEvent
Fields.Description: Identifies an event related to the mass trading status.

Fields.Name: MassHaltReason
Fields.Description: Denotes the reason for the Opening Delay or Trading halt of a group of securities.

Fields.Name: MDSecurityTradingStatus
Fields.Description: Identifies the trading status applicable to the instrument in the market data message.

Fields.Name: MDSubFeedType
Fields.Description: Describes a sub-class for a given class of service defined by MDFeedType (1022)

Fields.Name: MDHaltReason
Fields.Description: Denotes the reason for the Opening Delay or Trading Halt.

Fields.Name: ThrottleInst
Fields.Description: Describes action recipient should take if a throttle limit were exceeded.

Fields.Name: ThrottleCountIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a message decrements the number of outstanding requests, e.g. one where ThrottleType = Outstanding Requests.

Fields.Name: ShortSaleRestriction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a restriction applies to short selling a security.

Fields.Name: ShortSaleExemptionReason
Fields.Description: Indicates the reason a short sale order is exempted from applicable regulation (e.g. Reg SHO addendum (b)(1) in the U.S.).

Fields.Name: LegShortSaleExemptionReason
Fields.Description: Indicates the reason a short sale is exempted from applicable regulation (e.g. Reg SHO addendum (b)(1) in the U.S.)

Fields.Name: SideShortSaleExemptionReason
Fields.Description: Indicates the reason a short sale is exempted from applicable regulation (e.g. Reg SHO addendum (b)(1) in the U.S.)

Fields.Name: PartyDetailID
Fields.Description: Party identifier within Parties Reference Data messages.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailIDSource
Fields.Description: Source of the identifier of the PartyDetailID(1691) specified.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type or role of PartyDetailID(1691) specified.

Fields.Name: NoPartyDetailSubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of party detail sub-identifiers.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailSubID
Fields.Description: Sub-identifier for the party specified in PartyDetailID(1691).

Fields.Name: PartyDetailSubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of PartyDetailSubID(1695) value.

Fields.Name: EncodedOptionExpirationDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the OptionExpirationDesc(1581) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the OptionExpirationDesc(1581).

Fields.Name: StrikeUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Used to express the unit of measure (UOM) of the price if different from the contract.

Fields.Name: AccountSummaryReportID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the AccountSummaryReport(35=CQ).

Fields.Name: NoSettlementAmounts
Fields.Description: Number of settlement amount entries.

Fields.Name: SettlementAmount
Fields.Description: The amount of settlement.

Fields.Name: SettlementAmountCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the reported settlement amount.

Fields.Name: NoCollateralAmounts
Fields.Description: Number of collateral amount entries.

Fields.Name: CurrentCollateralAmount
Fields.Description: Currency value currently attributed to the collateral.

Fields.Name: CollateralCurrency
Fields.Description: Currency of the collateral; optional, defaults to the Settlement Currency if not specified.

Fields.Name: CollateralType
Fields.Description: Type of collateral on deposit being reported.

Fields.Name: NoPayCollects
Fields.Description: Number of pay collect entries.

Fields.Name: PayCollectType
Fields.Description: Category describing the reason for funds paid to, or the funds collected from the clearing firm.

Fields.Name: PayCollectCurrency
Fields.Description: Currency denomination of value in PayAmount(1710) and CollectAmount(1711). If not specified, default to currency specified in SettlementAmountCurrency(1702).

Fields.Name: PayAmount
Fields.Description: Amount to be paid by the clearinghouse to the clearing firm.

Fields.Name: CollectAmount
Fields.Description: Amount to be collected by the clearinghouse from the clearing firm.

Fields.Name: PayCollectMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment associated with the pay collect amount.

Fields.Name: PayCollectMarketID
Fields.Description: Market associated with the pay collect amount.

Fields.Name: MarginAmountMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment associated with the margin amount.

Fields.Name: MarginAmountMarketID
Fields.Description: Market associated with the margin amount

Fields.Name: UnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when UnitOfMeasure(996) = Ccy

Fields.Name: PriceUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the price unit of measure. Conditionally required when PriceUnitOfMeasure(1191) = Ccy

Fields.Name: UnderlyingUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the underlying unit of measure. Conditionally required when UnderlyingUnitOfMeasure(998) = Ccy

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPriceUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the underlying price unit of measure. Conditionally required when UnderlyingPriceUnitOfMeasure(1424) = Ccy

Fields.Name: LegUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when LegUnitOfMeasure(999) = Ccy

Fields.Name: LegPriceUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the price unit of measure. Conditionally required when LegPriceUnitOfMeasure(1421) = Ccy

Fields.Name: DerivativeUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when DerivativeUnitOfMeasure(1269) = Ccy

Fields.Name: DerivativePriceUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the price unit of measure. Conditionally required when DerivativePriceUnitOfMeasure(1315) = Ccy

Fields.Name: OrderOrigination
Fields.Description: Identifies the origin of the order.

Fields.Name: OriginatingDeptID
Fields.Description: An identifier representing the department or desk within the firm that originated the order.

Fields.Name: ReceivingDeptID
Fields.Description: An identifier representing the department or desk within the firm that received the order.

Fields.Name: InformationBarrierID
Fields.Description: The identifier of the information barrier in place for a trading unit that will meet the criteria of the "no-knowledge" exception in FINRA Rule 5320.02.

Fields.Name: FirmGroupID
Fields.Description: Firm assigned group allocation entity identifier.

Fields.Name: FirmMnemonic
Fields.Description: Allocation identifier assigned by the Firm submitting the allocation for an individual allocation instruction (as opposed to the overall message level identifier).

Fields.Name: AllocGroupID
Fields.Description: Intended to be used by a central counterparty to assign an identifier to allocations of trades for the same instrument traded at the same price.

Fields.Name: AvgPxGroupID
Fields.Description: Used by submitting firm to group trades being allocated into an average price group. The trades in average price group will be used to calculate an average price for the group.

Fields.Name: FirmAllocText
Fields.Description: Firm reference information, usually internal information, that is part of the initial message. The information would not be carried forward (e.g to Take-up Firm) and preserved with the transaction.

Fields.Name: EncodedFirmAllocTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedFirmAllocText(1734) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedFirmAllocText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the FirmAllocText(1732) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) represention should also be specified in FirmAllocText(1732) field.

Fields.Name: AllocationRollupInstruction
Fields.Description: An indicator to override the normal procedure to roll up allocations for the same take-up firm.

Fields.Name: AllocGroupQuantity
Fields.Description: Indicates the total quantity of an allocation group. Includes any allocated quantity.

Fields.Name: AllocGroupRemainingQuantity
Fields.Description: Indicates the remaining quantity of an allocation group that has not yet been allocated.

Fields.Name: AllocReversalStatus
Fields.Description: Identifies the status of a reversal transaction.

Fields.Name: ObligationType
Fields.Description: Type of reference obligation for credit derivatives contracts.

Fields.Name: TradePriceNegotiationMethod
Fields.Description: Method used for negotiation of contract price.

Fields.Name: UpfrontPriceType
Fields.Description: Type of price used to determine upfront payment for swaps contracts.

Fields.Name: UpfrontPrice
Fields.Description: Price used to determine upfront payment for swaps contracts.

Fields.Name: LastUpfrontPrice
Fields.Description: Price used to determine upfront payment for swaps contracts reported for a deal (trade).

Fields.Name: ApplLevelRecoveryIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether application level recovery is needed.

Fields.Name: BidMDEntryID
Fields.Description: The market data entry identifier of the bid side of a quote

Fields.Name: OfferMDEntryID
Fields.Description: The market data entry identifier of the offer side of a quote.

Fields.Name: BidQuoteID
Fields.Description: Marketplace assigned quote identifier for the bid side. Can be used to indicate priority.

Fields.Name: OfferQuoteID
Fields.Description: Marketplace assigned quote identifier for the offer side. Can be used to indicate priority.

Fields.Name: TotalBidSize
Fields.Description: Specifies the total bid size.

Fields.Name: TotalOfferSize
Fields.Description: Specifies the total offer size.

Fields.Name: SecondaryQuoteID
Fields.Description: Assigned by the party which accepts the quote. Can be used to provide the quote identifier assigned by an exchange, marketplace or executing system.

Fields.Name: CustodialLotID
Fields.Description: An opaque identifier used to communicate the custodian’s identifier for the lot. It is expected that this information would be provided by the custodian as part of a reconciliation process that occurs before trading.

Fields.Name: VersusPurchaseDate
Fields.Description: The effective acquisition date of the lot that would be used for gain-loss trade lot reporting. The versus purchase date used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available.

Fields.Name: VersusPurchasePrice
Fields.Description: The versus purchase price used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available. The value should be calculated based on current cost basis / quantity held.

Fields.Name: CurrentCostBasis
Fields.Description: The amount that the current shares are worth. If this lot was liquidated, the total gain/loss for a trade is equal to the trade amount minus the current cost basis.

Fields.Name: LegCustodialLotID
Fields.Description: An opaque identifier used to communicate the custodian’s identifier for the lot. It is expected that this information would be provided by the custodian as part of a reconciliation process that occurs before trading.

Fields.Name: LegVersusPurchaseDate
Fields.Description: The effective acquisition date of the lot that would be used for gain-loss trade lot reporting. The versus purchase date used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available.

Fields.Name: LegVersusPurchasePrice
Fields.Description: The versus purchase price used to identify the lot in situations where a custodial lot identifier is not available.The value should be calculated based on current cost basis / quantity held.

Fields.Name: LegCurrentCostBasis
Fields.Description: The amount that the current shares are worth. If this lot was liquidated, the total gain/loss for a trade is equal to the trade amount minus the current cost basis.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitRequestType
Fields.Description: Type of risk limit information.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitRequestResult
Fields.Description: Result of risk limit definition request.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Status of risk limit definition request.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitStatus
Fields.Description: Status of risk limit definition for one party.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitResult
Fields.Description: Result of risk limit definition for one party.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitUtilizationPercent
Fields.Description: Percentage of utilization of a party's set risk limit.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitUtilizationAmount
Fields.Description: Absolute amount of utilization of a party's set risk limit.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitAction
Fields.Description: Identifies the action to take or risk model to assume should risk limit be exceeded or breached for the specified party.

Fields.Name: RiskWarningLevelAmount
Fields.Description: Amount at which a warning is issued.

Fields.Name: RiskWarningLevelAction
Fields.Description: Action to take should warning level be exceeded.

Fields.Name: EntitlementRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for PartyEntitlementsRequest(35=CU).

Fields.Name: EntitlementReportID
Fields.Description: Identifier for the PartyEntitlementsReport(35=CV).

Fields.Name: NoPartyEntitlements
Fields.Description: Number of party entitlement values.

Fields.Name: NoEntitlements
Fields.Description: Number of entitlement values.

Fields.Name: EntitlementIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate if a party is entitled to an entitlement type specified in the EntitlementType(1775) field.

Fields.Name: EntitlementType
Fields.Description: Type of entitlement.

Fields.Name: EntitlementID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for a specific NoEntitlements(1773) repeating group instance.

Fields.Name: NoEntitlementAttrib
Fields.Description: Number of entitlement attributes.

Fields.Name: EntitlementAttribType
Fields.Description: Name of the entitlement attribute type. A code list of allowed values will be maintained on the FIX Protocol website. Values "4000" and above are reserved for bilaterally agreed upon user defined enumerations.

Fields.Name: EntitlementAttribDatatype
Fields.Description: Datatype of the entitlement attribute.

Fields.Name: EntitlementAttribValue
Fields.Description: Value of the entitlement attribute.

Fields.Name: EntitlementAttribCurrency
Fields.Description: Currency for EntitlementAttribValue(1780). Can be used if these fields represent a price, price offset, or amount.

Fields.Name: EntitlementStartDate
Fields.Description: Indicates the starting date of the entitlement.

Fields.Name: EntitlementEndDate
Fields.Description: Indicates the ending date of the entitlement.

Fields.Name: EntitlementPlatform
Fields.Description: The area to which the entitlement is applicable. This can be a trading platform or an offering.

Fields.Name: TradSesControl
Fields.Description: Indicates how control of trading session and subsession transitions are performed.

Fields.Name: TradeVolType
Fields.Description: Define the type of trade volume applicable for the MinTradeVol(562) and MaxTradeVol(1140)

Fields.Name: RefTickTableID
Fields.Description: Spread table code referred by the security or symbol.

Fields.Name: LegID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the leg within the context of a message (the scope of uniqueness to be defined by counterparty agreement). The LegID(1788) can be referenced using LegRefID(654).

Fields.Name: NoTargetMarketSegments
Fields.Description: Number of market segments upon which a mass action is to be taken.

Fields.Name: TargetMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment within a target market segment repeating group.

Fields.Name: NoAffectedMarketSegments
Fields.Description: Number of market segments affected by a mass action.

Fields.Name: AffectedMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment within an affected market repeating segment group.

Fields.Name: NoNotAffectedMarketSegments
Fields.Description: Number of market segments left unaffected by a mass action.

Fields.Name: NotAffectedMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment within an unaffected market repeating segment group.

Fields.Name: NoOrderEvents
Fields.Description: Number of order events.

Fields.Name: OrderEventType
Fields.Description: The type of event affecting an order. The last event type within the OrderEventGrp component indicates the ExecType(150) value resulting from the series of events (ExecType(150) values are shown in brackets).

Fields.Name: OrderEventExecID
Fields.Description: Refer to ExecID(17). Used when multiple different events are reported in single Execution Report. ExecID(17) and OrderEventExecID(1797) values should not overlap.

Fields.Name: OrderEventReason
Fields.Description: Action that caused the event to occur.

Fields.Name: OrderEventPx
Fields.Description: Price associated with the event.

Fields.Name: OrderEventQty
Fields.Description: Quantity associated with the event.

Fields.Name: OrderEventLiquidityIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrderEventType(1796) values of 4(Partially Filled) or 5(Filled).

Fields.Name: OrderEventText
Fields.Description: Additional information about the event.

Fields.Name: AuctionType
Fields.Description: Type of auction order.

Fields.Name: AuctionAllocationPct
Fields.Description: Percentage of matched quantity to be allocated to the submitter of the response to an auction order.

Fields.Name: AuctionInstruction
Fields.Description: Instruction related to system generated auctions, e.g. flash order auctions.

Fields.Name: RefClOrdID
Fields.Description: Used to reference an order via ClOrdID(11).

Fields.Name: LockType
Fields.Description: Indicates whether an order is locked and for what reason.

Fields.Name: LockedQty
Fields.Description: Locked order quantity.

Fields.Name: SecondaryLockedQty
Fields.Description: Locked order quantity in addition to LockedQty (1808), e.g. to distinguish total locked quantity from currently locked quantity.

Fields.Name: ReleaseInstruction
Fields.Description: Instruction to define conditions under which to release a locked order or parts of it.

Fields.Name: ReleaseQty
Fields.Description: Quantity to be made available, i.e. released from a lock.

Fields.Name: NoDisclosureInstructions
Fields.Description: Number of disclosure instructions.

Fields.Name: DisclosureType
Fields.Description: Information subject to disclosure.

Fields.Name: DisclosureInstruction
Fields.Description: Instruction to disclose information or to use default value of the receiver.

Fields.Name: TradingCapacity
Fields.Description: Designates the capacity in which the order is submitted for trading by the market participant.

Fields.Name: ClearingAccountType
Fields.Description: Designates the account type to be used for the order when submitted to clearing.

Fields.Name: LegClearingAccountType
Fields.Description: Designates the capacity in which the order will be submitted to clearing.

Fields.Name: TargetPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Qualifies the value of TargetPartyRole (1464).

Fields.Name: RelatedHighPrice
Fields.Description: Upper boundary for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order.

Fields.Name: RelatedLowPrice
Fields.Description: Lower boundary for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order.

Fields.Name: RelatedPriceSource
Fields.Description: Source for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order. Can be used together with RelatedHighPrice (1819) and/or RelatedLowPrice (1820).

Fields.Name: MinQtyMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates how the minimum quantity should be applied when executing the order.

Fields.Name: Triggered
Fields.Description: Indicates whether order has been triggered during its lifetime. Applies to cases where original information, e.g. OrdType(40), is modified when the order is triggered.

Fields.Name: AffectedOrigClOrdID
Fields.Description: OrigClOrdID(41) of an order affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

Fields.Name: NotAffSecondaryOrderID
Fields.Description: SecondaryOrderID (198) of an order not affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

Fields.Name: EventTimePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the event.

Fields.Name: EventTimeUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the event.

Fields.Name: LastQtyVariance
Fields.Description: When LastQty is an estimated value, e.g. for a Repo “circled” trade, LastQtyVariance specifies the absolute amount that the size may vary up or down when finalized. Omitted when LastQty(32) is already final.

Fields.Name: NoCrossLegs
Fields.Description: Number of legs in the side of a cross order.

Fields.Name: SettlPriceIncrement
Fields.Description: Settlement price increment for stated price range.

Fields.Name: SettlPriceSecondaryIncrement
Fields.Description: Secondary settlement price increment for stated price range. The meaning of secondary is left to bilateral agreement, e.g. it may refer to final settlement for a contract.

Fields.Name: ClearedIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the trade or position being reported was cleared through a clearing organization.

Fields.Name: ContractRefPosType
Fields.Description: Additional information related to the pricing of a commodity swaps position, specifically an indicator referring to the position type.

Fields.Name: PositionCapacity
Fields.Description: Used to describe the ownership of the position.

Fields.Name: PosQtyUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure if position quantity is expressed in valuation rather than contracts. Conditionally required when PosQtyUnitOfMeasure(1836)=Ccy.

Fields.Name: PosQtyUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Indicates the unit of measure of the position quantity when not expressed in contracts.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingContractPriceRefMonth
Fields.Description: Reference month if there is no applicable UnderlyingMaturityMonth(313) value for the contract or security.

Fields.Name: NoTradePriceConditions
Fields.Description: Number of trade price conditions.

Fields.Name: TradePriceCondition
Fields.Description: Price conditions in effect at the time of the trade. Multiple price conditions can be in effect at the same time. Price conditions are usually required to be reported in markets that have regulations on price execution at a market or national best bid or offer, and the trade price differs from the best bid or offer.

Fields.Name: TradeAllocStatus
Fields.Description: Identifies the status of an allocation when using a pre-clear workflow.
Fields.Elaboration: Note: This is different from the give-up process where a trade is cleared and then given up and goes through the allocation flow.

Fields.Name: NoTradeQtys
Fields.Description: Number of trade quantities.

Fields.Name: TradeQtyType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of trade quantity in TradeQty(1843).

Fields.Name: TradeQty
Fields.Description: Trade quantity.

Fields.Name: NoTradeAllocAmts
Fields.Description: Number of trade allocation amount entries.

Fields.Name: TradeAllocAmtType
Fields.Description: Type of the amount associated with a trade allocation.

Fields.Name: TradeAllocAmt
Fields.Description: The amount associated with a trade allocation.

Fields.Name: TradeAllocCurrency
Fields.Description: Currency denomination of the trade allocation amount.

Fields.Name: TradeAllocGroupInstruction
Fields.Description: Instruction on how to add a trade to an allocation group when it is being given-up.

Fields.Name: OffsetInstruction
Fields.Description: Indicates the trade is a result of an offset or onset.

Fields.Name: TradeAllocAmtReason
Fields.Description: Specifies the reason for an amount type when reported on an allocation. Useful when multiple instances of the same amount type are reported.

Fields.Name: StrategyLinkID
Fields.Description: Identifies the multileg strategy (e.g. spread) to which the trade belongs. This links together trade legs executed as part of a strategy during a single match event.

Fields.Name: SideAvgPx
Fields.Description: Calculated average price for this side of the trade.

Fields.Name: SideAvgPxIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate whether a trade or a sub-allocation should be allocated at the trade price (e.g. no average pricing), or whether it should be grouped with other trades/sub-allocations and allocated at the average price of the group.

Fields.Name: SideAvgPxGroupID
Fields.Description: The identifier for the average price group for the trade side. See also AvgPxGroupID(1731).

Fields.Name: NoRelatedTrades
Fields.Description: Number of related trades.

Fields.Name: RelatedTradeID
Fields.Description: Identifier of a related trade.

Fields.Name: RelatedTradeIDSource
Fields.Description: Describes the source of the identifier that RelatedTradeID(1856) represents.

Fields.Name: RelatedTradeDate
Fields.Description: Date of a related trade.

Fields.Name: RelatedTradeMarketID
Fields.Description: Market of execution of related trade.

Fields.Name: RelatedTradeQuantity
Fields.Description: Quantity of the related trade which can be less than or equal to the actual quantity of the related trade. For example, when one trade offsets another across asset classes.

Fields.Name: NoRelatedPositions
Fields.Description: Number of related positions.

Fields.Name: RelatedPositionID
Fields.Description: Identifier of a related position.

Fields.Name: RelatedPositionIDSource
Fields.Description: Describes the source of the identifier that RelatedPositionID(1862) represents.

Fields.Name: RelatedPositionDate
Fields.Description: Used to help identify the position when RelatedPositionID(1862) is not unique across multiple days. This date is generally the creation date of the identifier.

Fields.Name: QuoteAckStatus
Fields.Description: Acknowledgement status of a Quote(35=S) or QuoteCancel(35=Z) message submission.

Fields.Name: StrikeIndex
Fields.Description: Specifies the index used to calculate the strike price.

Fields.Name: OfferID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the ask side of the quote assigned by the quote issuer.

Fields.Name: NoValueChecks
Fields.Description: Number of value check entries.

Fields.Name: ValueCheckType
Fields.Description: Type of value to be checked.

Fields.Name: ValueCheckAction
Fields.Description: Action to be taken for the ValueCheckType(1869).

Fields.Name: LegSecurityXMLLen
Fields.Description: The length of the LegSecurityXML(1872) data block.

Fields.Name: LegSecurityXML
Fields.Description: XML definition for the leg security.

Fields.Name: LegSecurityXMLSchema
Fields.Description: The schema used to validate the contents of LegSecurityXML(1872).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecurityXMLLen
Fields.Description: The length of the UnderlyingSecurityXML(1875) data block.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecurityXML
Fields.Description: XML definition for the underlying security.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecurityXMLSchema
Fields.Description: The schema used to validate the contents of UnderlyingSecurityXML(1875).

Fields.Name: PartyDetailRequestResult
Fields.Description: Result party detail definition request.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Status of party details definition request.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailDefinitionStatus
Fields.Description: Status of party detail definition for one party.

Fields.Name: PartyDetailDefinitionResult
Fields.Description: Result of party detail definition for one party.

Fields.Name: EntitlementRequestResult
Fields.Description: Result of risk limit definition request.

Fields.Name: EntitlementRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Status of party entitlements definition request.

Fields.Name: EntitlementStatus
Fields.Description: Status of entitlement definition for one party.

Fields.Name: EntitlementResult
Fields.Description: Result of entitlement definition for one party.

Fields.Name: EntitlementRefID
Fields.Description: Reference to an EntitlementID(1776). Used for modification or deletion of an entitlement.

Fields.Name: SettlPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Used to express the unit of measure of the settlement price if different from the contract.

Fields.Name: SettlPriceUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the settlement price unit of measure if expressed in another currency than the base currency. Conditionally required when SettlPriceUnitOfMeasure(1886)=Ccy.

Fields.Name: TradeMatchTimestamp
Fields.Description: Timestamp of the match event. For off-exchange trades the time at which the deal was matched by the exchange. This timestamp will be the same on all the trades and will not change when a trade is modified.

Fields.Name: NoInstrmtMatchSides
Fields.Description: Number of instrument match sides.

Fields.Name: NoTrdMatchSides
Fields.Description: Number of trade match sides.

Fields.Name: TrdMatchSubID
Fields.Description: Used to identify each price level, step or clip within a match event.
Fields.Elaboration: The identifier may represent a grouping of matched resting orders at a given price level that was matched by an aggressor order. For example, an aggressive order sweeping through 2 price levels that included 3 resting orders would have two different TrdMatchSubID(1891) values.

Fields.Name: NoLegExecs
Fields.Description: Number of instrument leg executions.

Fields.Name: LegExecID
Fields.Description: The ExecID(17) value corresponding to a trade leg.

Fields.Name: LegTradeID
Fields.Description: The TradeID(1003) value corresponding to a trade leg.

Fields.Name: LegTradeReportID
Fields.Description: The TradeReportID(571) value corresponding to a trade leg.

Fields.Name: TradeMatchAckStatus
Fields.Description: Used to indicate the status of the trade match report submission.

Fields.Name: TradeMatchRejectReason
Fields.Description: Reason the trade match report submission was rejected.

Fields.Name: SideMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Identifies the market segment of the side.

Fields.Name: SideVenueType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of venue where the trade was executed for the side.

Fields.Name: SideExecRefID
Fields.Description: Used to reference the value from SideExecID(1427).

Fields.Name: LegExecRefID
Fields.Description: Used to reference the value from LegExecID(1893).

Fields.Name: HaircutIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates, if "Y", that a stated valuation includes a haircut, e.g. that the stated value reflects the subtraction of the haircut. Note that a value of "N" does not imply a haircut is not applicable, only that the haircut (if any) is not reflected in the stated valuation.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryTradeID
Fields.Description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryTradeIDEvent
Fields.Description: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

Fields.Name: RegulatoryTradeIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entitiy identifier may be assigned by a regulator.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryTradeIDType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). Contextual hierarchy of events for the same trade or transaction maybe captured through use of the different RegulatoryTradeIDType(1906) values using multiple instances of the repeating group as needed for regulatory reporting.

Fields.Name: NoRegulatoryTradeIDs
Fields.Description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: NoAllocRegulatoryTradeIDs
Fields.Description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: AllocRegulatoryTradeID
Fields.Description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

Fields.Name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator.

Fields.Name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDEvent
Fields.Description: Identifies the event which caused the origination of the identifier in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2(Clearing).

Fields.Name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

Fields.Name: NumOfCompetitors
Fields.Description: The number of competing Respondents (e.g. dealers) to receive a quote request (either via the QuoteRequest(35=R) or via other means).

Fields.Name: ResponseTime
Fields.Description: The time by which a meaningful response should arrive back (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT").
Fields.Elaboration: The meaning of the response time is specific to the context where the field is used. For a QuoteRequest(35=R) message, this is the time by which the Quote(35=S) message should arrive to the initiator of the QuoteRequest(35=R) message.

Fields.Name: QuoteDisplayTime
Fields.Description: Time by which the quote will be displayed.
Fields.Elaboration: For example, the time the execution venue will display dealer(s) submitted quotes to market participant(s).

Fields.Name: ExposureDurationUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit in which the ExposureDuration(1629) is expressed.

Fields.Name: CoverPrice
Fields.Description: The best quoted price received among those not traded.

Fields.Name: NoClearingAccountTypes
Fields.Description: Number of clearing account type entries.

Fields.Name: NoPriceMovements
Fields.Description: Number of price movement entries.

Fields.Name: NoPriceMovementValues
Fields.Description: Number of price movement value entries.

Fields.Name: PriceMovementValue
Fields.Description: Value at specific price movement point.

Fields.Name: PriceMovementPoint
Fields.Description: Price movement point up (positive integer) or down (negative integer) relative to the underlying price of the instrument.

Fields.Name: PriceMovementType
Fields.Description: Describes the format of the PriceMovementValue(1921).

Fields.Name: ClearingIntention
Fields.Description: Specifies the party's or parties' intention to clear the trade.

Fields.Name: TradeClearingInstruction
Fields.Description: Specifies the eligibility of this trade for clearing and central counterparty processing.

Fields.Name: BackloadedTradeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates that the trade being reported occurred in the past and is still in effect or active.

Fields.Name: ConfirmationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how a trade was confirmed.

Fields.Name: MandatoryClearingIndicator
Fields.Description: An indication that the trade is flagged for mandatory clearing.

Fields.Name: MixedSwapIndicator
Fields.Description: An indication that the trade is a mixed swap.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of CFTC , a "Mixed swap" is defined in the Commodity Exchange Act (CEA) section 1a(47)(D) as an instrument that is in part a swap subject to the jurisdiction of the CFTC, and in part a security-based swap subject to the jurisdiction of the SEC. When reporting the additional Swap Data Repositories must be identified in the appropriate Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 102 (Data repository), PartyRoleQualifier(2376) = 12 (Additional domestic trade repository) and PartySub-IDType(803) = 70 (Location or jurisdiction).

Fields.Name: OffMarketPriceIndicator
Fields.Description: An indication that the price is off-market.

Fields.Name: VerificationMethod
Fields.Description: Indication of how a trade was verified.

Fields.Name: ClearingRequirementException
Fields.Description: Specifies whether a party to a swap is using an exception to a clearing requirement. In the US, one such clearing requirement is CFTC's rule pursuant to CEA Section 2(h)(1).

Fields.Name: IRSDirection
Fields.Description: Used to specify whether the principal is paying or receiving the fixed rate in an interest rate swap.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryReportType
Fields.Description: Type of regulatory report.

Fields.Name: VoluntaryRegulatoryReport
Fields.Description: Used in conjunction with RegulatoryReportType(1934) to indicate whether the trade report is a voluntary regulatory report. If not specified, the default for a regulatory report is "N". When VoluntaryRegulatoryReport(1935)=Y it is recommended that one of the parties to the trade be identified as the voluntary reporting party through PartySubIDType(803) = 63 (Voluntary reporting entity).

Fields.Name: TradeCollateralization
Fields.Description: Specifies how the trade is collateralized.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of Dodd-Frank, all values shown except for 4 (Net exposure) apply. In the context of ESMA EU SFTR reporting only the values 1 (Uncollateralized), 3 (Fully collateralized) and 4 (Net exposure) apply.

Fields.Name: TradeContinuation
Fields.Description: Specifies the post-execution trade continuation or lifecycle event. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

Fields.Name: AssetClass
Fields.Description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

Fields.Name: AssetSubClass
Fields.Description: The subcategory description of the asset class.

Fields.Name: AssetType
Fields.Description: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in AssetSubClass(1939). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetType for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II's this may indicate the value needed in ESMA RTS 2 Annex IV Table 2 Field 16, or ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2 'Sub product' field.

Fields.Name: SwapClass
Fields.Description: The classification or type of swap. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

Fields.Name: NthToDefault
Fields.Description: The Nth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. If specified without MthToDefault(1943) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If MthToDefault(1943) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

Fields.Name: MthToDefault
Fields.Description: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When NthToDefault(1942) and MthToDefault(1943) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

Fields.Name: SettledEntityMatrixSource
Fields.Description: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

Fields.Name: SettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
Fields.Description: The publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. If not specified, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

Fields.Name: CouponType
Fields.Description: Coupon type of the bond.

Fields.Name: TotalIssuedAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued securities.

Fields.Name: CouponFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: CouponFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: CouponDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security. Absence of this field for a bond or an interest bearing security transaction implies a "flat" trade, i.e. no accrued interest determined at time of the transaction.

Fields.Name: ConvertibleBondEquityID
Fields.Description: Identifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted to.

Fields.Name: ConvertibleBondEquityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies class or source of the ConvertibleBondEquityID(1951) value. 100+ are reserved for private security.

Fields.Name: ContractPriceRefMonth
Fields.Description: Reference month if there is no applicable MaturityMonthYear(200) value for the contract or security.

Fields.Name: LienSeniority
Fields.Description: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

Fields.Name: LoanFacility
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

Fields.Name: ReferenceEntityType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.

Fields.Name: IndexSeries
Fields.Description: The series identifier of a credit default swap index.

Fields.Name: IndexAnnexVersion
Fields.Description: The version of a credit default swap index annex.

Fields.Name: IndexAnnexDate
Fields.Description: The date of a credit default swap index series annex.

Fields.Name: IndexAnnexSource
Fields.Description: The source of a credit default swap series annex.

Fields.Name: AgreementVersion
Fields.Description: The version of the master agreement

Fields.Name: MasterConfirmationDesc
Fields.Description: The type of master confirmation executed between the parties. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-type for values.

Fields.Name: MasterConfirmationDate
Fields.Description: Alternative to broker confirmation. The date of the confirmation executed between the parties and intended to govern all relevant transactions between those parties.

Fields.Name: MasterConfirmationAnnexDesc
Fields.Description: The type of master confirmation annex executed between the parties. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-annex-type for values.

Fields.Name: MasterConfirmationAnnexDate
Fields.Description: The date that an annex to the master confirmation was executed between the parties.

Fields.Name: BrokerConfirmationDesc
Fields.Description: Describes the type of broker confirmation executed between the parites. Can be used as an alterative to MasterConfirmationDesc(1962). See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/broker-confirmation-type for values.

Fields.Name: CreditSupportAgreementDesc
Fields.Description: The type of ISDA Credit Support Agreement. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-support-agreement-type for values.

Fields.Name: CreditSupportAgreementDate
Fields.Description: The date of the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties and intended to govern collateral arrangements for all OTC derivatives transactions between those parties.

Fields.Name: CreditSupportAgreementID
Fields.Description: A common reference or unique identifier to identify the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties.

Fields.Name: GoverningLaw
Fields.Description: Identification of the law governing the transaction. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/governing-law for values.

Fields.Name: NoSideRegulatoryTradeIDs
Fields.Description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: SideRegulatoryTradeID
Fields.Description: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organziations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifier (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

Fields.Name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator.

Fields.Name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDEvent
Fields.Description: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

Fields.Name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

Fields.Name: NoSecondaryAssetClasses
Fields.Description: Number of secondary asset classes in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: SecondaryAssetClass
Fields.Description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure for a multi-asset trade.

Fields.Name: SecondaryAssetSubClass
Fields.Description: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

Fields.Name: SecondaryAssetType
Fields.Description: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in SecondaryAssetSubClass(1978). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetType for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II's this may indicate the value needed in ESMA RTS 2 Annex IV Table 2 Field 16, or ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2 'Sub product' field.

Fields.Name: BlockTrdAllocIndicator
Fields.Description: Indication that a block trade will be allocated.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingEvents
Fields.Description: Number of events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventType
Fields.Description: Code to represent the type of event.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventDate
Fields.Description: The date of the event.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventTime
Fields.Description: The time of the event. To be used in combination with UnderlyingEventDate(1983).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventTimeUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the event.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventTimePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the event.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventPx
Fields.Description: Predetermined price of issue at event, if applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingConstituentWeight
Fields.Description: For a basket, or pool, describes the weight of each of the constituents within the basket. If not provided, it is assumed to be equal weighted.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCouponType
Fields.Description: Specifies the coupon type of the underlying bond.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingTotalIssuedAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued security.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCouponFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCouponFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCouponDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingObligationID
Fields.Description: For a CDS basket or pool identifies the reference obligation.
Fields.Elaboration: UnderlyingObligationID(1994) is reserved for the reference entity for baskets or pools. In a CDS single name the reference entity is identified in insrument ID and the obligations are identified in UnderlyingObligationID(1994).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingObligationIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source scheme of the UnderlyingObligationID(1994).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEquityID
Fields.Description: Specifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEquityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of the UnderlyingEquityID(1996).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLienSeniority
Fields.Description: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLoanFacility
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingReferenceEntityType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.

Fields.Name: StrikeIndexSpread
Fields.Description: Specifies the strike price offset from the named index.

Fields.Name: ValuationSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the source of trade valuation data.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingIndexSeries
Fields.Description: The series identifier of a credit default swap index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingIndexAnnexVersion
Fields.Description: The version identifier of a credit default swap index annex.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingIndexAnnexDate
Fields.Description: The date of a credit default swap index series annex.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingIndexAnnexSource
Fields.Description: The source of a credit default swap index series annex.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProductComplex
Fields.Description: Identifies an entire suite of products for a given market. In Futures this may be "interest rates", "agricultural", "equity indexes", etc

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecurityGroup
Fields.Description: An exchange specific name assigned to a group of related securities which may be concurrently affected by market events and actions.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettleOnOpenFlag
Fields.Description: Indicator to determine if Instrument is Settle on Open.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssignmentMethod
Fields.Description: Method under which assignment was conducted

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecurityStatus
Fields.Description: Gives the current state of the instrument

Fields.Name: UnderlyingObligationType
Fields.Description: Type of reference obligation for credit derivatives contracts.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetClass
Fields.Description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetSubClass
Fields.Description: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetType
Fields.Description: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingAssetSubClass(2082). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetType for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II's this may indicate the value needed in ESMA RTS 2 Annex IV Table 2 Field 16, or ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2 'Sub product' field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSwapClass
Fields.Description: The type or classification of swap. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNthToDefault
Fields.Description: The Nth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. If specified without UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMthToDefault
Fields.Description: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When UnderlyingNthToDefault(2017) and UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettledEntityMatrixSource
Fields.Description: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
Fields.Description: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. If not specified, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikeMultiplier
Fields.Description: Used for derivatives. Multiplier applied to the strike price for the purpose of calculating the settlement value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikeValue
Fields.Description: Used for derivatives. The number of shares/units for the financial instrument involved in the option trade.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikePriceDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how the strike price is determined at the point of option exercise. The strike may be fixed throughout the life of the option, set at expiration to the value of the underlying, set to the average value of the underlying , or set to the optimal value of the underlying.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikePriceBoundaryMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the strike price relative to the underlying price at the point of option exercise.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikePriceBoundaryPrecision
Fields.Description: Used in combination with StrikePriceBoundaryMethod(1479) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement
Fields.Description: Minimum price increment for the instrument. Could also be used to represent tick value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMinPriceIncrementAmount
Fields.Description: Minimum price increment amount associated with the UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement(2026). For listed derivatives, the value can be calculated by multiplying UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement(2026) by UnderlyingContractMultiplier(436).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptPayoutType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of valuation method or payout trigger for an in-the-money option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptPayoutAmount
Fields.Description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPriceQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: Method for price quotation.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingValuationMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates type of valuation method used.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingListMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the instruments are pre-listed only or can also be defined via user request.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCapPrice
Fields.Description: Used to express the ceiling price of a capped call.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFloorPrice
Fields.Description: Used to express the floor price of a capped put.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFlexibleIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate if a security has been defined as flexible according to "non-standard" means. Analog to CFICode Standard/Non-standard indicator.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFlexProductEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate if a product or group of product supports the creation of flexible securities.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPositionLimit
Fields.Description: Position limit for the instrument.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNTPositionLimit
Fields.Description: Position Limit in the near-term contract for a given exchange-traded product.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPool
Fields.Description: Identifies the mortgage backed security (MBS) / asset backed security (ABS) pool.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingContractSettlMonth
Fields.Description: Specifies when the contract (i.e. MBS/TBA) will settle. Must be present for MBS/TBA.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDatedDate
Fields.Description: If different from IssueDate()

Fields.Name: UnderlyingInterestAccrualDate
Fields.Description: If different from IssueDate and DatedDate

Fields.Name: UnderlyingShortSaleRestriction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a restriction applies to short selling a security.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingRefTickTableID
Fields.Description: Spread table code referred by the security or symbol.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEvents
Fields.Description: Number of complex events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of complex event.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutAmount
Fields.Description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an event. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPrice
Fields.Description: Specifies the price at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the UnderlyingComplexEventType(2046).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the event price relative to the UnderlyingComplexEventPrice(2048) at the point the complex event outcome takes effect as determined by the UnderlyingComplexEventPriceTimeType(2051).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryPrecision
Fields.Description: Used in combination with UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod(2049) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies when the complex event outcome takes effect. The outcome of a complex event is a payout or barrier action as specified by the UnderlyingComplexEventType(2046).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCondition
Fields.Description:
Specifies the condition between complex events when more than one event is specified.
Multiple barrier events would use an "or" condition since only one can be effective at a given time. A set of digital range events would use an "and" condition since both conditions must be in effect for a payout to result.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventDates
Fields.Description: Number of underlying complex event dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventStartDate
Fields.Description: The start date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options. The start date must always be less than or equal to end date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventEndDate
Fields.Description: The end date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options. UnderlyingComplexEventEndDate(2056) must always be greater than or equal to UnderlyingComplexEventStartDate(2055).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventTimes
Fields.Description: Number of complex event times in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventStartTime
Fields.Description: The start time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective. UnderlyingComplexEventStartTime(2057) must always be less than or equal to UndelryingComplexEventEndTime(2058).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventEndTime
Fields.Description: The end time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective. UnderlyingComplexEventEndTime(2058) must always be greater than or equal to UnderlyingComplexEventStartTime(2057).

Fields.Name: NoLegEvents
Fields.Description: Number of events in the repeating group

Fields.Name: LegEventType
Fields.Description: Code to represent the type of event.

Fields.Name: LegEventDate
Fields.Description: The date of the event.

Fields.Name: LegEventTime
Fields.Description: Specific time of event. To be used in combination with LegEventDate(2061).

Fields.Name: LegEventTimeUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the event.

Fields.Name: LegEventTimePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the event.

Fields.Name: LegEventPx
Fields.Description: Predetermined price of issue at event, if applicable.

Fields.Name: LegEventText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

Fields.Name: LegAssetClass
Fields.Description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

Fields.Name: LegAssetSubClass
Fields.Description: The general subcategory description of the asset class.

Fields.Name: LegAssetType
Fields.Description: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in LegAssetSubClass(2068). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetType for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II's this may indicate the value needed in ESMA RTS 2 Annex IV Table 2 Field 16, or ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2 'Sub product' field.

Fields.Name: LegSwapClass
Fields.Description: Swap type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify comments related to the event.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingEventTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingEventText(2073) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingEventText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingEventText(2071) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingEventText(2071) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegEventTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegEventText(2075) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegEventText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegEventText(2066) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegEventText(2066) field.

Fields.Name: NoLegSecondaryAssetClasses
Fields.Description: Number of secondary asset classes in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegSecondaryAssetClass
Fields.Description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure for a multi-asset trade.

Fields.Name: LegSecondaryAssetSubClass
Fields.Description: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

Fields.Name: LegSecondaryAssetType
Fields.Description: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in LegSecondaryAssetSubClass(2078). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetType for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II's this may indicate the value needed in ESMA RTS 2 Annex IV Table 2 Field 16, or ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2 'Sub product' field.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingSecondaryAssetClasses
Fields.Description: Number of secondary asset classes in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecondaryAssetClass
Fields.Description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure for a multi-asset trade.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecondaryAssetSubClass
Fields.Description: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecondaryAssetType
Fields.Description: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingSecondaryAssetSubClass(2082). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetType for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II's this may indicate the value needed in ESMA RTS 2 Annex IV Table 2 Field 16, or ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2 'Sub product' field.

Fields.Name: PreviousClearingBusinessDate
Fields.Description: The date of the previous clearing business day.

Fields.Name: ValuationDate
Fields.Description: The valuation date of the trade.

Fields.Name: ValuationTime
Fields.Description: The valuation time of the trade.

Fields.Name: ValuationBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center whose calendar is used for valuation, e.g. "GLOB". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: MarginAmtFXRate
Fields.Description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the MarginAmt(1645) from the MarginAmtCcy(1646) and the Currency(15).

Fields.Name: MarginAmtFXRateCalc
Fields.Description: Specifies whether or not MarginAmtFXRate(2088) should be multipled or divided.

Fields.Name: CollateralFXRate
Fields.Description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the CurrentCollateralAmount(1704) from the CollateralCurrency(1646) and the Currency(15).

Fields.Name: CollateralFXRateCalc
Fields.Description: Specifies whether or not CollateralFXRate(2090) should be multipled or divided.

Fields.Name: CollateralAmountMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment associated with the collateral amount.

Fields.Name: CollateralAmountMarketID
Fields.Description: Market associated with the collateral amount.

Fields.Name: PayCollectFXRate
Fields.Description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the PayAmount(1710) or CollectAmount(1711) from the PayCollectCurrency(1709) and the Currency(15).

Fields.Name: PayCollectFXRateCalc
Fields.Description: Specifies whether or not PayCollectFXRate(2094) should be multipled or divided.

Fields.Name: PosAmtStreamDesc
Fields.Description: Corresponds to the value in StreamDesc(40051) in the StreamGrp component.

Fields.Name: PositionFXRate
Fields.Description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the PosAmt(708) from the PositionCurrency(1055) and the Currency (15).

Fields.Name: PositionFXRateCalc
Fields.Description: Specifies whether or not PositionFXRate(2097) should be multipled or divided.

Fields.Name: PosAmtMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment associated with the position amount.

Fields.Name: PosAmtMarketID
Fields.Description: Market associated with the position amount.

Fields.Name: TerminatedIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates if the position has been terminated.

Fields.Name: ShortMarkingExemptIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the originating account is exempt (Y) from marking orders as short or not (N). This designation may be used on both buy and sell orders.

Fields.Name: RelatedRegulatoryTradeIDSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the identifier of the reporting entity as assigned by regulatory agency.

Fields.Name: NoAttachments
Fields.Description: The number of attached files.

Fields.Name: AttachmentName
Fields.Description: Specifies the file name of the attachment.

Fields.Name: AttachmentMediaType
Fields.Description:
The MIME media type (and optional subtype) of the attachment. The values used are those assigned, listed and maintained by IANA (www.iana.org) [RFC2046]. See http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/index.html for available types.
Examples values (RFC number provided for reference here only): "application/pdf" (see [RFC3778]) "application/msword" (for .doc files) "multipart/signed" (see [RFC1847]) "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" (for .docx files)

Fields.Name: AttachmentClassification
Fields.Description:
Specifies semantically the type of the attached document from a business perspective. The default classification scheme reuses the FIX standard classification scheme of a high level section (pretrade, trade, posttrade, etc.) and a category, then a specific application or document type. The expression follows {"section/category/application type"}.
The goal here is to map the attachment into the sections and categories of the FIX business messages if possible. The classification scheme can be expanded or replaced by counterparty agreement. This approach permits the introduction and reference to other business ontologies.
Example: posttrade/confirmation/confirm pretrade//termsheet

Fields.Name: AttachmentExternalURL
Fields.Description: Used to specify an external URL where the attachment can be obtained.

Fields.Name: AttachmentEncodingType
Fields.Description: The encoding type of the content provided in EncodedAttachment(2112).
Fields.Elaboration: MessageEncoding(347) that defines how FIX fields of type Data are encoded. The MessageEncoding(347) is used embed text in another character set (e.g. Unicode or Shift-JIS) within FIX.

Fields.Name: UnencodedAttachmentLen
Fields.Description: Unencoded content length in bytes. Can be used to validate successful unencoding.

Fields.Name: EncodedAttachmentLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded the EncodedAttachment(2112) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedAttachment
Fields.Description: The content of the attachment in the encoding format specified in the AttachmentEncodingType(2109) field.

Fields.Name: NoAttachmentKeywords
Fields.Description: The number of attachment keywords.

Fields.Name: AttachmentKeyword
Fields.Description: Can be used to provide data or keyword tagging of the content of the attachment.

Fields.Name: NegotiationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the negotiation method to be used.

Fields.Name: NextAuctionTime
Fields.Description: The time of the next auction.

Fields.Name: ComplexOptPayoutPaySide
Fields.Description: Trade side of payout payer.

Fields.Name: ComplexOptPayoutReceiveSide
Fields.Description: Trade side of payout receiver.

Fields.Name: ComplexOptPayoutUnderlier
Fields.Description: Reference to the underlier whose payments are being passed through.

Fields.Name: ComplexOptPayoutPercentage
Fields.Description: Percentage of observed price for calculating the payout associated with the event.

Fields.Name: ComplexOptPayoutTime
Fields.Description: Specifies when the payout is to occur.

Fields.Name: ComplexOptPayoutCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the payout amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPricePercentage
Fields.Description: Specifies the price percentage at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the ComplexEventType(1484).

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCurrencyOne
Fields.Description: Specifies the first or only reference currency of the trade. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable for complex FX option strategies.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCurrencyTwo
Fields.Description: Specifies the second reference currencyof the trade. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable for complex FX option strategies.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventQuoteBasis
Fields.Description: For foreign exchange Quanto option feature.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventFixedFXRate
Fields.Description: Specifies the fixed FX rate alternative for FX Quantro options.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the calculation agent.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventStrikePrice
Fields.Description: Upper strike price for Asian option feature. Strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventStrikeFactor
Fields.Description: Strike factor for Asian option feature. Upper strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventStrikeNumberOfOptions
Fields.Description: Upper string number of options for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventsXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to credit event table elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventNotifyingParty
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The local business center for which the credit event is to be determined. The inclusion of this business center implies that Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions is replaced by the local time of the specified business center. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventStandardSources
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', indicates that ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventMinimumSources
Fields.Description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this complex event for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to a complex event elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: ValuationReferenceModel
Fields.Description: Specifies the methodology and/or assumptions used to generate the trade value.

Fields.Name: StrategyType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of trade strategy.

Fields.Name: CommonPricingIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that common pricing applies. Common pricing may be relevant for a transaction that references more than one commodity reference price.

Fields.Name: SettlDisruptionProvision
Fields.Description: Specifies the consequences of bullion settlement disruption events.

Fields.Name: InstrumentRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction if not overridden elsewhere.

Fields.Name: InstrumentRoundingPrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: LegSettleOnOpenFlag
Fields.Description: Indicator to determine if the instrument is to settle on open.

Fields.Name: LegInstrmtAssignmentMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method under which assignment was conducted.

Fields.Name: LegSecurityStatus
Fields.Description: Used for derivatives. Denotes the current state of the InstrumentLeg.

Fields.Name: LegRestructuringType
Fields.Description: A category of CDS credit event in which the underlying bond experiences a restructuring. Used to define a CDS instrument.

Fields.Name: LegSeniority
Fields.Description: Specifies which issue (underlying bond) will receive payment priority in the event of a default. Used to define a CDS instrument.

Fields.Name: LegNotionalPercentageOutstanding
Fields.Description: Indicates the notional percentage of the deal that is still outstanding based on the remaining components of the index. Used to calculate the true value of a CDS trade or position.

Fields.Name: LegOriginalNotionalPercentageOutstanding
Fields.Description: Used to reflect the Original value prior to the application of a credit event. See LegNotionalPercentageOutstanding(2151).

Fields.Name: LegAttachmentPoint
Fields.Description: Lower bound percentage of the loss that the tranche can endure.

Fields.Name: LegDetachmentPoint
Fields.Description: Upper bound percentage of the loss the tranche can endure.

Fields.Name: LegObligationType
Fields.Description: Type of reference obligation for credit derivatives contracts.

Fields.Name: LegSwapSubClass
Fields.Description: The sub-classification or notional schedule type of the swap.

Fields.Name: LegNthToDefault
Fields.Description: The Nth reference obligation in a CDS reference basket. If specified without LegMthToDefault(2158) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If LegMthToDefault(2158) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

Fields.Name: LegMthToDefault
Fields.Description: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When an NthToDefault(2157) to MthToDefault(2158) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

Fields.Name: LegSettledEntityMatrixSource
Fields.Description: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

Fields.Name: LegSettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
Fields.Description: The publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. When this element is omitted, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

Fields.Name: LegCouponType
Fields.Description: Specifies the coupon type of the bond.

Fields.Name: LegTotalIssuedAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued security.

Fields.Name: LegCouponFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: LegCouponFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: LegCouponDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

Fields.Name: LegConvertibleBondEquityID
Fields.Description: Identifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted to.

Fields.Name: LegConvertibleBondEquityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies class or source of the LegConvertibleBondEquitySecurityID(2166) value.

Fields.Name: LegContractPriceRefMonth
Fields.Description: Reference month if there is no applicable LegMaturityMonthYear(610) value for the contract or security.

Fields.Name: LegLienSeniority
Fields.Description: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

Fields.Name: LegLoanFacility
