Fields.Description: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

Fields.Name: LegReferenceEntityType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.

Fields.Name: LegIndexSeries
Fields.Description: The series identifier of a credit default swap index.

Fields.Name: LegIndexAnnexVersion
Fields.Description: The version of a credit default swap index annex.

Fields.Name: LegIndexAnnexDate
Fields.Description: The date of a credit default swap index series annex.

Fields.Name: LegIndexAnnexSource
Fields.Description: The source of a credit default swap series annex.

Fields.Name: LegSettlRateIndex
Fields.Description: In an outright or forward commodity trade that is cash settled this is the index used to determine the cash payment.

Fields.Name: LegSettlRateIndexLocation
Fields.Description: This is an optional qualifying attribute of LegSettlementRateIndex(2176) such as the delivery zone for an electricity contract.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExpirationDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the option expiration.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegOptionExpirationDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegOptionExpirationDesc(2180) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegOptionExpirationDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegOptionExpirationDesc(2178) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegOptionExpirationDesc(2178).

Fields.Name: LegStrikeMultiplier
Fields.Description: Used for derivatives. Multiplier applied to the strike price for the purpose of calculating the settlement value.

Fields.Name: LegStrikeValue
Fields.Description: The number of shares/units for the financial instrument involved in the option trade. Used for derivatives.

Fields.Name: LegStrikeUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Used to express the unit of measure (UOM) of the price if different from the contract.

Fields.Name: LegStrikeIndex
Fields.Description: Specifies the index used to calculate the strike price.

Fields.Name: LegStrikeIndexSpread
Fields.Description: Specifies the strike price offset from the named index.

Fields.Name: LegStrikePriceDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how the strike price is determined at the point of option exercise. The strike may be fixed throughout the life of the option, set at expiration to the value of the underlying, set to the average value of the underlying , or set to the optimal value of the underlying.

Fields.Name: LegStrikePriceBoundaryMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the strike price relative to the underlying price at the point of option exercise.

Fields.Name: LegStrikePriceBoundaryPrecision
Fields.Description: Used in combination with StrikePriceBoundaryMethod(2187) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

Fields.Name: LegUnderlyingPriceDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how the underlying price is determined at the point of option exercise. The underlying price may be set to the current settlement price, set to a special reference, set to the optimal value of the underlying during the defined period ("Look-back") or set to the average value of the underlying during the defined period ("Asian option").

Fields.Name: LegMinPriceIncrement
Fields.Description: Minimum price increment for a given exchange-traded instrument. Could also be used to represent tick value.

Fields.Name: LegMinPriceIncrementAmount
Fields.Description: Minimum price increment amount associated with the LegMinPriceIncrement(2190). For listed derivatives, the value can be calculated by multiplying LegMinPriceIncrement(2190) by LegContractMultiplier(614).

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethod
Fields.Description: Settlement method for a contract or instrument. Additional values may be used with bilateral agreement.

Fields.Name: LegOptPayoutType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of valuation method or trigger payout for an in-the-money option.

Fields.Name: LegOptPayoutAmount
Fields.Description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

Fields.Name: LegPriceQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method for price quotation.

Fields.Name: LegValuationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of valuation method applied.

Fields.Name: LegValuationSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the source of trade valuation data.

Fields.Name: LegValuationReferenceModel
Fields.Description: Specifies the methodology and/or assumptions used to generate the trade value.

Fields.Name: LegListMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates whether instruments are pre-listed only or can also be defined via user request.

Fields.Name: LegCapPrice
Fields.Description: Used to express the ceiling price of a capped call.

Fields.Name: LegFloorPrice
Fields.Description: Used to express the floor price of a capped put.

Fields.Name: LegFlexibleIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate a derivatives security that can be defined using flexible terms. The terms commonly permitted to be defined by market participants are expiration date and strike price. FlexibleIndicator is an alternative to LegCFICode(608) Standard/Non-standard attribute.

Fields.Name: LegFlexProductEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate if a product or group of product supports the creation of flexible securities.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventStartTime
Fields.Description: The start time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective. The start time must always be less than or equal to the end time.

Fields.Name: LegPositionLimit
Fields.Description: Position Limit for a given exchange-traded product.

Fields.Name: LegNTPositionLimit
Fields.Description: Position limit in the near-term contract for a given exchange-traded product.

Fields.Name: LegCPProgram
Fields.Description: The program under which a commercial paper is issued.

Fields.Name: LegCPRegType
Fields.Description: The registration type of a commercial paper issuance.

Fields.Name: LegShortSaleRestriction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a restriction applies to short selling a security.

Fields.Name: AssetGroup
Fields.Description: Indicates the broad product or asset classification. May be used to provide grouping for the product taxonomy (Product(460), SecurityType(167), etc.) and/or the risk taxonomy (AssetClass(1938), AssetSubClass(1939), AssetType(1940), etc.).

Fields.Name: LegStrategyType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of trade strategy.

Fields.Name: LegCommonPricingIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that common pricing applies. Common pricing may be relevant for a transaction that references more than one commodity reference price.

Fields.Name: LegSettlDisruptionProvision
Fields.Description: Specifies the consequences of bullion settlement disruption events.

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction if not overridden elsewhere.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable for complex FX option strategies.

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentRoundingPrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: MiscFeeRate
Fields.Description: The fee rate when MiscFeeAmt(137) is a percentage of trade quantity.

Fields.Name: MiscFeeAmountDue
Fields.Description: The fee amount due if different from MiscFeeAmt(137).

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEvents
Fields.Description: Number of complex events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of complex event.

Fields.Name: LegComplexOptPayoutPaySide
Fields.Description: Trade side of payout payer.

Fields.Name: LegComplexOptPayoutReceiveSide
Fields.Description: Trade side of payout receiver.

Fields.Name: LegComplexOptPayoutUnderlier
Fields.Description: Reference to the underlier whose payments are being passed through.

Fields.Name: LegComplexOptPayoutAmount
Fields.Description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an event. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

Fields.Name: LegComplexOptPayoutPercentage
Fields.Description: Percentage of observed price for calculating the payout associated with the event.

Fields.Name: LegComplexOptPayoutTime
Fields.Description: Specifies when the payout is to occur.

Fields.Name: LegComplexOptPayoutCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the payout amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPrice
Fields.Description: Specifies the price at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the LegComplexEventType(2219).

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPricePercentage
Fields.Description: Specifies the price percentage at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the LegComplexEventType(2219).

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the event price relative to the complex event price at the point the complex event outcome takes effect as determined by the LegComplexEventPriceTimeType(2231).

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPriceBoundaryPrecision
Fields.Description: Used in combination with LegComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod(2229) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPriceTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies when the complex event outcome takes effect. The outcome of a complex event is a payout or barrier action as specified by the LegComplexEventType(2219).

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies the condition between complex events when more than one event is specified. Multiple barrier events would use an "or" condition since only one can be effective at a given time. A set of digital range events would use an "and" condition since both conditions must be in effect for a payout to result.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCurrencyOne
Fields.Description: Specifies the first or only reference currency of the trade. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable for complex FX option strategies.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCurrencyTwo
Fields.Description: Specifies the second reference currency of the trade. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable for complex FX option strategies.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventQuoteBasis
Fields.Description: For foreign exchange Quanto option feature.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventFixedFXRate
Fields.Description: Specifies the fixed FX rate alternative for FX Quantro options.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the calculation agent.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventStrikePrice
Fields.Description: Upper strike price for Asian option feature. Strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventStrikeFactor
Fields.Description: Strike factor for Asian option feature. Upper strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventStrikeNumberOfOptions
Fields.Description: Upper string number of options for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventsXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to credit event table elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventNotifyingParty
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Specifies the local business center for which the credit event is to be determined. The inclusion of this business center implies that Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions is replaced by the local time of the specified business center. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventStandardSources
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', indicates that ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventMinimumSources
Fields.Description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventEndTime
Fields.Description: The end time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective. The end time must always be greater than or equal to the start time.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this complex event for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to a complex event elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventDates
Fields.Description: Number of complex event dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventStartDate
Fields.Description: The start date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options. The start date must always be less than or equal to end date.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventEndDate
Fields.Description: The end date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options. The end date must always be greater than or equal to start date.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventTimes
Fields.Description: Number of complex event times in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: NoLegInstrumentParties
Fields.Description: Number of parties in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentPartyID
Fields.Description: Used to identify party id related to instrument.

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: Used to identify source of instrument party id.

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentPartyRole
Fields.Description: Used to identify the role of instrument party id.

Fields.Name: NoLegInstrumentPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of parties sub-IDs in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentPartySubID
Fields.Description: PartySubID value within an instrument party repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of LegInstrumentPartySubID (2259) value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutPaySide
Fields.Description: Trade side of payout payer.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutReceiveSide
Fields.Description: Trade side of payout receiver.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutUnderlier
Fields.Description: Reference to the underlier whose payments are being passed through.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutPercentage
Fields.Description: Percentage of observed price for calculating the payout associated with the event.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutTime
Fields.Description: The time when the payout is to occur.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the payout amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPricePercentage
Fields.Description: Specifies the price percentage at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the UnderlyingComplexEventType(2046).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCurrencyOne
Fields.Description: Specifies the first or only reference currency of the trade. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable for complex FX option strategies.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCurrencyTwo
Fields.Description: Specifies the second reference currency of the trade. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable for complex FX option strategies.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventQuoteBasis
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency pairing for the quote.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventFixedFXRate
Fields.Description: Specifies the fixed FX rate alternative for FX Quantro options.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the calculation agent.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventStrikePrice
Fields.Description: Upper strike price for Asian option feature. Strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventStrikeFactor
Fields.Description: Strike factor for Asian option feature. Upper strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventStrikeNumberOfOptions
Fields.Description: Upper string number of options for a Strike Spread.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventsXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to credit event table elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventNotifyingParty
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Specifies the local business center for which the credit event is to be determined. The inclusion of this business center implies that Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions is replaced by the local time of the specified business center. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventStandardSources
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', indicates that ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventMinimumSources
Fields.Description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this complex event for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to a complex event elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlRateIndex
Fields.Description: In an outright or forward commodity trade that is cash settled this is the index used to determine the cash payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlRateIndexLocation
Fields.Description: This is an optional qualifying attribute of UnderlyingSettlementRateIndex(2284) such as the delivery zone for an electricity contract.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExpirationDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the option expiration.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingOptionExpirationDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingOptionExpirationDesc(2288) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingOptionExpirationDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingOptionExpirationDesc(2286) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingOptionExpirationDesc(2286).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSwapSubClass
Fields.Description: The sub-classification or notional schedule type of the swap.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikeUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Used to express the unit of measure (UOM) of the price if different from the contract.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikeIndex
Fields.Description: Specifies the index used to calculate the strike price.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikeIndexSpread
Fields.Description: Specifies the strike price offset from the named index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingValuationSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the source of trade valuation data.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingValuationReferenceModel
Fields.Description: Specifies the methodology and/or assumptions used to generate the trade value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrategyType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of trade strategy.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCommonPricingIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that common pricing applies. Common pricing may be relevant for a transaction that references more than one commodity reference price.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlDisruptionProvision
Fields.Description: Specifies the consequences of settlement disruption events.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingInstrumentRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction if not overridden elsewhere.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingInstrumentRoundingPrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: AllocGrossTradeAmt
Fields.Description: Total amount traded for this account (i.e. quantity * price) expressed in units of currency.

Fields.Name: LastQtyChanged
Fields.Description: The positive or negative change in quantity when this report is a trade correction or continuation.

Fields.Name: TradeVersion
Fields.Description: Specifies the version of a trade or contract. This is used by systems or trading platforms in conjunction with TradeID(1003) to uniquely identify the version of a trade or contract. If used the conditions for a change of version are subject to bilateral agreement. It is recommended to change the version only for significant updates to the business entity rather than for minor changes to trade details or systematic distribution of reports. Examples where the version would change are trade quantity modification, customer account assignment or trade novation.

Fields.Name: HistoricalReportIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates that the trade or event being reported occurred in the past and the trade is terminated or no longer active.

Fields.Name: NoAssetAttributes
Fields.Description: The number of asset attribute entries in the group.

Fields.Name: AssetAttributeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the name of the attribute. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Asset_Attribute_Types for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

Fields.Name: AssetAttributeValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the value of the asset attribute.

Fields.Name: AssetAttributeLimit
Fields.Description: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: NoLegAssetAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

Fields.Name: LegAssetAttributeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the name of the attribute. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Asset_Attribute_Types for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

Fields.Name: LegAssetAttributeValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: LegAssetAttributeLimit
Fields.Description: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingAssetAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetAttributeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the name of the attribute. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Asset_Attribute_Types for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetAttributeValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetAttributeLimit
Fields.Description: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitReportStatus
Fields.Description: Status of risk limit report.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitReportRejectReason
Fields.Description: The reason for rejecting the PartyRiskLimitsReport(35=CM) or PartyRiskLimitsUpdateReport(35=CR).

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckRequestID
Fields.Description: The unique identifier of the PartyRiskLimitCheckRequest(35=DF) message.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckID
Fields.Description: The unique and static identifier, at the business entity level, of a risk limit check request.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckTransType
Fields.Description: Specifies the transaction type of the risk limit check request.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of limit check message.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckRequestRefID
Fields.Description: Specifies the message reference identifier of the risk limit check request message.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckRequestType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of limit amount check being requested.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the amount being requested for approval.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Indicates the status of the risk limit check request.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckRequestResult
Fields.Description: Result of the credit limit check request.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitApprovedAmount
Fields.Description: The credit/risk limit amount approved.

Fields.Name: PartyActionRequestID
Fields.Description: The unique identifier of the PartyActionRequest(35=DH) message.

Fields.Name: PartyActionType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of action to take or was taken for a given party.

Fields.Name: ApplTestMessageIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate whether the message being sent is to test the receiving application's availability to process the message. When set to "Y" the message is a test message. If not specified, the message is by default not a test message.

Fields.Name: PartyActionReportID
Fields.Description: The unique identifier of the PartyActionReport(35=DI) message as assigned by the message sender.

Fields.Name: PartyActionResponse
Fields.Description: Specifies the action taken as a result of the PartyActionType(2239) of the PartyActionRequest(35=DH) message.

Fields.Name: PartyActionRejectReason
Fields.Description: Specifies the reason the PartyActionRequest(35=DH) was rejected.

Fields.Name: RefRiskLimitCheckID
Fields.Description: The reference identifier of the PartyRiskLimitCheckRequest(35=DF) message, or a similar out of band message, that contained the approval for the risk/credit limit check request.

Fields.Name: RefRiskLimitCheckIDType
Fields.Description: Specifies which type of identifier is specified in RefRiskLimitCheckID(2334) field.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitVelocityPeriod
Fields.Description: The time interval for which the clip size limit applies. The velocity time unit is expressed in RiskLimitVelocityUnit(2337).

Fields.Name: RiskLimitVelocityUnit
Fields.Description: Unit of time in which RiskLimitVelocityPeriod(2336) is expressed.

Fields.Name: RequestingPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Qualifies the value of RequestingPartyRole(1660).

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckModelType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of credit limit check model workflow to apply for the specified party

Fields.Name: EventMonthYear
Fields.Description: Used with derivatives when an event is express as a month-year with optional day or month or week of month. Format: YYYYMM (e.g. 199903) YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20030323) YYYYMMwN (e.g. 200303w2) for week A specific date can be appended to the month-year. For instance, if multiple event types exist in the same Year and Month, but actually at a different time, a value can be appended, such as "w" or "w2" to indicate week. Likewise, the day of monty (0-31) can be appended to indicate a specific event date.

Fields.Name: LegEventMonthYear
Fields.Description: Used with derivatives when an event is express as a month-year with optional day or month or week of month. Format: YYYYMM (e.g. 199903) YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20030323) YYYYMMwN (e.g. 200303w2) for week A specific date can be appended to the month-year. For instance, if multiple event types exist in the same Year and Month, but actually at a different time, a value can be appended, such as "w" or "w2" to indicate week. Likewise, the day of monty (0-31) can be appended to indicate a specific event date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingEventMonthYear
Fields.Description: Used with derivatives when an event is express as a month-year with optional day or month or week of month. Format: YYYYMM (e.g. 199903) YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20030323) YYYYMMwN (e.g. 200303w2) for week A specific date can be appended to the month-year. For instance, if multiple event types exist in the same Year and Month, but actually at a different time, a value can be appended, such as "w" or "w2" to indicate week. Likewise, the day of monty (0-31) can be appended to indicate a specific event date.

Fields.Name: RiskLimitCheckStatus
Fields.Description: Indicates the status of the risk limit check performed on a trade.

Fields.Name: SideRiskLimitCheckStatus
Fields.Description: Indicates the status of the risk limit check performed on the side of a trade.

Fields.Name: NoEntitlementTypes
Fields.Description: Number of entitlement types in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegMidPx
Fields.Description: Leg Mid price/rate. For OTC swaps, this is the mid-market mark (for example, as defined by CFTC). For uncleared OTC swaps, LegMidPx(2346) and the MidPx(631) fields are mutually exclusive.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryTransactionType
Fields.Description: Specifies the regulatory mandate or rule that the transaction complies with.

Fields.Name: LegAssetGroup
Fields.Description: Indicates the broad product or asset classification. May be used to provide grouping for the product taxonomy (Product(460), SecurityType(167), etc.) and/or the risk taxonomy (AssetClass(1938), AssetSubClass(1939), AssetType(1940), etc.).

Fields.Name: PricePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the price decimal precision of the instrument.
Fields.Elaboration: For FX, this specifies the pip size in which forward points are calculated. Point (pip) size varies by currency pair. Major currencies are all traded in points of 0.0001, with the exception of JPY which has a point size of 0.01.

Fields.Name: CollateralPortfolioID
Fields.Description: Identifier of the collateral portfolio when reporting on a portfolio basis.

Fields.Name: EncodedComplianceTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedComplianceText(2352) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedComplianceText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ComplianceText(2404) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ComplianceText(2404) field.

Fields.Name: TradingUnitPeriodMultiplier
Fields.Description: Indicates the number of contract periods associated with the minimum trading unit for a given contract duration resulting in the number of total traded contracts.
Fields.Elaboration: As an example, 456 is the number of off-peak periods for a product with a minimum trading unit of 5 MWh resulting in 2280 total traded contracts.

Fields.Name: LegTradingUnitPeriodMultiplier
Fields.Description: Indicates the number of contract periods associated with the minimum trading unit for a given contract duration resulting in the number of total traded contracts.
Fields.Elaboration: As an example, 456 is the number of off-peak periods for a product with a minimum trading unit of 5 MWh resulting in 2280 total traded contracts.

Fields.Name: PartyRiskLimitStatus
Fields.Description: The status of risk limits for a party.

Fields.Name: RemunerationIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the trade price was adjusted for compensation (i.e. includes a mark-up, mark-down or commission) in the price paid.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MSRB and FINRA TRACE reporting requirements, this is used among firms to indicate trade remuneration.

Fields.Name: LegTotalTradeQty
Fields.Description: Expresses the total quantity traded over the life of the contract when LegLastQty(1418) is to be repeated periodically over the term of the contract. The value is the product of LegLastQty(1418) and LegTradingUnitPeriodMultiplier(2353).

Fields.Name: LegLastMultipliedQty
Fields.Description: Expresses the quantity bought/sold when LastQty is expressed in contracts. Used in addition to LegLastQty(1418), it is the product of LegLastQty(1418) and LegContractMultiplier(614).

Fields.Name: LegTotalGrossTradeAmt
Fields.Description: Expresses the full total monetary value of the traded contract. The value is the product of LegLastPx(637) and LegTotalTradeQty(2357) or LegTotalTradeMultipliedQty(2360), if priced in units instead of contracts.

Fields.Name: LegTotalTradeMultipliedQty
Fields.Description: Expresses the total trade quantity in units where LegContractMultiplier(614) is not 1. The value is the product of LegTotalTradeQty(2357) and LegContractMultiplier(614).

Fields.Name: CompressionGroupID
Fields.Description: Use to identify a netting or compression group where trades in the group were netted or compressed. This includes both terminating trades and any remnant trades that result from the operation.

Fields.Name: SelfMatchPreventionID
Fields.Description: Identifies an order or trade that should not be matched to an opposite order or trade if both buy and sell orders for the same asset contain the same SelfMatchPreventionID(2362) and submitted by the same firm.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingTradingUnitPeriodMultiplier
Fields.Description: Indicates the number of contract periods associated with the minimum trading unit for a given contract duration resulting in the number of total traded contracts.
Fields.Elaboration: As an example, 456 is the number of off-peak periods for a product with a minimum trading unit of 5 MWh resulting in 2280 total traded contracts.

Fields.Name: PosReportAction
Fields.Description: Indicates action that triggered the Position Report.

Fields.Name: SettlForwardPoints
Fields.Description: FX forward points added to SettlPrice(730). The value is expressed in decimal form and may be a negative.
Fields.Elaboration: As an example, 61.99 points is expressed as 0.006199.

Fields.Name: SettlPriceFxRateCalc
Fields.Description: Specifies whether LastPx(31) [TradeCaptureReport] or SettlPrice(730) [PositionReport] should be multiplied or divided.

Fields.Name: TotalTradeQty
Fields.Description: Expresses the total quantity traded over the life of the contract when LastQty(32) is repeated periodically over the term of the contract. The value is the product of LastQty(32) and TradingUnitPeriodMultiplier(2353).

Fields.Name: LastMultipliedQty
Fields.Description: Expresses the quantity bought or sold when LastQty(32) is expressed in number of contracts. Used in addition to LastQty(32). It is the product of LastQty(32) and ContractMultiplier(231).

Fields.Name: TotalGrossTradeAmt
Fields.Description: Expresses the full total monetary value of the traded contract. The value is the product of LastPx(31) and TotalTradeQty(2367) or TotalTradeMultipliedQty(2370), if priced in units instead of contracts.

Fields.Name: TotalTradeMultipliedQty
Fields.Description: Expresses the total trade quantity in units where ContractMultiplier(231) is not 1. The value is the product of TotalTradeQty(2367) and ContractMultiplier(231).

Fields.Name: EncodedTradeContinuationText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the TradeContinuationText(2374) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the TradeContinuationText(2374) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedTradeContinuationTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedTradeContinuationText(2371) field.

Fields.Name: IntraFirmTradeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the trade or position was entered into as an intra-group transaction, i.e. between two units of the same parent entity having majority ownership interest in both counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of EMIR this refers to Regulation (EU) 648/2012 Article 3 "intragroup transactions" section 1 which states: "In relation to a non-financial counterparty, an intragroup transaction is an OTC derivative contract entered into with another counterparty which is part of the same group provided that both counterparties are included in the same consolidation on a full basis and they are subject to an appropriate centralised risk evaluation, measurement and control procedures and that counterparty is established in the Union or, if it is established in a third country, the Commission has adopted an implementing act under Article 13(2) in respect of that third country. Canada's similar requirement is under Appendix A to OSC Rule 91-507."

Fields.Name: TradeContinuationText
Fields.Description: Elaboration of the purpose or action of the regulatory report when TradeContinuation(1937)=99 (Other).

Fields.Name: TaxonomyType
Fields.Description: The type of identification taxonomy used to identify the security.

Fields.Name: PartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of PartyRole(452).

Fields.Name: DerivativeInstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of DerivativeInstrumentPartyRole(1295).

Fields.Name: InstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of InstrumentPartyRole(1051).

Fields.Name: LegInstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of LegInstrumentPartyRole(2257).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of LegProvisionPartyRole(40536).

Fields.Name: Nested2PartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of Nested2PartyRole(759).

Fields.Name: Nested3PartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of Nested3PartyRole(951).

Fields.Name: Nested4PartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of Nested4PartyRole(1417).

Fields.Name: NestedPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of NestedPartyRole(538).

Fields.Name: ProvisionPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of ProvisionPartyRole(40177).

Fields.Name: RequestedPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of RequestedPartyRole(1509).

Fields.Name: TradeContingency
Fields.Description: Indicates the contingency attribute for a trade in an asset class that may be contingent on the clearing of a corresponding paired trade (for example Exchange for Physical (EFP), Exchange for Swap (EFS), Exchange for Related (EFR) or Exchange for Option (EFO), collectively called EFRPs). Once the paired trade clears or fails to clear, the related trade (the trade which carries this attribute) ceases to exist.

Fields.Name: RootPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of RootPartyRole(1119).

Fields.Name: SettlPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of SettlPartyRole(784).

Fields.Name: TradeConfirmationReferenceID
Fields.Description: A reference or control identifier or number used as a trade confirmation key.
Fields.Elaboration: An example of a control identifier is the DTC ID Control Number.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingInstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Used to further qualify the value of UnderlyingInstrumentPartyRole(1061).

Fields.Name: AllocRefRiskLimitCheckID
Fields.Description: The reference identifier to the PartyRiskLimitCheckRequest(35=DF), or a similar out of band message, message that contained the approval or rejection for risk/credit limit check for this allocation.

Fields.Name: AllocRefRiskLimitCheckIDType
Fields.Description: Specifies which type of identifier is specified in AllocRefRiskLimitCheckID(2392) field.

Fields.Name: LimitUtilizationAmt
Fields.Description: The total amount of the limit that has been drawn down against the counterparty. This includes the amount for prior trades. It may or may not include the amount for the given trade, specified in LastLimitAmt(1632), depending upon whether the given trade is considered pending.

Fields.Name: LimitAmt
Fields.Description: The limit for the counterparty. This represents the total limit amount, independent of any amount already utilized.

Fields.Name: LimitRole
Fields.Description: Indicates the scope of the limit by role.
Fields.Elaboration: Used to indicate whether this is a customer account limit, a clearing firm limit, etc.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryTradeIDScope
Fields.Description: Specifies the scope to which the RegulatoryTradeID(1903) applies. Used when a trade must be assigned more than one identifier, e.g. one for the clearing member and another for the client on a cleared trade as with the principal model in Europe.

Fields.Name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDScope
Fields.Description: Specifies the scope to which the SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972) applies. Used when a trade must be assigned more than one identifier, e.g. one for the clearing member and another for the client on a cleared trade as with the principal model in Europe.

Fields.Name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDScope
Fields.Description: Specifies the scope to which the AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909) applies. Used when a trade must be assigned more than one identifier, e.g. one for the clearing member and another for the client on a cleared trade as with the principal model in Europe.

Fields.Name: EffectiveBusinessDate
Fields.Description: Specifies an explicit business date for associated reference data or transaction. Used when an implicit date is not sufficiently specific.

Fields.Name: ListManualOrderIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates if the list of orders was initially received manually (as opposed to electronically) or if it was entered manually (as opposed to entered by automated trading software).

Fields.Name: EntitlementSubType
Fields.Description: Subtype of an entitlement specified in EntitlementType(1775).

Fields.Name: QuoteModelType
Fields.Description: Quote model type

Fields.Name: ComplianceText
Fields.Description: Free text for compliance information required for regulatory reporting.

Fields.Name: ExecMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how the transaction was executed, e.g. via an automated execution platform or other method.

Fields.Name: AllocRegulatoryLegRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

Fields.Name: ComplexEventSpotRate
Fields.Description: FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventForwardPoints
Fields.Description: FX forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventSpotRate
Fields.Description: FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventForwardPoints
Fields.Description: FX forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryLegRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

Fields.Name: RateSourceReferemcePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: RelatedToSecurityID
Fields.Description: The security identifier of the instrument, instrument leg or underlying instrument with which the related instrument has correlation.

Fields.Name: RelatedToSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies class or source of the RelatedToSecurityID(2413) value.

Fields.Name: RelatedToStreamXIDRef
Fields.Description: StreamXID(41303), LegStreamXID(41700) or UnderlyingStreamXID(42016) of the stream with which the related instrument has correlation.

Fields.Name: SideRegulatoryLegRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

Fields.Name: RelatedToDividendPeriodXIDRef
Fields.Description: The DividendPeriodXID(42293) of the stream dividend period with which the related instrument has correlation.

Fields.Name: FirmTradeEventID
Fields.Description: An identifier created by the trading party for the life cycle event associated with this report.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventSpotRate
Fields.Description: FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventForwardPoints
Fields.Description: FX forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

Fields.Name: FillRefID
Fields.Description: A reference to either the value of the FillExecID(1363) or an implicit position of a fills instance in the FillsGrp component.

Fields.Name: OrderRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique message identifier for an order request as assigned by the submitter of the request.

Fields.Name: MassOrderRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique message identifier for a mass order request as assigned by the submitter of the orders.

Fields.Name: MassOrderReportID
Fields.Description: Unique message identifier for a mass order request as assigned by the receiver of the orders.

Fields.Name: MassOrderRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Status of mass order request.

Fields.Name: MassOrderRequestResult
Fields.Description: Request result of mass order request.

Fields.Name: OrderResponseLevel
Fields.Description: The level of response requested from receiver of mass order messages. A default value should be bilaterally agreed.

Fields.Name: NoOrderEntries
Fields.Description: Number of order entries.

Fields.Name: OrderEntryAction
Fields.Description: Specifies the action to be taken for the given order.

Fields.Name: OrderEntryID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for an order within a single MassOrder(35=DJ) message that can be used as a reference in the MassOrderAck(35=DK) message.

Fields.Name: ExecTypeReason
Fields.Description: The initiating event when an ExecutionReport(35=8) is sent.

Fields.Name: TotNoOrderEntries
Fields.Description: Totals number of orders for a mass order or its acknowledgment being fragmented across multiple messages.

Fields.Name: NoTargetPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of target party sub IDs in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: TargetPartySubID
Fields.Description: Party sub-identifier value within a target party repeating group.

Fields.Name: TargetPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: Type of TargetPartySubID(2434) value.

Fields.Name: TransferInstructionID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the transfer instruction assigned by the submitter.

Fields.Name: TransferID
Fields.Description: The unique identifier assigned to the transfer entity once it is received, for example, by the CCP or the party governing the transfer process. Generally this same identifier for the transfer is used by all parties involved.

Fields.Name: TransferReportID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the transfer report message.

Fields.Name: TransferTransType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of transfer transaction.

Fields.Name: TransferType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of transfer request.

Fields.Name: TransferScope
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of transfer.

Fields.Name: TransferStatus
Fields.Description: Status of the transfer.

Fields.Name: TransferRejectReason
Fields.Description: Reason the transfer instruction was rejected.

Fields.Name: TransferReportType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of transfer report.

Fields.Name: AggressorTime
Fields.Description: Timestamp of aggressive order or quote resulting in match event.

Fields.Name: AggressorSide
Fields.Description: Side of aggressive order or quote resulting in match event.

Fields.Name: FastMarketIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates if the instrument is in "fast market" state.
Fields.Elaboration: A "fast market" is a state in which market rules are applied to instrument(s) or entire trading session when market events causes significant price movements due to public information.

Fields.Name: LinkageHandlingIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicate whether linkage handling is in effect for an instrument or not.

Fields.Name: NumberOfBuyOrders
Fields.Description: Number of buy orders involved in a trade.

Fields.Name: NumberOfSellOrders
Fields.Description: Number of sell orders involved in a trade.

Fields.Name: SettlPriceDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Calculation method used to determine settlement price.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticReqID
Fields.Description: Message identifier for a statistics request.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticRptID
Fields.Description: Message identifier for a statistics report.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticName
Fields.Description: The short name or acronym for a set of statistic parameters.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticDesc
Fields.Description: Can be used to provide an optional textual description for a statistic.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticType
Fields.Description: Type of statistic value.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticScope
Fields.Description: Entities used as basis for the statistics.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticSubScope
Fields.Description: Sub-scope of the statistics to further reduce the entities used as basis for the statistics.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticScopeType
Fields.Description: Scope details of the statistics to reduce the number of events being used as basis for the statistics.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Dissemination frequency of statistics. Special meaning for a value of zero which represents an event-driven dissemination in real time (e.g. as soon as a new trade occurs).

Fields.Name: MDStatisticFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit for MDStatisticFrequencyPeriod(2460).

Fields.Name: MDStatisticDelayPeriod
Fields.Description: Number of time units between the calculation of the statistic and its dissemination. Can be used to defer or delay publication.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticDelayUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit for MDStatisticDelayPeriod(2462).

Fields.Name: MDStatisticIntervalType
Fields.Description: Type of interval over which statistic is calculated.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticIntervalTypeUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit for MDStatisticIntervalType(2464).

Fields.Name: MDStatisticIntervalPeriod
Fields.Description: Length of time over which the statistic is calculated. Special meaning for a value of zero to express that there is no aggregation over time. Can be used with other interval types expressing relative date and time ranges to combine them with sliding window peaks, e.g. highest volume across 1 minute intervals of the previous day.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticIntervalUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit for MDStatisticIntervalPeriod(2466).

Fields.Name: MDStatisticStartDate
Fields.Description: First day of range for which statistical data is collected.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticEndDate
Fields.Description: Last day of range for which statistical data is collected.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticStartTime
Fields.Description: Start time of the time range for which statistical data is collected.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticEndTime
Fields.Description: End time of the time range for which statistical data is collected.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticRatioType
Fields.Description: Ratios between various entities.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticRequestResult
Fields.Description: Result returned in response to MarketDataStatisticsRequest (35=DO).

Fields.Name: NoMDStatistics
Fields.Description: Number of market data statistics.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for a statistic.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticTime
Fields.Description: Time of calculation of a statistic.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticStatus
Fields.Description: Status for a statistic to indicate its availability.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticValue
Fields.Description: Statistical value.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticValueType
Fields.Description: Type of statistical value.

Fields.Name: MDStatisticValueUnit
Fields.Description: Unit of time for statistical value.

Fields.Name: EncodedMDStatisticDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMDStatisticDesc(2482) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedMDStatisticDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MDStatisticDesc(2455) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MDStatisticDesc(2455) field.

Fields.Name: AllocRiskLimitCheckStatus
Fields.Description: Indicates the status of the risk limit check performed on a trade for this allocation instance.

Fields.Name: FirmTransactionID
Fields.Description: The unique transaction entity identifier assigned by the firm.

Fields.Name: TransactionID
Fields.Description: The unique transaction entity identifier.

Fields.Name: WireReference
Fields.Description: The reference to a wire transfer associated with the transaction. Wire references done via wire services such as Fedwire Output Message Accountabilitty Data "OMAD" or SWIFT Output Sequence Number "OSN".

Fields.Name: CollRptRejectReason
Fields.Description: Reject reason code for rejecting the collateral report.

Fields.Name: CollRptStatus
Fields.Description: The status of the collateral report.

Fields.Name: PackageID
Fields.Description: Identifier assigned to a collection of trades so that they can be analyzed as one atomic unit for risk assessment and clearing.

Fields.Name: TradeNumber
Fields.Description: Ordinal number of the trade within a series of related trades.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetGroup
Fields.Description: Indicates the broad product or asset classification. May be used to provide grouping for the product taxonomy (Product(460), SecurityType(167), etc.) and/or the risk taxonomy (AssetClass(1938), AssetSubClass(1939), AssetType(1940), etc.).

Fields.Name: LegDifferentialPrice
Fields.Description: Used in pricing a group of individual Trade at Settlement (TAS) and Trade At Marker (TAM) contracts as an atomic unit. The value is the negotiated currency offset either at settlement (TAS) or at the time specified in the product definition (TAM). The final contract price is reported in LegLastPx(637).

Fields.Name: EncodedLegDocumentationText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegDocumentationText(2505) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegDocumentationText(2505) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegDocumentationTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegDocumentationText(2493) field.

Fields.Name: LegAgreementCurrency
Fields.Description: Contractual currency forming the basis of a financing agreement and associated transactions. Usually, but not always, the same as the trade currency.

Fields.Name: LegAgreementDate
Fields.Description: A reference to the date the underlying agreement specified by LegAgreementID(2498) and LegAgreementDesc(2497) was executed.

Fields.Name: LegAgreementDesc
Fields.Description: The full name of the base standard agreement, annexes and amendments in place between the principals applicable to a financing transaction. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-agreement-type for derivative values.

Fields.Name: LegAgreementID
Fields.Description: A common reference to the applicable standing agreement between the counterparties to a financing transaction.

Fields.Name: LegAgreementVersion
Fields.Description: The version of the master agreement.

Fields.Name: LegBrokerConfirmationDesc
Fields.Description: Describes the type of broker confirmation executed between the parties. Can be used as an alternative to MasterConfirmationDesc(1962). See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/broker-confirmation-type for values.

Fields.Name: LegCreditSupportAgreementDate
Fields.Description: The date of the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties and intended to govern collateral arrangements for all OTC derivatives transactions between those parties.

Fields.Name: LegCreditSupportAgreementDesc
Fields.Description: The type of ISDA Credit Support Agreement. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-support-agreement-type for values.

Fields.Name: LegCreditSupportAgreementID
Fields.Description: A common reference or unique identifier to identify the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryType
Fields.Description: Identifies type of settlement.

Fields.Name: LegDocumentationText
Fields.Description: A sentence or phrase pertinent to the trade, not a reference to an external document. E.g. "To be registered with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Acid Rain Division, SO2 Allowance Tracking System".

Fields.Name: LegEndDate
Fields.Description: End date of a financing deal, i.e. the date the seller reimburses the buyer and takes back control of the collateral.

Fields.Name: LegGoverningLaw
Fields.Description: Identification of the law governing the transaction. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/governing-law for values.

Fields.Name: LegMarginRatio
Fields.Description: The fraction of the cash consideration that must be collateralized, expressed as a percent. A MarginRatio of 2% indicates that the value of the collateral (after deducting for "haircut") must exceed the cash consideration by 2%.

Fields.Name: LegMasterConfirmationAnnexDate
Fields.Description: The date that an annexation to the master confirmation was executed between the parties.

Fields.Name: LegMasterConfirmationDate
Fields.Description: Alternative to broker confirmation. The date of the confirmation executed between the parties and intended to govern all relevant transactions between those parties.

Fields.Name: LegMasterConfirmationDesc
Fields.Description: The type of master confirmation executed between the parties. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-type for values.

Fields.Name: LegMasterConfirmationAnnexDesc
Fields.Description: The type of master confirmation annexation executed between the parties. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-annex-type for values.

Fields.Name: LegStartDate
Fields.Description: Start date of a financing deal, i.e. the date the buyer pays the seller cash and takes control of the collateral.

Fields.Name: LegTerminationType
Fields.Description: Type of financing termination.

Fields.Name: AllocCalculatedCcyQty
Fields.Description: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency trade applicable to the allocation instance.

Fields.Name: CollateralRequestInstruction
Fields.Description: An encoded collateral request processing instruction to the receiver.

Fields.Name: CollateralRequestLinkID
Fields.Description: A unique identifier to link together a set or group of requests.

Fields.Name: CollateralRequestNumber
Fields.Description: Ordinal number of the request within a set or group of requests.

Fields.Name: TotNumCollateralRequests
Fields.Description: Total number of request messages within a set or group of requests.

Fields.Name: WarningText
Fields.Description: Communicates the underlying condition when the request response indicates "warning".

Fields.Name: EncodedWarningText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the WarningText(2520) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the WarningText(2520) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedWarningTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedWarningtText(2521) field.

Fields.Name: CrossedIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the order or quote was crossed with another order or quote having the same context, e.g. having accounts with a common ownership.

Fields.Name: TradeReportingIndicator
Fields.Description: Used between parties to convey trade reporting status.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of regulatory reporting, this field may be used by the reporting party (e.g. party obligated to report to regulators) to inform their trading counterparty or other interested parties the trade reporting status.

Fields.Name: AffiliatedFirmsTradeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the transaction or position was entered into between two affiliated firms. I.e. one counterparty has an ownership interest in the other counterparty but less than the majority interest.
Fields.Elaboration: This trade attribute was identified under and applies to the Canadian CSA trade reporting regulations.

Fields.Name: InternationalSwapIndicator
Fields.Description: Identifies the swap trade as an "international" transaction.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of CFTC Regulation 45.3(h), an international swap is required by U.S. law and the law of another jurisdiction to be reported both to a US Swaps Data Repository and to a different trade repository registered within the other jurisdiction. The additional SDRs must be identified in the appropriate Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 102 (Data repository), PartyRoleQualifier(2376) = 11 (Additional international trade repository) and PartySubIDType(803) = 70 (Location or jurisdiction).

Fields.Name: MultiAssetSwapIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates a swap that does not have one easily identifiable primary underlying asset, but instead involves multiple underlying assets within one trade repository's jurisdiction that belong to different asset classes.

Fields.Name: ClearingSettlPrice
Fields.Description: Clearing settlement price.

Fields.Name: NoRelativeValues
Fields.Description: Number of relative value metrics entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: RelativeValueType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of relative value measurement being specified.

Fields.Name: RelativeValue
Fields.Description: The valuation of an instrument relative to a base measurement specified in RelativeValueType(2530). This value can be negative.

Fields.Name: RelativeValueSide
Fields.Description: Specifies the side of the relative value.

Fields.Name: BidSpread
Fields.Description: Basis points relative to a benchmark curve on the bid side, such as LIBOR, or a known security, such as 10Y US Treasury bond. The benchmark security or curve name is specified in the SpreadOrBenchmarkCurveData component.

Fields.Name: OfferSpread
Fields.Description: Basis points relative to a benchmark curve on the offer side, such as LIBOR, or a known security, such as 10Y US Treasury bond. The benchmark security or curve name is specified in the SpreadOrBenchmarkCurveData component.

Fields.Name: MDReportEvent
Fields.Description: Technical event within market data feed.

Fields.Name: MDReportCount
Fields.Description: Number of reference and market data messages in-between two MarketDataReport(35=DR) messages.

Fields.Name: TotNoMarketSegmentReports
Fields.Description: Total number of reports related to market segments.

Fields.Name: TotNoInstrumentReports
Fields.Description: Total number of reports related to instruments.

Fields.Name: TotNoPartyDetailReports
Fields.Description: Total number of reports related to party detail information.

Fields.Name: TotNoEntitlementReports
Fields.Description: Total number of reports related to party entitlement information.

Fields.Name: TotNoRiskLimitReports
Fields.Description: Total number of reports related to party risk limit information.

Fields.Name: MarketSegmentStatus
Fields.Description: Status of market segment.

Fields.Name: MarketSegmentType
Fields.Description: Used to classify the type of market segment.

Fields.Name: MarketSegmentSubType
Fields.Description: Used to further categorize market segments within a MarketSegmentType(2543).

Fields.Name: NoRelatedMarketSegments
Fields.Description: Number of related market segments.

Fields.Name: RelatedMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Identifies a related market segment.

Fields.Name: MarketSegmentRelationship
Fields.Description: Type of relationship between two or more market segments.

Fields.Name: NoAuctionTypeRules
Fields.Description: Number of auction order types.

Fields.Name: AuctionTypeProductComplex
Fields.Description: Identifies an entire suite of products for which the auction order type rule applies.

Fields.Name: NoPriceRangeRules
Fields.Description: Number of rules related to price ranges.

Fields.Name: StartPriceRange
Fields.Description: Lower boundary for price range.

Fields.Name: EndPriceRange
Fields.Description: Upper boundary for price range.

Fields.Name: PriceRangeValue
Fields.Description: Maximum range expressed as absolute value.

Fields.Name: PriceRangePercentage
Fields.Description: Maximum range expressed as percentage.

Fields.Name: PriceRangeProductComplex
Fields.Description: Identifies an entire suite of products in the context of trading rules related to price ranges.

Fields.Name: PriceRangeRuleID
Fields.Description: Identifier for a price range rule.

Fields.Name: FastMarketPercentage
Fields.Description: The percentage factor to be applied to trading rule parameters (e.g. price ranges, size ranges, etc.) when fast market conditions are applicable.

Fields.Name: NoQuoteSizeRules
Fields.Description: Number of rules related to quote sizes.

Fields.Name: QuoteSideIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether single sided quotes are allowed.

Fields.Name: NoFlexProductEligibilities
Fields.Description: Number of eligibility indicators for the creation of flexible securities.

Fields.Name: FlexProductEligibilityComplex
Fields.Description: Identifies an entire suite of products which are eligible for the creation of flexible securities.

Fields.Name: NumOfComplexInstruments
Fields.Description: Represents the total number of multileg securities or user defined securities that make up the security.

Fields.Name: MarketDepthTimeInterval
Fields.Description: Specifies the time interval used for netting market data in a price depth feed.

Fields.Name: MarketDepthTimeIntervalUnit
Fields.Description: The time unit associated with the time interval of the netting of market data in a price depth feed.

Fields.Name: MDRecoveryTimeInterval
Fields.Description: Specifies the time interval between two repetitions of the same market data for cyclic recovery feeds.

Fields.Name: MDRecoveryTimeIntervalUnit
Fields.Description: The time unit associated with the time interval between two cycles of the same market data in cyclic data recovery feeds.

Fields.Name: PrimaryServiceLocationID
Fields.Description: Primary service location identifier.

Fields.Name: SecondaryServiceLocationID
Fields.Description: Secondary or alternate service location identifier.

Fields.Name: MatchRuleProductComplex
Fields.Description: Identifies an entire suite of products for which the matching rule applies.

Fields.Name: CustomerPriority
Fields.Description: Specifies the kind of priority given to customers.

Fields.Name: TickRuleProductComplex
Fields.Description: Identifies an entire suite of products for which the price tick rule applies.

Fields.Name: PreviousAdjustedOpenInterest
Fields.Description: Previous day's adjusted open interest.

Fields.Name: PreviousUnadjustedOpenInterest
Fields.Description: Previous day's unadjusted open interest.

Fields.Name: LowExercisePriceOptionIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates if a given option instrument permits low exercise prices (LEPO).

Fields.Name: BlockTradeEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates if a given instrument is eligible for block trading.

Fields.Name: InstrumentPricePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the number of decimal places for instrument prices.

Fields.Name: StrikePricePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the number of decimal places for exercise price.

Fields.Name: OrigStrikePrice
Fields.Description: Original exercise price, e.g. after corporate action requiring changes.

Fields.Name: SettlSubMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies a suitable settlement sub-method for a given settlement method.

Fields.Name: NoClearingPriceParameters
Fields.Description: Number of parameter sets for clearing prices.

Fields.Name: BusinessDayType
Fields.Description: Relative identification of a business day.

Fields.Name: ClearingPriceOffset
Fields.Description: Constant value required for the calculation of the clearing price, e.g. for variance futures.

Fields.Name: VegaMultiplier
Fields.Description: Constant value required for the calculation of the clearing quantity, e.g. for variance futures.

Fields.Name: AnnualTradingBusinessDays
Fields.Description: Number of trading business days in a year.

Fields.Name: TotalTradingBusinessDays
Fields.Description: Number of trading business days over the lifetime of an instrument.

Fields.Name: TradingBusinessDays
Fields.Description: Number of actual trading business days of an instrument.

Fields.Name: RealizedVariance
Fields.Description: Actual or realized variance of an instrument used to calculate settlement prices, e.g. for variance futures.

Fields.Name: StandardVariance
Fields.Description: Standard variance (over the lifetime of an instrument) or initial variance used to calculate settlement prices, e.g. for variance futures.

Fields.Name: RelatedClosePrice
Fields.Description: Closing price of the underlying required to calculate the RealizedVariance(2587).

Fields.Name: OvernightInterestRate
Fields.Description: Overnight interest rate.

Fields.Name: AccumulatedReturnModifiedVariationMargin
Fields.Description: The economic cost of the variation margin from one trading day to the next.

Fields.Name: CalculationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies how the calculation will be made.

Fields.Name: NoOrderAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of order attribute entries.

Fields.Name: OrderAttributeType
Fields.Description: The type of order attribute.

Fields.Name: OrderAttributeValue
Fields.Description: The value associated with the order attribute type specified in OrderAttributeType(2594).

Fields.Name: DeltaCrossed
Fields.Description: Indicates that the party has taken a position on both a put and a call on the same underlying asset.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventFuturesPriceValuation
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions. Applicable only to futures contracts.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventOptionsPriceValuation
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions. Applicable only to options contracts.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPVFinalPriceElectionFallback
Fields.Description: Specifies the fallback provisions for the hedging party in the determination of the final settlement price.

Fields.Name: StrikeIndexCurvePoint
Fields.Description: The point on the floating rate index curve. Sample values: M = combination of a number between 1-12 and an "M" for month, e.g. 3M Y = combination of number between 1-100 and a "Y" for year, e.g. 10Y 10Y-OLD = see above, then add "-OLD" when appropriate INTERPOLATED = the point is mathematically derived 2/2031 5 3/8 = the point is stated via a combination of maturity month / year and coupon.

Fields.Name: StrikeIndexQuote
Fields.Description: The quote side from which the index price is to be determined.

Fields.Name: ExtraordinaryEventAdjustmentMethod
Fields.Description: Defines how adjustments will be made to the contract should one or more of the extraordinary events occur.

Fields.Name: ExchangeLookAlike
Fields.Description: For a share option trade, indicates whether the instrument is to be treated as an 'exchange look-alike'.
Fields.Elaboration: This designation has significance for how share adjustments (arising from corporate actions) will be determined for the instrument. For an 'exchange look-alike' instrument the relevant share adjustments will follow that for a corresponding designated contract listed on the related exchange (referred to as Options Exchange Adjustment (ISDA defined term)), otherwise the share adjustments will be determined by the calculation agent (referred to as Calculation Agent Adjustment (ISDA defined term)).

Fields.Name: LegStrikeIndexCurvePoint
Fields.Description: The point on the floating rate index curve. Sample values: M = combination of a number between 1-12 and an "M" for month, e.g. 3M Y = combination of number between 1-100 and a "Y" for year, e.g. 10Y 10Y-OLD = see above, then add "-OLD" when appropriate INTERPOLATED = the point is mathematically derived 2/2031 5 3/8 = the point is stated via a combination of maturity month / year and coupon.

Fields.Name: LegStrikeIndexQuote
Fields.Description: The quote side from which the index price is to be determined.

Fields.Name: LegExtraordinaryEventAdjustmentMethod
Fields.Description: Defines how adjustments will be made to the contract should one or more of the extraordinary events occur.

Fields.Name: LegExchangeLookAlike
Fields.Description: For a share option trade, indicates whether the instrument is to be treated as an 'exchange look-alike'.
Fields.Elaboration: This designation has significance for how share adjustments (arising from corporate actions) will be determined for the instrument. For an 'exchange look-alike' instrument the relevant share adjustments will follow that for a corresponding designated contract listed on the related exchange (referred to as Options Exchange Adjustment (ISDA defined term)), otherwise the share adjustments will be determined by the calculation agent (referred to as Calculation Agent Adjustment (ISDA defined term)).

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventFuturesPriceValuation
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions. Applicable only to futures contracts.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventOptionsPriceValuation
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions. Applicable only to options contracts.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPVFinalPriceElectionFallback
Fields.Description: Specifies the fallback provisions for the hedging party in the determination of the final settlement price

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventFuturesPriceValuation
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions. Applicable only to futures contracts.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventOptionsPriceValuation
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions. Applicable only to options contracts.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPVFinalPriceElectionFallback
Fields.Description: Specifies the fallback provisions for the hedging party in the determination of the final settlement price

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNotional
Fields.Description: Notional value for the equity or bond underlier.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNotionalCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency denomination of the notional value. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNotionalDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method of determining the notional amount. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNotionalAdjustments
Fields.Description: Specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the return swap.

Fields.Name: PositionID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for a position entity. Refer to PosMaintRptID(721) for a unique identifier of a position report message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNotionalXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another notional amount for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFutureID
Fields.Description: In the case of an index underlier specifies the unique identifier for the referenced futures contract.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFutureIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of the UnderlyingFutureID(2620).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikeIndexCurvePoint
Fields.Description: The point on the floating rate index curve. Sample values: M = combination of a number between 1-12 and an "M" for month, e.g. 3M Y = combination of number between 1-100 and a "Y" for year, e.g. 10Y 10Y-OLD = see above, then add "-OLD" when appropriate INTERPOLATED = the point is mathematically derived 2/2031 5 3/8 = the point is stated via a combination of maturity month / year and coupon.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStrikeIndexQuote
Fields.Description: The quote side from which the index price is to be determined.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventAdjustmentMethod
Fields.Description: Defines how adjustments will be made to the contract should one or more of the extraordinary events occur.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExchangeLookAlike
Fields.Description: For a share option trade, indicates whether the instrument is to be treated as an 'exchange look-alike'.
Fields.Elaboration: This designation has significance for how share adjustments (arising from corporate actions) will be determined for the instrument. For an 'exchange look-alike' instrument the relevant share adjustments will follow that for a corresponding designated contract listed on the related exchange (referred to as Options Exchange Adjustment (ISDA defined term)), otherwise the share adjustments will be determined by the calculation agent (referred to as Calculation Agent Adjustment (ISDA defined term)).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAverageVolumeLimitationPercentage
Fields.Description: The limit of average percentage of individual securities traded in a day or a number of days.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAverageVolumeLimitationPeriodDays
Fields.Description: Specifies the limitation period for average daily trading volume in number of days.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDepositoryReceiptIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the underlier is a depository receipt.
Fields.Elaboration: A depository receipt is a negotiable certificate issued by a trust company or security depository.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOpenUnits
Fields.Description: The number of units (units of the index or number of securities, par amount of a bond) that constitute the underlier. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingBasketDivisor
Fields.Description: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingInstrumentXID
Fields.Description: Identifier for referencing this UnderlyingInstrument from a parent instrument or a convertible instrument.

Fields.Name: CollateralAmountType
