Fields.Description: The type of value in CurrentCollateralAmount(1704).

Fields.Name: NoMiscFeeSubTypes
Fields.Description: Specifies the number of miscellaneous fee sub-types.

Fields.Name: MiscFeeSubType
Fields.Description: Used to provide more granular fee types related to a value of MiscFeeType(139). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Misc_Fee_Sub_Types for code list of applicable fees. Other fee sub-types may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.
Fields.Elaboration: Fee sub-types may include market or country specific fee.

Fields.Name: MiscFeeSubTypeAmt
Fields.Description: The amount of the specified MiscFeeSubType(2634).

Fields.Name: MiscFeeSubTypeDesc
Fields.Description: Can be used to provide an optional textual description of the fee sub-type.

Fields.Name: EncodedMiscFeeSubTypeDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2638) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedMiscFeeSubTypeDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2636) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2636) field.

Fields.Name: NoCommissions
Fields.Description: Number of commissions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: CommissionAmount
Fields.Description: The commission amount.

Fields.Name: CommissionAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates what type of commission is being expressed in CommissionAmount(2640).

Fields.Name: CommissionBasis
Fields.Description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

Fields.Name: CommissionCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency denomination of the commission amount if different from the trade's currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: CommissionUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The commission rate unit of measure.

Fields.Name: CommissionUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when CommissionUnitOfMeasure(2644) = Ccy (Amount of currency).

Fields.Name: CommissionRate
Fields.Description: The commission rate when CommissionAmount(2640) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". If the rate is a percentage or expressed in basis points, use the decimalized form, e.g. "0.05" for a 5% commission or "0.005" for 50 basis points.

Fields.Name: CommissionSharedIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the amount in CommissionAmount(2640) is to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement.

Fields.Name: CommissionAmountShared
Fields.Description: Commission amount to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement. If specified, this amount should not exceed the amount in CommissionAmount(2640).

Fields.Name: CommissionLegRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

Fields.Name: CommissionDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the commission.

Fields.Name: EncodedCommissionDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of the encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedCommissionDesc(2652) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedCommissionDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the CommissionDesc(2650) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the CommissionDesc(2650) field.

Fields.Name: NoAllocCommissions
Fields.Description: Number of commissions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionAmount
Fields.Description: The commission amount.

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates what type of commission is being expressed in AllocCommissionAmount(2654).

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionBasis
Fields.Description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency denomination of the commission amount if different from the trade's currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The commission rate unit of measure.

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionUnitOfMeasureCurrency
Fields.Description: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when AllocCommissionUnitOfMeasure(2658) = Ccy (Currency).

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionRate
Fields.Description: The commission rate when AllocCommissionAmount(2654) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". If the rate is a percentage or expressed in basis points, use the decimalized form, e.g. "0.05" for a 5% commission or "0.005" for 50 basis points.

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionSharedIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the amount in AllocCommissionAmount(2654) is to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement.

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionAmountShared
Fields.Description: Commission amount to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement. If specified, this amount should not exceed the amount in AllocCommissionAmount(2654).

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionLegRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the commission.

Fields.Name: EncodedAllocCommissionDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of the encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAllocCommissionDesc(2666) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedAllocCommissionDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AllocCommissionDesc(2664) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AllocCommissionDesc(2664) field.

Fields.Name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates that the order or trade originates from a computer program or algorithm requiring little-to-no human intervention.

Fields.Name: NoTrdRegPublications
Fields.Description: Number of regulatory publication rules in repeating group.

Fields.Name: TrdRegPublicationType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of regulatory trade publication. Additional reasons for the publication type may be specified in TrdRegPublicationReason(2670).

Fields.Name: TrdRegPublicationReason
Fields.Description: Additional reason for trade publication type specified in TrdRegPublicationType(2669). Reasons may be specific to regulatory trade publication rules.

Fields.Name: SideTradeReportingIndicator
Fields.Description: Used between parties to convey trade reporting status.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of regulatory reporting, this field may be used by the reporting party (e.g. party obligated to report to regulators) to inform their trading counterparty or other interested parties the trade reporting status.

Fields.Name: CrossRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique message identifier for a cross request as assigned by the submitter of the request.

Fields.Name: FillMatchID
Fields.Description: Identifier assigned by a matching system to a match event containing multiple executions.

Fields.Name: FillMatchSubID
Fields.Description: Identifier assigned by a matching system to a price level (e.g. match step, clip) within a match event containing multiple executions.

Fields.Name: MassActionReason
Fields.Description: Reason for submission of mass action.

Fields.Name: MaximumPricePercentage
Fields.Description: Maximum deviation, in percentage terms, of an execution price from a reference price, e.g. the initial price of a match event.

Fields.Name: NotAffectedReason
Fields.Description: Reason for order being unaffected by mass action even though it belongs to the orders covered by MassActionScope(1374).

Fields.Name: TotalNotAffectedOrders
Fields.Description: Total number of orders unaffected by either the OrderMassActionRequest(35=CA) or OrderMassCancelRequest(35=Q).

Fields.Name: OrderOwnershipIndicator
Fields.Description: Change of ownership of an order to a specific party.

Fields.Name: LegAccount
Fields.Description: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

Fields.Name: InTheMoneyCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition.

Fields.Name: LegInTheMoneyCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition in general terms.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingInTheMoneyCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition in general terms.

Fields.Name: DerivativeInTheMoneyCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition in general terms.

Fields.Name: ContraryInstructionEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of InTheMoneyCondition(2681). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

Fields.Name: LegContraryInstructionEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of LegInTheMoneyCondition(2682). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingContraryInstructionEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of UnderlyingInTheMoneyCondition(2683). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

Fields.Name: DerivativeContraryInstructionEligibilityIndicator
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of DerivativeInTheMoneyCondition(2684). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

Fields.Name: CollateralMarketPrice
Fields.Description: Market price of the collateral, either from market sources or pre-agreed by the counterparties.

Fields.Name: CollateralPercentOverage
Fields.Description: Percentage of over-collateralization particularly when CollateralAmountType(2632) = 4 (Additional collateral value)

Fields.Name: NoSideCollateralAmounts
Fields.Description: Number of side collateral amount entries.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralAmountMarketID
Fields.Description: Market associated with the collateral amount.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralAmountMarketSegmentID
Fields.Description: Market segment associated with the collateral amount.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralAmountType
Fields.Description: The type of value in CurrentCollateralAmount(1704).

Fields.Name: SideCollateralCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the collateral; optional, defaults to the settlement currency if not specified. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralFXRate
Fields.Description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the SideCurrentCollateralAmount(2702) from the SideCollateralCurrency(2695) and the Currency(15).

Fields.Name: SideCollateralFXRateCalc
Fields.Description: Specifies whether or not SideCollateralFXRate(2696) should be multiplied or divided.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralMarketPrice
Fields.Description: Market price of the collateral, either from market sources or pre-agreed by the counterparties.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralPercentOverage
Fields.Description: Percentage of over-collateralization particularly when SideCollateralAmountType(2694) = 4 (Additional collateral value).

Fields.Name: SideCollateralPortfolioID
Fields.Description: Identifier of the collateral portfolio when reporting on a portfolio basis.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralType
Fields.Description: Type of collateral on deposit being reported.

Fields.Name: SideCurrentCollateralAmount
Fields.Description: Currency value currently attributed to the collateral.

Fields.Name: SideHaircutIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates, if "Y", that a stated valuation includes a haircut, e.g. that the stated value reflects the subtraction of the haircut. Note that a value of "N" does not imply a haircut is not applicable, only that the haircut (if any) is not reflected in the stated valuation.

Fields.Name: ExDestinationType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of execution destination for the order.

Fields.Name: MarketCondition
Fields.Description: Market condition. In the context of ESMA RTS 8 it is important that trading venues communicate the condition of the market, particularly "stressed" and "exceptional", in order to provide incentives for firms contributing to liquidity.

Fields.Name: NoQuoteAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of quote attributes entries.

Fields.Name: QuoteAttributeType
Fields.Description: The type of attribute for the quote.

Fields.Name: QuoteAttributeValue
Fields.Description: The value associated with the quote attribute type specified in QuoteAttributeType(2707).

Fields.Name: NoPriceQualifiers
Fields.Description: Number of price qualifiers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PriceQualifier
Fields.Description: Qualifier for price. May be used when the price needs to be explicitly qualified.

Fields.Name: MDValueTier
Fields.Description: Describes the reporting ranges for executed transactions.
Fields.Elaboration: In context of ESMA RTS 27 Article 9, the execution venue is required to report on transactions within several size ranges (in terms of a value and currency). The thresholds for these ranges are dependent on the type of financial instrument.

Fields.Name: MiscFeeQualifier
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the current entry contributes to the trade or transaction economics, i.e. affects NetMoney(118).

Fields.Name: MiscFeeDesc
Fields.Description: Can be used to provide a textual description of the fee type.

Fields.Name: FinancialInstrumentFullName
Fields.Description: The full normative name of the financial instrument.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of ESMA reference data, this is used to provide the full name of the instrument as defined by the Derivatives Service Bureau (DSB).

Fields.Name: EncodedFinancialInstrumentFullNameLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedFinancialInstrumentFullName(2716) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedFinancialInstrumentFullName
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the FinancialInstrumentFullName(2714) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the FinancialInstrumentFullName(2714) field.

Fields.Name: LegFinancialInstrumentFullName
Fields.Description: The full normative name of the multileg's financial instrument.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of ESMA reference data, this is used to provide the full name of the instrument as defined by the Derivatives Service Bureau (DSB).

Fields.Name: EncodedLegFinancialInstrumentFullNameLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) individual multileg instrument's EncodedLegFinancialInstrumentFullName(2719).

Fields.Name: EncodedLegFinancialInstrumentFullName
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegFinancialInstrumentFullName(2717) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegFinancialInstrumentFullName(2717) field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName
Fields.Description: The full normative name of the underlying financial instrument.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of ESMA reference data, this is used to provide the full name of the instrument as defined by the Derivatives Service Bureau (DSB).

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullNameLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) underlying instrument's EncodedUnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName(2722).

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName(2720) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingFinancialInstrumentFullName(2720) field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Curve time unit associated with the underlying index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Curve time multiplier for the underlying index.

Fields.Name: CommissionAmountSubType
Fields.Description: Further sub classification of the CommissionAmountType(2641).

Fields.Name: AllocCommissionAmountSubType
Fields.Description: Further sub classification of the AllocCommissionAmountType(2655).

Fields.Name: AllocLegRefID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for a specific leg (uniqueness not defined as part of the FIX specification). AllocLegRefID(2727tbd) references the value from LegID(1788) in the current multileg order or trade message specifying to which leg the allocation instance applies.

Fields.Name: FloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index identified in FloatingRateIndexID(2731).

Fields.Name: FloatingRateIndexCurveSpread
Fields.Description: Spread from the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: FloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the floating rate index identified in FloatingRateIndexID(2731).

Fields.Name: FloatingRateIndexID
Fields.Description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: FloatingRateIndexIDSource
Fields.Description: Source for the floating rate index identified in FloatingRateIndexID(2731).

Fields.Name: IndexRollMonth
Fields.Description: Month identified in the index roll.
Fields.Elaboration: Use "1" for January, "2" for February, etc.

Fields.Name: NoIndexRollMonths
Fields.Description: Number of instances of the index roll month.

Fields.Name: AssetSubType
Fields.Description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in AssetType(1940). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetSubType for code list of applicable values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II, ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2, this may indicate the 'Further sub product' or equity 'Parameter' fields.

Fields.Name: CommodityFinalPriceType
Fields.Description: Final price type of the commodity as specified by the trading venue.

Fields.Name: FinancialInstrumentShortName
Fields.Description: Short name of the financial instrument. Uses ISO 18774 (FINS) values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II this maps to ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 3 Field 7 and may be used in other RTS that requires a similar field.

Fields.Name: NextIndexRollDate
Fields.Description: Next index roll date.

Fields.Name: LegAssetSubType
Fields.Description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in LegAssetType(2069). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetSubType for code list of applicable values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II, ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2, this may indicate the 'Further sub product' or equity 'Parameter' fields.

Fields.Name: LegFinancialInstrumentShortName
Fields.Description: Short name of the financial instrument. Uses ISO 18774 (FISN) values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II this maps to ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 3 Field 7 and may be used in other RTS that requires a similar field.

Fields.Name: SecondaryAssetSubType
Fields.Description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in SecondaryAssetType(1979). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetSubType for code list of applicable values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II, ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2, this may indicate the 'Further sub product' or equity 'Parameter' fields.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFinancialInstrumentShortName
Fields.Description: Short name of the financial instrument. Uses ISO 18774 (FINS) values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II this maps to ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 3 Field 7 and may be used in other RTS that requires a similar field.

Fields.Name: LegSecondaryAssetSubType
Fields.Description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in LegSecondaryAssetType(2079). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetSubType for code list of applicable values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II RTS 23 Annex I Table 2, this may indicate the 'Further sub product' or equity 'Parameter' fields.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAssetSubType
Fields.Description: Used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingAssetType(2015). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetSubType for code list of applicable values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II, ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2, this may indicate the 'Further sub product' or equity 'Parameter' fields.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSecondaryAssetSubType
Fields.Description: May be used to provide a more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingSecondaryAssetType(2083). See https://www.fixtrading.org/codelists/AssetSubType for code list of applicable values.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of MiFID II, ESMA RTS 23 Annex I Table 2, this may indicate the 'Further sub product' or equity 'Parameter' fields.

Fields.Name: NoReferenceDataDates
Fields.Description: Number of instances of reference data dates.

Fields.Name: ReferenceDataDate
Fields.Description: Reference data entry's date-time of the type specified in ReferenceDataDateType(2748).

Fields.Name: ReferenceDataDateType
Fields.Description: Reference data entry's date-time type.

Fields.Name: ExecutionTimestamp
Fields.Description: Time of the individual execution.

Fields.Name: ReportingPx
Fields.Description: Represents the reportable price on fill when an instance of the Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 73 (Execution Venue) is present to prevent having to compute running totals.

Fields.Name: ReportingQty
Fields.Description: Represents the reportable quantity on fill when an instance of the Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 73 (Execution Venue) is present to prevent having to compute running totals.

Fields.Name: DeliveryRouteOrCharter
Fields.Description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight contracts.

Fields.Name: ReturnTrigger
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of return or payout trigger for the swap or forward.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryRouteOrCharter
Fields.Description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight contracts.

Fields.Name: LegReturnTrigger
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of return or payout trigger for the swap or forward.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryRouteOrCharter
Fields.Description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight contracts.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingReturnTrigger
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of return or payout trigger for the swap or forward.

Fields.Name: AllocRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the request message.

Fields.Name: GroupAmount
Fields.Description: Indicates the total notional units or amount of an allocation group. Includes any allocated units or amount.
Fields.Elaboration: Whether notional units or amount is used depends on the type of listed derivative contract and the clearinghouse. A notional unit is (price x quantity) without the derivative's contract value factor.

Fields.Name: GroupRemainingAmount
Fields.Description: Indicates the remaining notional units or amount of an allocation group that has not yet been allocated.
Fields.Elaboration: Whether notional units or amount is used depends on the type of listed derivative contract and the clearinghouse. A notional unit is (price x quantity) without the derivative's contract value factor.

Fields.Name: AllocGroupAmount
Fields.Description: Indicates the notional units or amount being allocated.
Fields.Elaboration: Whether notional units or amount is used depends on the type of listed derivative contract and the clearinghouse. A notional unit is (price x quantity) without the derivative's contract value factor.

Fields.Name: PriceMarkup
Fields.Description: Price offset of the markup denominated in the price type of the trade.
Fields.Elaboration: The field is expressed in a value that can simply be added to or subtracted from the (clean) price to reach the marked- up price. E.g., a percent of par price of 98 marked up to 98.5 should be 0.5, an FX rate of 1.17936 marked up to 1.19 should be 0.01064, a stock price of 22.75 marked up to 22.9 should be 0.15, etc.

Fields.Name: AveragePriceType
Fields.Description: The average pricing model used for block trades.

Fields.Name: AveragePriceStartTime
Fields.Description: Start of the time period during which price averaging occurred.

Fields.Name: AveragePriceEndTime
Fields.Description: End of the time period during which price averaging occurred.

Fields.Name: OrderPercentOfTotalVolume
Fields.Description: For Percent-of-volume (POV) average pricing this is the target percentage this order quantity represents of the total trading volume of an instrument during the specified time period. This provides the data needed to ensure that the average price is fair based on the total sum of grouped POV trades.
Fields.Elaboration: For example, if during the POV time period there are 5 trades including this one with a total volume of 5000 and this trade has a quantity of 1000 then the OrderPercentOfTotalVolume(2766) of this trade is 20 percent expressed as "0.20".

Fields.Name: AllocGroupStatus
Fields.Description: Status of the trade give-up relative to the group identified in AllocGroupID(1730).

Fields.Name: AllocRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Status of the AllocationInstructionAlertRequest(35=DU).

Fields.Name: AllocAvgPxIndicator
Fields.Description: Average pricing indicator at the allocation level.

Fields.Name: AllocAvgPxGroupID
Fields.Description: Used by submitting firm to group trades being sub-allocated into an average price group. The trades in the average price group will be used to calculate an average price for the group.

Fields.Name: PreviousAllocGroupID
Fields.Description: When reporting a group change by the central counterparty to allocations of trades for the same instrument traded at the same price this identifies the previous group identifier.

Fields.Name: NoMatchExceptions
Fields.Description: Number of match exceptions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionType
Fields.Description: Type of matching exception.

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionElementType
Fields.Description: Identifies the data point used in the matching operation which resulted in an exception.

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionElementName
Fields.Description: The matching exception data point name, for example: "Trade currency". This may be used for display purposes, providing a corresponding description for the value in MatchExceptionElementType(2774).

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionAllocValue
Fields.Description: The allocating party's data value used in the match operation.

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionConfirmValue
Fields.Description: The confirming party's data value used in the match operation.

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionToleranceValue
Fields.Description: The data element's tolerance value. Omitted if no tolerance is allowed or not applicable.

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionToleranceValueType
Fields.Description: The type of value in MatchExceptionToleranceValue(2778). Omitted if no tolerance is allowed or not applicable.
Fields.Elaboration: For example, if the tolerance for accrued interest is 0.01% of total accrued interest then MatchExceptionElementType(2774)=1 (Accrued interest), MatchExceptionToleranceValueType(2779)=2 (Percentage) and MatchExcecptionToleranceValue(2778)=0.0001. If tolerance for the exchange rate of an FX trade is "0.001" then MatchExceptionElementType(2774)=2 (Deal pPrice), MatchExceptionToleranceValueType(2779)=1 (Fixed amount) and MatchExcecptionToleranceValue(2778)=0.001.

Fields.Name: MatchExceptionText
Fields.Description: Description of the exception.

Fields.Name: NoMatchingDataPoints
Fields.Description: Number of matching data points in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: MatchingDataPointIndicator
Fields.Description: Data point's matching type.

Fields.Name: MatchingDataPointValue
Fields.Description: Value of the matching data point.

Fields.Name: MatchingDataPointType
Fields.Description: Identifies the data point used in the matching operation.
Fields.Elaboration: Values may not have applicable tolerance values, in this case this means the data point was used for matching but did not match.

Fields.Name: MatchingDataPointName
Fields.Description: The matching data point name, for example: "Trade currency". This may be used for display purposes, providing a corresponding description for the value in MatchingDataPointType(2784).

Fields.Name: TradeAggregationRequestID
Fields.Description: The message identifier for the trade aggregation request.

Fields.Name: TradeAggregationRequestRefID
Fields.Description: Reference identifier to a previously sent trade aggregation message being cancelled or replaced.

Fields.Name: TradeAggregationTransType
Fields.Description: Identifies the trade aggregation transaction type.

Fields.Name: AggregatedQty
Fields.Description: Total quantity of orders or fills quantity aggregated.

Fields.Name: TradeAggregationRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Status of the trade aggregation request.

Fields.Name: TradeAggregationRejectReason
Fields.Description: Reason for trade aggregation request being rejected.

Fields.Name: TradeAggregationReportID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the TradeAggregationReport(35=DX).

Fields.Name: AvgSpotRate
Fields.Description: The average FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: AvgForwardPoints
Fields.Description: The average forward points. May be a negative value.

Fields.Name: OffshoreIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of the currency rate being used. This is relevant for currencies that have offshore rate that different from onshore rate.

Fields.Name: FXBenchmarkRateFix
Fields.Description: Specifies the foreign exchange benchmark rate fixing to be used in valuing the transaction. For example "London 4 p.m." or "Tokyo 3 p.m."

Fields.Name: EncodedMatchExceptionTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMatchExceptionText(2798) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedMatchExecptionText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MatchExceptionText(2780) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MatchExceptionText(2780) field.

Fields.Name: PayReportID
Fields.Description: Unique ID of the PayManagementReport(35=EA) message.

Fields.Name: PayDisputeReason
Fields.Description: Used to provide the reason for disputing a request or report. See https://www.fixtrading.org/packages/PayDisputeReason for the list of applicable values.

Fields.Name: EncodedReplaceText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ReplaceText(2805) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ReplaceText(2805) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedReplaceTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedReplaceText(2801) field.

Fields.Name: PayReportRefID
Fields.Description: Reference identifier of the PayManagementReport(35=EA). To be used with PayReportTransType(2804)=1 (Replace).

Fields.Name: PayReportTransType
Fields.Description: Identifies the message transaction type.

Fields.Name: ReplaceText
Fields.Description: Identifies the reason for amendment.

Fields.Name: PayReportStatus
Fields.Description: Identifies status of the payment report.

Fields.Name: CancelText
Fields.Description: Identifies the reason for cancelation.

Fields.Name: EncodedCancelText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the CancelText(2807) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the CancelText(2807) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedCancelTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedCancelText(2808) field.

Fields.Name: PayRequestRefID
Fields.Description: Reference identifier of the PayManagementRequest(35=DY). To be used with PayRequestTransType(2811)=1 (Cancel).

Fields.Name: PayRequestTransType
Fields.Description: Identifies the message transaction type.

Fields.Name: PayRequestID
Fields.Description: Unique ID of the PayManagementRequest(35=DY) message.

Fields.Name: PayRequestStatus
Fields.Description: Identifies status of the request being responded to.

Fields.Name: EncodedPostTradePaymentDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the PostTradePaymentDesc(2820) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the PostTradePaymentDesc(2820) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedPostTradePaymentDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedPostTradePaymentDesc(2814) field.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentAccount
Fields.Description: The cash account on the books of the receiver of the request or the sender of the report to be debited or credited.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentAmount
Fields.Description: The payment amount for the specified PostTradePaymentType(2824).

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency in which PostTradePaymentAmount(2817) is denominated. Uses ISO 4271 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentDebitOrCredit
Fields.Description: Payment side of this individual payment from the requesting firm's perspective.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentDesc
Fields.Description: A short descriptive name given to the payment, e.g. Premium, Upfront, etc. The description may be used as reference.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentID
Fields.Description: The identifier for the individual payment.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentLinkID
Fields.Description: Used to link a group of payments together, e.g. cross-currency payments associated with a swap.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentStatus
Fields.Description: Used to indicate the status of a post-trade payment.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentType
Fields.Description: Type of post-trade payment. See ISITC "Payments Cash Purpose Codes" for list of payment type codes to use available at https://isitc.org/market-practices/reference-data-and-standards-market-practice and select "ISITC Classification Code List".

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentCalculationDate
Fields.Description: The (actual) date the periodic payments calculations are made.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentValueDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted (for holidays and other non-business days) payment date on which the payment is expected to settle.

Fields.Name: PostTradePaymentFinalValueDate
Fields.Description: The actual or final payment date on which the payment was made.

Fields.Name: CurrentDisplayPrice
Fields.Description: Price at which the order is currently displayed to the market. Can be used on order messages, e.g. NewOrderSingle(35=D), to provide the current displayed price of a parent order when splitting it into smaller child orders.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of US CAT this is used when reporting new child orders.

Fields.Name: DuplicateClOrdIDIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate that a ClOrdID(11) value is an intentional duplicate of a previously sent value. Allows to avoid the rejection of an order with OrdRejReason(103) = 6 (Duplicate Order).
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of US CAT this can be used when the recipient of a previously routed order requires the same identifier to be re-used for a new route.

Fields.Name: EventInitiatorType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of entity who initiated an event, e.g. modification or cancellation of an order or quote.

Fields.Name: NBBOEntryType
Fields.Description: Type of NBBO information.

Fields.Name: NBBOPrice
Fields.Description: Price related to NBBO. NBBOEntryType(2831) may be used to indicate entry type, e.g. bid or offer.

Fields.Name: NBBOQty
Fields.Description: Quantity related to NBBO. NBBOEntryType(2831) may be used to indicte entry type, e.g. bid or offer.

Fields.Name: NBBOSource
Fields.Description: Source of NBBO information.

Fields.Name: OrderOriginationFirmID
Fields.Description: Identifier for the original owner of an order as part of the OrderAggregationGrp component. Use the Parties component with PartyRole(452) = 13 (Order Origination Firm) to identify the original owner of an individual order outside of an aggregation.

Fields.Name: OrderTime
Fields.Description: Timestamp for the assignment of a (unique) identifier to an order.

Fields.Name: SingleQuoteIndicator
Fields.Description: Used to indicate whether the quoting system allows only one quote to be active at a time for the quote issuer or market maker.

Fields.Name: CurrentWorkingPrice
Fields.Description: Current working price of the order relative to the state of the order.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of US CAT this can be used for the current price of the parent order when reporting a split into new (child) orders.

Fields.Name: TrdRegTimestampManualIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a given timestamp was manually captured.

Fields.Name: CollateralReinvestmentRate
Fields.Description: Interest rate received for collateral reinvestment.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of EU SFTR this is the reinvestment interest rate received from cash collateral made by the lender. If there are multiple reinvestment types, this is an average rate.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the underlying instrument the entity applies to by referencing the underlying instrument's UnderlyingID(2874).

Fields.Name: CollateralReinvestmentAmount
Fields.Description: The cash amount of the specified re-investment type.

Fields.Name: CollateralReinvestmentCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency denomination of the re-invested cash amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: CollateralReinvestmentType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of investment the cash collateral is re-invested in.

Fields.Name: NoCollateralReinvestments
Fields.Description: Number of instances of CollateralReinvestmentType(2844) in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: FundingSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the funding source used to finance margin or collateralized loan.

Fields.Name: FundingSourceCurrency
Fields.Description: Currency denomination of the market value of the funding source. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: FundingSourceMarketValue
Fields.Description: Market value of the funding source.

Fields.Name: NoFundingSources
Fields.Description: Number of instances of FundingSource(2846) in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: MarginDirection
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the margin described is posted or received.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralReinvestmentRate
Fields.Description: Interest rate received for collateral reinvestment.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of EU SFTR this is the reinvestment interest rate received from cash collateral made by the lender. If there are multiple reinvestment types, this is an average rate.

Fields.Name: SideUnderlyingRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the underlying instrument the entity applies to by referencing the underlying instrument's UnderlyingID(2874).

Fields.Name: NoSideCollateralReinvestments
Fields.Description: Number of instances of SideCollateralReinvestmentType(2867) in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralReinvestmentAmount
Fields.Description: The cash amount of the specified re-investment type.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralReinvestmentCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency denomination of the re-invested cash amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: SideCollateralReinvestmentType
Fields.Description: Indicates the type of investment the cash collateral is re-invested in.

Fields.Name: CollateralizationValueDate
Fields.Description: Date when the collateral is to be assessed or assigned.

Fields.Name: RegulatoryReportTypeBusinessDate
Fields.Description: The business date on which the event identified in RegulatoryReportType(1934) took place.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of EU SFTR reports with a RegulatoryReportType(1934) value 7 (Post-trade valuation), 31 (Collateral update) or 32 (Margin update), the business date on which the business event took place, which results in the information contained in the report.

Fields.Name: ClearingPortfolioID
Fields.Description: When the transaction is cleared and included in a portfolio of transactions this identifies the portfolio by its unique identifier.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of EU SFTR reporting this applies to cleared transactions grouped in a portfolio for which margins are exchanged.

Fields.Name: NoTransactionAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of instances of TransactionAttributeType(2872) in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: TransactionAttributeType
Fields.Description: Type of attribute(s) or characteristic(s) associated with the transaction.

Fields.Name: TransactionAttributeValue
Fields.Description: Value associated with the specificed TransactionAttributeType(2872).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingID
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the underlying instrument within the context of a message.
Fields.Elaboration: The UnderlyingID(2874) can be referenced by other fields, for example UnderlyingRefID(tbd2841) and SideUnderlyingRefID(2863), from other components . The scope of uniqueness is agreed upon between counterparties.

Fields.Name: PosAmtPrice
Fields.Description: The price used to calculate the PosAmt(708).
Fields.Elaboration: This may be used for certain PosAmtType(707) values where the PosAmt(708) is based on the current price of the position's security. In the context of EU SFTR reporting, this is the price used to calculate the loan value for securities loan and borrowing, and buy-sell back. The price may be expressed in units or percentage of the underlying security, yield or an absolute amount that ignores netting. For Buy/Sellback it expresses the initial spot price.

Fields.Name: PosAmtPriceType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of price for PosAmtPrice(2876).

Fields.Name: TerminationDate
Fields.Description: The date of a contract's early termination or other post-trade event when the event is prior to the contract natural end or maturity not defined as part of the security's reference data or contractual terms/agreement.

Fields.Name: CouponOtherDayCount
Fields.Description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in CouponDayCount(1950).

Fields.Name: LegCouponOtherDayCount
Fields.Description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in LegCouponDayCount(2165).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCouponOtherDayCount
Fields.Description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in UnderlyingCouponDayCount(1993).

Fields.Name: NoAdditionalTermBondRefs
Fields.Description: Number of bonds in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondSecurityID
Fields.Description: Security identifier of the bond.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source scheme of the AdditionalTermBondSecurityID(40001) value.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the bond.

Fields.Name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc(40005) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the bond value is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondIssuer
Fields.Description: Issuer of the bond.

Fields.Name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer(40009) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondSeniority
Fields.Description: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondCouponType
Fields.Description: Coupon type of the bond.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondCouponRate
Fields.Description: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
Fields.Description: The maturity date of the bond.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondParValue
Fields.Description: The par value of the bond.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
Fields.Description: Total issued amount of the bond.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermBondDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

Fields.Name: NoAdditionalTerms
Fields.Description: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

Fields.Name: AdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

Fields.Name: NoCashSettlTerms
Fields.Description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: CashSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlAmount(40034) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: CashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
Fields.Description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for the purpose of cash settlement.
Fields.Elaboration: Associated with ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Date.

Fields.Name: CashSettlValuationTime
Fields.Description: The time of valuation.

Fields.Name: CashSettlBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: CashSettlQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

Fields.Name: CashSettlQuoteAmount
Fields.Description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specifed, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Quotation Amount.

Fields.Name: CashSettlQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlQuoteAmount(40028) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

Fields.Name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
Fields.Description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevent obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Minimum Quotation Amount.

Fields.Name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount(40030) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDealer
Fields.Description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Dealer.

Fields.Name: CashSettlBusinessDays
Fields.Description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.
Fields.Elaboration: If a cash settlement amount is specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days following the calculation of the final price. If a cash settlement amount is not specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days after all conditions to settlement are satisfied. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Date.

Fields.Name: CashSettlAmount
Fields.Description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.
Fields.Elaboration: If not specified this is not to be included in the message and the parties to the trade are expected to calculate the value. The value is the greater of (a) floating rate payer calculation amount x (reference price - final price) or (b) zero. Price values are all expressed as a percentage. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Amount

Fields.Name: CashSettlRecoveryFactor
Fields.Description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount calculated is (1 - CashSettlRecoveryFactor(40035)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

Fields.Name: CashSettlFixedTermIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

Fields.Name: CashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in CashSettlAmount(40034). For cash settlement this specifies whether quotations should be obtained inclusive or not of accrued interest. For physical settlement this specifies whether the buyer should deliver the obligation with an outstanding principal balance that includes or excludes accrued interest.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Include/Exclude Accrued Interest.

Fields.Name: CashSettlValuationMethod
Fields.Description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Method

Fields.Name: CashSettlTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

Fields.Name: NoContractualDefinitions
Fields.Description: Number of financing definitions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ContractualDefinition
Fields.Description: Specifies which contract definition, such as those published by ISDA, will apply for the terms of the trade. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-definitions for values.

Fields.Name: NoContractualMatrices
Fields.Description: Number of contractual matrices in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ContractualMatrixSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the applicable contract matrix. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/matrix-type-1-0.xml for values.

Fields.Name: ContractualMatrixDate
Fields.Description: The publication date of the applicable version of the contract matrix. If not specified, the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

Fields.Name: ContractualMatrixTerm
Fields.Description: Specifies the applicable key into the relevent contract matrix. In the case of 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions, the ContractualMatrixTerm(40045) is not applicable and is to be omitted. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-matrix-transaction-type for values.

Fields.Name: NoFinancingTermSupplements
Fields.Description: Number of financing terms supplements in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: FinancingTermSupplementDesc
Fields.Description: Identifies the applicable contractual supplement. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-supplement for values.

Fields.Name: FinancingTermSupplementDate
Fields.Description: The publication date of the applicable version of the contractual supplement.

Fields.Name: NoStreams
Fields.Description: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: StreamType
Fields.Description: Type of swap stream.

Fields.Name: StreamDesc
Fields.Description: A short descriptive name given to the payment stream. Eg. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as reference.

Fields.Name: StreamPaySide
Fields.Description: The side of the party paying the stream.

Fields.Name: StreamReceiveSide
Fields.Description: The side of the party receiving the stream.

Fields.Name: StreamNotional
Fields.Description: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. Use the PaymentScheduleGrp component to specify the rate steps.

Fields.Name: StreamCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the StreamNotional(40054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: StreamText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted effective date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the effective date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative effective date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative effective date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative effective date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted effective date.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted termination date.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: StreamTerminationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted termination date.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust calculation periods, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

Fields.Name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

Fields.Name: StreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

Fields.Name: StreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

Fields.Name: StreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: NoSettlRateFallbacks
Fields.Description: Number of settlement rate fallbacks in the repeating group

Fields.Name: SettlRatePostponementMaximumDays
Fields.Description: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceding to this method.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of the rate information.

Fields.Name: SettlRatePostponementSurvey
Fields.Description: Indicates whether to request a settlement rate quote from the market.

Fields.Name: SettlRatePostponementCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the settlement rate postponement calculation agent.

Fields.Name: NoProvisions
Fields.Description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ProvisionType
Fields.Description: Type of provisions.

Fields.Name: ProvisionDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

Fields.Name: ProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: ProvisionDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted date of the provision.

Fields.Name: ProvisionDateTenorPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

Fields.Name: ProvisionDateTenorUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in ProvisionCalculationAgent(40098) or in the ProvisionParties component.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
Fields.Description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
Fields.Description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: The instrument provision option’s exercise style.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
Fields.Description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
Fields.Description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
Fields.Description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
Fields.Description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
Fields.Description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
Fields.Description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlMethod
Fields.Description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of quote information.

Fields.Name: ProvisionText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTime
Fields.Description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The cash settlement valuation date adjustment business day convention. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
Fields.Description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
Fields.Description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
Fields.Description: Number of provision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
Fields.Description: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(40144).

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
Fields.Description: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
Fields.Description: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

Fields.Name: NoProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
Fields.Description: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
Fields.Description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40173).

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: NoProvisionPartyIDs
Fields.Description: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

Fields.Name: ProvisionPartyID
Fields.Description: The party identifier/code for the payment settlement party.

Fields.Name: ProvisionPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies class or source of the ProvisionPartyID(40175) value.

Fields.Name: ProvisionPartyRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type or role of ProvisionPartyID(40175) specified.

Fields.Name: NoProvisionPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

Fields.Name: ProvisionPartySubID
Fields.Description: Party sub-identifier, if applicable, for ProvisionPartyID(40175).

Fields.Name: ProvisionPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: The type of ProvisionPartySubID(40179).

Fields.Name: NoProtectionTerms
Fields.Description: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermNotional
Fields.Description: The notional amount of protection coverage.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Floating Rate Payer Calculation Amount.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermCurrency
