Fields.Description: The currency of ProtectionTermNotional(40182). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermSellerNotifies
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. ProtectionTermSellerNotifies(40184)=Y indicates that the seller notifies.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. ProtectionTermBuyerNotifies(40185)=Y indicates that the buyer notifies.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermStandardSources
Fields.Description: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (ProtectionTermStandardSources(40187)=Y) or not.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
Fields.Description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventNewsSource
Fields.Description: Newspaper or electronic news service or source that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

Fields.Name: NoProtectionTermEvents
Fields.Description: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Event_Types for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventValue
Fields.Description: Protection term event value appropriate to ProtectionTermEvenType(40192). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Event_Types for applicable event type values.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventCurrency
Fields.Description: Applicable currency if ProtectionTermEventValue(40193) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for protection term events.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with protection term events.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventDayType
Fields.Description: Day type for events that specify a period and unit.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Rate source for events that specify a rate source, e.g. Floating rate interest shortfall.

Fields.Name: NoProtectionTermEventQualifiers
Fields.Description: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermEventQualifier
Fields.Description: Protection term event qualifier. Used to further qualify ProtectionTermEventType(40192).

Fields.Name: NoProtectionTermObligations
Fields.Description: Number of obligations in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermObligationType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of obligation applicable to the protection terms. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Obligation_Types for code list of applicable obligation types.

Fields.Name: ProtectionTermObligationValue
Fields.Description: Protection term obligation value appropriate to ProtectionTermObligationType(40202). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Obligation_Types for applicable obligation type values.

Fields.Name: NoPhysicalSettlTerms
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PhysicalSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PhysicalSettlBusinessDays
Fields.Description: The number of business days used in the determination of physical settlement. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this element is used.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Business Day.

Fields.Name: PhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
Fields.Description: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

Fields.Name: PhysicalSettlTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

Fields.Name: NoPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of deliverable obligation applicable for physical settlement. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Deliverable_Obligation_Types for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

Fields.Name: PhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
Fields.Description: Physical settlement deliverable obligation value appropriate to PhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(40210). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Deliverable_Obligation_Types for applicable obligation type values.

Fields.Name: NoPayments
Fields.Description: Number of additional settlement or bullet payments.

Fields.Name: PaymentType
Fields.Description: Type of payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentPaySide
Fields.Description: The side of the party paying the payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentReceiveSide
Fields.Description: The side of the party receiving the payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency in which PaymentAmount(40217) is denominated. Uses ISO 4271 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentAmount
Fields.Description: The total payment amount.

Fields.Name: PaymentPrice
Fields.Description: The price determining the payment amount expressed in terms specified in PaymentPriceType(40919) and expressed in market format.

Fields.Name: PaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted payment date.

Fields.Name: PaymentBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted payment date.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionValue
Fields.Description: Applicable value for LegMarketDisruptionEvent(41468).

Fields.Name: PaymentDiscountFactor
Fields.Description: The value representing the discount factor used to calculate the present value of the cash flow.

Fields.Name: PaymentPresentValueAmount
Fields.Description: The amount representing the present value of the forecast payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentPresentValueCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the PaymentPresentValueAmount(40225) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlStyle
Fields.Description: Payment settlement style.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource(40087) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains a value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: PaymentText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a sdtandard value does not apply. Identifies the payment type when PaymentType(40213) = 99 (Other).

Fields.Name: NoPaymentSettls
Fields.Description: Number of additional settlements or bullet payments.

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlAmount
Fields.Description: The payment settlement amount.

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the PaymentSettlAmount(40231) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentSettlPartyIDs
Fields.Description: Number of parties identified in the additional settlement or bullet payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlPartyID
Fields.Description: The payment settlement party identifier.

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of PaymentSettlPartyID(40234) value (e.g. BIC).

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlPartyRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the role of PaymentSettlPartyID(40234) (e.g. the beneficiary's bank or depository institution).

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlPartyRoleQualifier
Fields.Description: Qualifies the value of PaymentSettlPartyRole(40236).

Fields.Name: NoPaymentSettlPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlPartySubID
Fields.Description: Party sub-identifier, if applicable, for PaymentSettlPartyRole(40236).

Fields.Name: PaymentSettlPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: The type of PaymentSettlPartySubID(40239) value.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreams
Fields.Description: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegStreamType
Fields.Description: Type of swap stream.

Fields.Name: LegStreamDesc
Fields.Description: A short descriptive name given to the payment stream, e.g. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as a reference.

Fields.Name: LegStreamPaySide
Fields.Description: The side of the party paying the stream.

Fields.Name: LegStreamReceiveSide
Fields.Description: The side of the party receiving the stream.

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotional
Fields.Description: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. The LegPaymentSchedule component should be used for specifying the steps.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the LegStreamNotional(40246) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegStreamText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted effective date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's effective date or relative effective date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's effective date or relative effective date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the effective date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative effective date offset.

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative effective date offset.

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative effective date offset.

Fields.Name: LegStreamEffectiveDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted effective date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted termination date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTerminationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted termination date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust calculation periods, e.g. "GLBO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

Fields.Name: LegStreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

Fields.Name: LegStreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: NoCashSettlDealers
Fields.Description: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: NoBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of payment stream applicable to the swap stream associated with the instrument leg.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamMarketRate
Fields.Description: Used only for credit index trade. This contains the credit spread ("fair value") at which the trade was executed. The market rate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. This is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamDelayIndicator
Fields.Description: Applicable to credit default swaps on mortgage backed securities to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed amount. Residential mortgage backed securities typically have a payment delay of 5 days between the coupon date of the reference obligation and the payment date of the synthetic swap. Commercial mortage backed securities do not typically have a payment delay, with both payment dates (the coupon date of the reference obligation and the payment date of the synthetic swap) being on the 25th of each month.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency that the stream settles in (to support swaps that settle in a currency different from the notional currency). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in the payment stream calculations.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamAccrualDays
Fields.Description: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamDiscountType
Fields.Description: The method of calculating discounted payment amounts.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamDiscountRate
Fields.Description: Discount rate. The rate is expressed in decimal, e.g. 5% is expressed as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamDiscountRateDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention applied to the LegPaymentStreamDiscountRate(40286).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingMethod
Fields.Description: Compounding method.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInterimPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of payments.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of payments.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFirstPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first payment date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLastRegularPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last regular payment date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when payment dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamResetDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the reset dates are relative to an anchor date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's reset date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's reset date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamResetFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for frequency of resets.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamResetFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with frequency of resets.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamResetWeeklyRollConvention
Fields.Description: Used to specify the day of the week in which the reset occurs for payments that reset on a weekly basis.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the initial fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted initial fixing date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative rate cut-off date offset.
Fields.Elaboration: This is generally the number of days preceeding the period end date or termination date, as appropriate, for the specified floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRate
Fields.Description: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixedAmount
Fields.Description: The leg instrument payment stream's fixed payment amount. In a CDS, this can be an alternative to LegPaymentStreamRate(40326).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateOrAmountCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency in which LegPaymentStreamFixedAmount(40327) or LegPaymentStreamRate(40326) is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFutureValueNotional
Fields.Description: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex
Fields.Description: The payment stream floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexSource
Fields.Description: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpread
Fields.Description: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndex(40331).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determineds the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
Fields.Description: The inflation lag period day type.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the inflation index level from multiple points. The most common is linear method.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationIndexSource
Fields.Description: The inflation index reference source.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationPublicationSource
Fields.Description: The publication source, such as relevant web site, news publication or a government body, where inflation information is obtained.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationInitialIndexLevel
Fields.Description: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInflationFallbackBondApplicable
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8, is applicable or not. If not specified, the default value is "Y" (True/Yes).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFRADiscounting
Fields.Description: The method of Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) discounting, if any, that will apply.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableRefCurrency
Fields.Description: Non-deliverable settlement reference currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable settlement terms. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the non-deliverable fixing dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegSettlRateFallbackRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.

Fields.Name: NoLegNonDeliverableFixingDates
Fields.Description: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegNonDeliverableFixingDate
Fields.Description: The non-deliverable fixing date. Type of date is specified in LegNonDeliverableFixingDateType(40369).

Fields.Name: LegNonDeliverableFixingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: LegSettlRateFallbackReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When LegSettlRateFallbackRateSource(40366) = 3(ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When PaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource(40371) = 3(ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: SettlRateFallbackRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentSchedules
Fields.Description: Number of swap schedules in the repeating group

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStubType
Fields.Description: Indicates to which stub this schedule applies.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on which the value is adjusted, or calculated if a future value notional for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)), or the start date of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentSchedulePaySide
Fields.Description: The side of the party paying the step schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleReceiveSide
Fields.Description: The side of the party receiving the step schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleNotional
Fields.Description: The notional value for this step schedule, or amount of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency for this step schedule. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRate
Fields.Description: The rate value for this step schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpread
Fields.Description: The spread value for this step schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixedAmount
Fields.Description: The explicit payment amount for this step schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixedCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue
Fields.Description: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStepRate
Fields.Description: The percentage by which the notional changes on each step date. The percentage is either a percentage applied to the initial notional amount or the previous outstanding notional, depending on the value specified in LegPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo(40395). The percentage can be either positive or negative.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetRate
Fields.Description: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies whether the LegPaymentScheduleStepRate(40393) or LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40392) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleWeight
Fields.Description: Floating rate observation weight for cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingTime
Fields.Description: The fxing time associated with the step schedule.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Business center for determining fixing time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangePaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the interim exchange payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted interim exchange date.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentScheduleRateSources
Fields.Description: Number of rate sources in the repeating group

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSourceType
Fields.Description: Rate source type.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleReferencePage
Fields.Description:
Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.
For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When RateSource(1446) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStubs
Fields.Description: Number of stubs in the repeating group

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubType
Fields.Description: Stub type.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubLength
Fields.Description: Optional indication whether stub is shorter or longer than the regular swap period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubRate
Fields.Description: The agreed upon fixed rate for this stub.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubFixedAmount
Fields.Description: A fixed payment amount for the stub.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubFixedCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the fixed payment amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex
Fields.Description: The stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexSource
Fields.Description: The source for the stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateSpread
Fields.Description: Spread from floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the stub index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2
Fields.Description: The second stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2Source
Fields.Description: The source for the second stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2CurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit multiplier for the stub floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2CurveUnit
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit associated with the stub floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the second floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateSpread
Fields.Description: Spread from the second floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the second stub index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2CapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubIndex2FloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: NoLegProvisions
Fields.Description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionType
Fields.Description: Type of provisions.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted date of the provision.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionDateTenorPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the leg provision's tenor period.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionDateTenorUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the leg provision's tenor period.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in LegProvisionCalculationAgent(40456) or in the ProvisionParties component.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
Fields.Description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
Fields.Description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: The instrument provision option exercise style.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
Fields.Description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
Fields.Description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
Fields.Description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
Fields.Description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
Fields.Description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
Fields.Description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlMethod
Fields.Description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of quote information.

Fields.Name: BusinessCenter
Fields.Description: A business center whose calendar is used for date adjustment, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

Fields.Name: NoLegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
Fields.Description: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
Fields.Description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40521).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
Fields.Description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
Fields.Description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
Fields.Description: Number of provision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
Fields.Description: A predetermined option exercise date unadjusted or adjusted depending on LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(40497).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option relevant underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
Fields.Description: The first date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
Fields.Description: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueTime
Fields.Description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

Fields.Name: NoLegProvisionPartyIDs
Fields.Description: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionPartyID
Fields.Description: The party identifier/code for the payment settlement party.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of LegProvisionPartyID(40534).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionPartyRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type or role of LegProvisionPartyID(40534) specified.

Fields.Name: NoLegProvisionPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionPartySubID
Fields.Description: Party sub-identifier, if applicable, for LegProvisionPartyRole(40536).

Fields.Name: LegProvisionPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: The type of LegProvisionPartySubID(40538) value.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreams
Fields.Description: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamType
Fields.Description: Type of swap stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamDesc
Fields.Description: A short descriptive name given to payment stream. Eg. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as a reference.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamPaySide
Fields.Description: The side of the party paying the stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamReceiveSide
Fields.Description: The side of the party receiving the stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamNotional
Fields.Description: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. Use SwapSchedule for steps.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingStreamNotional(40545) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted termination date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted termination date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the calculation periods, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of payment stream applicable to the swap stream associated with the underlying instrument.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMarketRate
Fields.Description: Used only for credit index trade. This contains the credit spread ("fair value") at which the trade was executed. The market rate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. This is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDelayIndicator
Fields.Description: Applicable to credit default swaps on mortgage backed securities to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed amount. Residential mortgage backed securities typically have a payment delay of 5 days between the coupon date of the reference obligation and the payment date of the synthetic swap. Commercial mortage backed securities do not typically have a payment delay, with both payment dates (the coupon date of the reference obligation and the payment date of the synthetic swap) being on the 25th of each month.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency that the stream settles in (to support swaps that settle in a currency different from the notional currency). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in the payment stream calculations.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamAccrualDays
Fields.Description: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountType
Fields.Description: The method of calculating discounted payment amounts

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountRate
Fields.Description: Discount rate. The rate is expressed in decimal, e.g. 5% is expressed as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountRateDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention applied to the UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountRate(40575).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingMethod
Fields.Description: Compounding Method.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterimPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of payments.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of payments.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first payment date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLastRegularPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last regular payment date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when payment dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the reset dates are relative to an anchor date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's reset date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's reset date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for frequency of resets.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with frequency of resets.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetWeeklyRollConvention
Fields.Description: Used to specify the day of the week in which the reset occurs for payments that reset on a weekly basis.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the initial fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted initial fixing date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
