Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate
Fields.Description: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixedAmount
Fields.Description: The underlying payment stream's fixed payment amount. In CDS an alternative to UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate(40615).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateOrAmountCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency in which UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixedAmount(40616) or UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate(40615) is denominated. Users ISO 4271 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFutureValueNotional
Fields.Description: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex
Fields.Description: The payment stream's floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexSource
Fields.Description: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the underlying instrument’s floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the underlying instrument’s floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. A multiplier schedule is expressed as explicit multipliers and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in the calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpread
Fields.Description: Spread from floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies a short or long spread value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. An initial rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: When rate averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average calculation method is to be used.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determines the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
Fields.Description: The inflation lag period day type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the Inflation Index Level from multiple points - the most common is Linear.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationIndexSource
Fields.Description: The inflation index reference source.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationPublicationSource
Fields.Description: The current main publication source such as relevant web site or a government body.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationInitialIndexLevel
Fields.Description: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationFallbackBondApplicable
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8, is applicable or not. If not specified, the default value is "Y" (True/Yes).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFRADiscounting
Fields.Description: The method of Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) discounting, if any, that will apply.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableRefCurrency
Fields.Description: The non-deliverable settlement reference currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the non-deliverable fixing dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: SettlRateFallbackReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When SettlRateFallbackRateSource(40373) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDates
Fields.Description: Number of Fixing dates in the repeating group

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDate
Fields.Description: The non-deliverable fixing date unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDateType(40658).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingSettlRateFallbacks
Fields.Description: Number of settlement rate fallbacks in the repeating group

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlRatePostponementMaximumDays
Fields.Description: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceding to this method.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlRatePostponementSurvey
Fields.Description: Indicates whether to request a settlement rate quote from the market.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlRatePostponementCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the settlement rate postponement calculation agent.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentSchedules
Fields.Description: Number of swap schedules in the repeating group

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleType
Fields.Description: Type of schedule.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStubType
Fields.Description: Indicates to which stub this schedule applies.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on which the value is adjusted, or calculated if a future value notional for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)), or the start date of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentSchedulePaySide
Fields.Description: The side of the party paying the step schedule.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleReceiveSide
Fields.Description: The side of the party receiving the step schedule.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleNotional
Fields.Description: The notional value for this step, or amount of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency for this step. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRate
Fields.Description: The rate value for this step.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSpread
Fields.Description: The spread value for this step.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixedAmount
Fields.Description: The explicit payment amount for this step.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixedCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue
Fields.Description: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRate
Fields.Description: The percentage by which the notional changes on each step date. The percentage is either a percentage applied to the initial notional amount or the previous outstanding notional, depending on the value specified in UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo(40685). The percentage can be either positive or negative.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepOffsetRate
Fields.Description: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies whether the UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRate(40683) or UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40682) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleWeight
Fields.Description: Floating rate observation weight for cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessDayCnvtn
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingTime
Fields.Description: The fixing time.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Business center for determining fixing time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangePaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the interim exchange payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted interim exchange date.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSources
Fields.Description: Number of rate sources in the repeating group

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSourceType
Fields.Description: Rate source type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleReferencePage
Fields.Description:
Identifies the reference “page” from the rate source.
For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When RateSource(1446) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStubs
Fields.Description: Number of stubs in the repeating group

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubType
Fields.Description: Stub type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubLength
Fields.Description: Optional indication whether stub is shorter or longer than the regular swap period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubRate
Fields.Description: The agreed upon fixed rate for this stub.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubFixedAmount
Fields.Description: A fixed payment amount for the stub.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubFixedCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the fixed payment amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex
Fields.Description: The stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexSource
Fields.Description: The source for the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateSpread
Fields.Description: Spread from floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the stub index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2
Fields.Description: The second stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2Source
Fields.Description: The source of the second stub floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2CurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit multiplier for the stub floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2CurveUnit
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit associated with the stub floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the second floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateSpread
Fields.Description: Spread from the second floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the second stub index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2CapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2FloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of payment stream associated with the swap.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamMarketRate
Fields.Description: Used only for credit index trade. This contains the credit spread ("fair value") at which the trade was executed. The market rate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. This is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamDelayIndicator
Fields.Description: Applicable to credit default swaps on mortgage backed securities to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed amount. Residential mortgage backed securities typically have a payment delay of 5 days between the coupon date of the reference obligation and the payment date of the synthetic swap. Commercial mortgage backed securities do not typically have a payment delay, with both payment dates (the coupon date of the reference obligation and the payment date of the synthetic swap) being on the 25th of each month.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency that the stream settles in (to support swaps that settle in a currency different from the notional currency). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in the payment stream calculations.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamAccrualDays
Fields.Description: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamDiscountType
Fields.Description: The method of calculating discounted payment amounts

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamDiscountRate
Fields.Description: Discount rate. The rate is expressed in decimal, e.g. 5% is expressed as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamDiscountRateDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention applied to the PaymentStreamDiscountRate(40745).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingMethod
Fields.Description: Compounding method.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInterimPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalPrincipalExchangeIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of payments.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of payments.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFirstPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first payment date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLastRegularPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last regular payment date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when payment dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamResetDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the reset dates are relative to an anchor date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamResetDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's reset date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamResetDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's reset date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamResetFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of resets.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamResetFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of resets.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamResetWeeklyRollConvention
Fields.Description: Used to specify the day of the week in which the reset occurs for payments that reset on a weekly basis.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the initial fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative initial fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted initial fixing date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative rate cut-off date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRate
Fields.Description: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment stream.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixedAmount
Fields.Description: The payment stream's fixed payment amount. In CDS an alternative to PaymentStreamRate(40784).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateOrAmountCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency in which PaymentStreamFixedAmount(40785) or PaymentStreamRate(40784) is denominated. Uses ISO 4271 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFutureValueNotional
Fields.Description: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndex
Fields.Description: The payment stream floating rate index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndexSource
Fields.Description: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. A multiplier schedule is expressed as explicit multipliers and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in the calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateSpread
Fields.Description: Spread from floating rate index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. An initial rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: When rate averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average calculation method is to be used.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determines the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
Fields.Description: The inflation lag period day type.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the Inflation Index Level from multiple points - the most common is Linear.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationIndexSource
Fields.Description: The inflation index reference source.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationPublicationSource
Fields.Description: The current main publication source such as relevant web site or a government body.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationInitialIndexLevel
Fields.Description: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInflationFallbackBondApplicable
Fields.Description: Indicates whether a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8, is applicable or not. If not specified, the default value is "Y" (True/Yes).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFRADiscounting
Fields.Description: The method of Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) discounting, if any, that will apply.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableRefCurrency
Fields.Description: The non-deliverable settlement reference currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable settlement terms. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the non-deliverable fixing dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource(40661) = 3(ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: NoNonDeliverableFixingDates
Fields.Description: Number of Fixing dates in the repeating group

Fields.Name: NonDeliverableFixingDate
Fields.Description: Non-deliverable fixing date unadjusted or adjusted depending on NonDeliverableFixingDateType(40827).

Fields.Name: NonDeliverableFixingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: NoPaymentSchedules
Fields.Description: Number of swap schedules in the repeating group

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleType
Fields.Description: Type of schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStubType
Fields.Description: Indicates to which stub this schedule applies.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The date on which the value is adjusted, or calculated if a future value notional for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)), or the start date of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date of a cash flow payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentSchedulePaySide
Fields.Description: The side of the party paying the step schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleReceiveSide
Fields.Description: The side of the party receiving the stepf schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleNotional
Fields.Description: The notional value for this step, or amount of a cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency for this step. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRate
Fields.Description: The rate value for this step schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateSpread
Fields.Description: The spread value for this step schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixedAmount
Fields.Description: The explicit payment amount for this step schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixedCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStepFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStepFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue
Fields.Description: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStepRate
Fields.Description: The percentage by which the notional changes on each step date. The percentage is either a percentage applied to the initial notional amount or the previous outstanding notional, depending on the value specified in PaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo(40849). The percentage can be either positive or negative.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStepOffsetRate
Fields.Description: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies whether the PaymentScheduleStepRate(40847) or PaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40846) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleWeight
Fields.Description: Floating rate observation weight for cashflow payment.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted fixing date.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingTime
Fields.Description: The fixing time associated with the step schedule.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Business center for determining fixing time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangePaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the interim exchange payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative interim exchange date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted interim exchange date.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentScheduleRateSources
Fields.Description: Number of swap schedule rate sources.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateSourceType
Fields.Description: Rate source type.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleReferencePage
Fields.Description:
Identifies the reference “page” from the rate source.
For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When RateSource(1446) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the payment stub index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubIndexCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubIndexCapRateSellSide

Fields.Name: PaymentStubIndexFloorRate

The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubIndex2CurveUnit
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit associated with the stub floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubIndex2RateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the second floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingStreamText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingStreamText(40547) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingStreamText(40547) field.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackValue
Fields.Description: Applicable value for LegMarketDisruptionFallbackType(41470).

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionValue
Fields.Description: Applicable value for MarketDisruptionEvent(41093).

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackValue
Fields.Description: Applicable value for MarketDisruptionFallbackType(41095).

Fields.Name: PaymentSubType
Fields.Description: Used to further clarify the value of PaymentType(40213).

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventAveragingObservations
Fields.Description: The number of averaging observations in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventAveragingObservationNumber
Fields.Description: Cross reference to the ordinal observation as specified either in the ComplexEventScheduleGrp or ComplexEventPeriodDateGrp components.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventAveragingWeight
Fields.Description: The weight factor to be applied to the observation.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventCreditEvents
Fields.Description: The number of credit events specified in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of credit event. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Types for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventValue
Fields.Description: The credit event value appropriate to ComplexEventCreditEventType(40998). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Types for applicable event type values.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the applicable currency when ComplexEventCreditEventValue(40999) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for complex credit events.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with complex credit events.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type for the complex credit events.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information used for credit events. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Rate_Source for code list of applicable sources.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventCreditEventQualifiers
Fields.Description: The number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventQualifier
Fields.Description: Specifies a complex event qualifier. Used to further qualify ComplexEventCreditEventType(40998).

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventPeriodDateTimes
Fields.Description: The number of entries in the date-time repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPeriodDate
Fields.Description: The averaging date for an Asian option. The trigger date for a Barrier or Knock option.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPeriodTime
Fields.Description: The averaging time for an Asian option.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventPeriods
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventPeriodType
Fields.Description: Specifies the period type.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center used to determine dates and times in the schedule or date-time group. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventRateSources
Fields.Description: The number of rate sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.
Fields.Elaboration: For FX, the reference source to be used for the FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventRateSourceType
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the rate source specified is a primary or secondary source.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference page from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate is to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When ComplexEventRateSource(41014) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: The number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the complex event date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted complex event date.
Fields.Elaboration: For example the second expiration date for a calendar spread option strategy.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the complex event date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the complex event date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted complex event date.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventFixingTime
Fields.Description: The local market fixing time.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventFixingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to determine the actual fixing times. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventCreditEventSources
Fields.Description: Number of event sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventCreditEventSource
Fields.Description: A newspaper or electronic news service that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

Fields.Name: NoComplexEventSchedules
Fields.Description: Number of schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventScheduleStartDate
Fields.Description: The start date of the schedule.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventScheduleEndDate
Fields.Description: The end date of the schedule.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventScheduleFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the schedule date frequency.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventScheduleFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the schedule date frequency.

Fields.Name: ComplexEventScheduleRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the DateAdjustment component in Instrument.

Fields.Name: NoDeliverySchedules
Fields.Description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery schedule.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleXID
Fields.Description: Identifier for this instance of delivery schedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleNotional
Fields.Description: Physical delivery quantity.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleNotionalCommodityFrequency
Fields.Description: The frequency of notional delivery.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41046). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: DeliverySchedulePositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41046). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleToleranceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleToleranceType
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlCountry
Fields.Description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeZone
Fields.Description: Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Prevailing_Timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

Fields.Name: NoDeliveryScheduleSettlDays
Fields.Description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlDay
Fields.Description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTotalHours
Fields.Description: The sum of the total hours specified in the DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeGrp component.

Fields.Name: NoDeliveryScheduleSettlTimes
Fields.Description: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlStart
Fields.Description: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41057).

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlEnd
Fields.Description: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41057).

Fields.Name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamPipeline
Fields.Description: The name of the oil delivery pipeline.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamEntryPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity will enter the delivery mechanism or pipeline.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamWithdrawalPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity product will be withdrawn prior to delivery.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product. For bullion, see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryRestriction
Fields.Description: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryContingency
Fields.Description: Specifies the electricity delivery contingency. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
Fields.Description: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
Fields.Description: Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Risk_Apportionment for the details of the external code list.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
Fields.Description: Specifies the title transfer location.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies the condition of title transfer.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
Fields.Description: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryStreamToleranceType(41074). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryStreamToleranceType(41074). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamToleranceType
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamToleranceOptionSide
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamTotalPositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%.).

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%.).

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
Fields.Description: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
Fields.Description: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.
Fields.Elaboration: Examples of transportation equipment or mode are barge, truck, railcar, etc.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamElectingPartySide
Fields.Description: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period as found in a swing or interruptible contract.

Fields.Name: NoDeliveryStreamCycles
Fields.Description: Number of delivery cycles in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamCycleDesc
Fields.Description: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

Fields.Name: EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41084) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the DeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41082) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the DeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41082) field.

Fields.Name: NoDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
Fields.Description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamCommoditySource
Fields.Description: The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionProvision
Fields.Description: The consequences of market disruption events.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackProvision
Fields.Description: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionMaximumDays
Fields.Description: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2005 Commodity Definition.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionMaterialityPercentage
Fields.Description: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable to 2005 Commodity Definitions only.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionMinimumFuturesContracts
Fields.Description: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable to 1993 Commodity Definitions only.

Fields.Name: NoMarketDisruptionEvents
Fields.Description: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionEvent
Fields.Description: Specifies the market disruption event. For commodities see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values. For foreign exchange, see http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Market_Disruption_Event for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: NoMarketDisruptionFallbacks
Fields.Description: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of disruption fallback. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

Fields.Name: NoMarketDisruptionFallbackReferencePrices
Fields.Description: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierType
Fields.Description: The type of reference price underlier.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityID
Fields.Description: Specifies the identifier value of the security.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the class or source scheme of the security identifier.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Specifies the description of the underlying security.

Fields.Name: EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41102) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41100) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41100) field.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackOpenUnits
Fields.Description: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackBasketCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: MarketDisruptionFallbackBasketDivisor
Fields.Description: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

Fields.Name: ExerciseDesc
Fields.Description: A description of the option exercise.

Fields.Name: EncodedExerciseDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedExerciseDesc(41102) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedExerciseDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ExerciseDesc(41106) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ExerciseDesc(41106) field.

Fields.Name: AutomaticExerciseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

Fields.Name: AutomaticExerciseThresholdRate
Fields.Description: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

Fields.Name: ExerciseConfirmationMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

Fields.Name: ManualNoticeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: FallbackExerciseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

Fields.Name: LimitedRightToConfirmIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

Fields.Name: ExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

Fields.Name: NoOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative earliest option exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise dates.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise dates.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseNominationDeadline
Fields.Description: Last date (adjusted) for establishing the option exercise terms.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first exercise date.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last exercise date.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseEarliestTime
Fields.Description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseLatestTime
Fields.Description: The latest exercise time. See also OptionExerciseEarliestTime(41134).

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise time, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values

Fields.Name: NoOptionExerciseDates
Fields.Description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseDate
Fields.Description: The option exercise fixed date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on OptionExerciseDateType(41139).

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: NoOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of exercise expiration dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the DateAdjustment component in Instrument.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The option exercise expiration time.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise expiration time, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoOptionExerciseExpirationDates
