Fields.Description: Number of fixed exercise expiration dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDate
Fields.Description: An adjusted or unadjusted fixed option exercise expiration date.

Fields.Name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of option exercise expiration date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: PaymentUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Used to express the unit of measure (UOM) of the payment amount if not in the currency of the trade.

Fields.Name: PaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative payment date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentForwardStartType
Fields.Description: Forward start premium type.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentScheduleFixingDays
Fields.Description: Number of fixing days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDayOfWeek
Fields.Description: The day of the week on which fixing will take place.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDayNumber
Fields.Description: The occurrence of the day of week on which fixing takes place.
Fields.Elaboration: For example, a fixing of the 3rd Friday would be DayOfWk=5 DayNum=3. If omitted every day of the week is a fixing day.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this PaymentSchedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to payment schedule elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the schedule rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The schedule rate unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateConversionFactor
Fields.Description: The number to be multiplied by the derived floating rate of the payment schedule in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the schedule rate conversion factor is 1.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleRateSpreadType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPrice
Fields.Description: The schedule settlement period price.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the schedule settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleStepUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The schedule step unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDayDistribution
Fields.Description: The distribution of fixing days.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingDayCount
Fields.Description: The number of days over which fixing should take place.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the fixing lag duration.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the fixing lag duration.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.
Fields.Elaboration: If the first observation offset is specified, the observation period will start the specified interval prior to each calculation period - i.e. if the first observation offset is 4 months and the lag duration is 3 months, observations will be taken in months 4, 3 and 2 (but not 1) prior to each calculation period. If no first observation offset is specified, the observation period will end immediately preceding each calculation period.

Fields.Name: PaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', the Flat Rate is the New Worldwide Tanker Nominal Freight Scale for the Freight Index Route taken at the Trade Date of the transaction “Fixed”. If 'N' it is taken on each Pricing Date “Floating”.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFlatRateAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the actual monetary value of the flat rate when PaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator(41180) = 'Y'.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFlatRateCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the actual flat rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamMaximumPaymentAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the limit on the total payment amount.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamMaximumPaymentCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of total payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamMaximumTransactionAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the limit on the payment amount that goes out in any particular calculation period.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamMaximumTransactionCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the period payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixedAmountUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the fixed payment amount unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamTotalFixedAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the total fixed payment amount.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamWorldScaleRate
Fields.Description: The number of Worldscale points for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a wet voyage charter commodity swap.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamContractPrice
Fields.Description: The price per relevant unit for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a dry voyage charter or time charter commodity swap.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamContractPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of PaymentStreamContractPrice(41190). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2CurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve.
Fields.Elaboration: May be used for a Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) with an average rate between two curve points.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2CurveUnit
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndexLocation
Fields.Description: Specifies the location of the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndexLevel
Fields.Description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD index level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateIndexUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate index level.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamSettlLevel
Fields.Description: Specifies how weather index units are to be calculated.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamReferenceLevel
Fields.Description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD reference level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamReferenceLevelUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate reference level.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamReferenceLevelEqualsZeroIndicator
Fields.Description: When set to 'Y', it indicates the weather reference level equals zero.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateSpreadCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the floating rate spread. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateSpreadUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Species the unit of measure (UOM) of the floating rate spread.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateConversionFactor
Fields.Description: The number to be multiplied by the derived floating rate of the payment stream in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the floating rate conversion factor is 1.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRateSpreadType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLastResetRate
Fields.Description: The floating rate determined at the most recent reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalRate
Fields.Description: The floating rate determined at the final reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCalculationLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the calculation lag duration.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCalculationLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the calculation lag duration.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.
Fields.Elaboration: If the first observation offset is specified, the observation period will start the specified interval prior to each calculation period - i.e. if the first observation offset is 4 months and the lag duration is 3 months, observations will be taken in months 4, 3 and 2 (but not 1) prior to each calculation period. If no first observation offset is specified, the observation period will end immediately preceding each calculation period.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity pricing day type.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingDayDistribution
Fields.Description: The distribution of pricing days.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingDayCount
Fields.Description: The number of days over which pricing should take place.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingBusinessCalendar
Fields.Description: Specifies the business calendar to use for pricing. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-business-calendar for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payent stream's pricing dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamRiskApportionmentSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the source or legal framework for the risk apportionment. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Risk_Apportionment_Source for the details of the external code list.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamRiskApportionmentSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the source or legal framework for the risk apportionment. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Risk_Apportionment_Source for the details of the external code list.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamPaymentDates
Fields.Description: Number of payment dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed stream payment date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of payment date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamMasterAgreementPaymentDatesIndicator
Fields.Description: When set to 'Y', it indicates that payment dates are specified in the relevant master agreement.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamPricingDates
Fields.Description: Number of pricing dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed stream pricing date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of pricing date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamPricingDays
Fields.Description: Number of pricing days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingDayOfWeek
Fields.Description: The day of the week on which pricing takes place.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamPricingDayNumber
Fields.Description: The occurrence of the day of week on which pricing takes place.
Fields.Elaboration: For example a pricing day of the 3rd Friday would be DayOfWk=5 DayNum=3.

Fields.Name: NoPricingDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PricingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust pricing or fixing dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PricingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted pricing or fixing date.

Fields.Name: PricingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust pricing or fixing dates. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: PricingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted pricing or fixing date.

Fields.Name: PricingTime
Fields.Description: Specifies the local market time of the pricing or fixing.

Fields.Name: PricingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Specifies the business center for determining the pricing or fixing time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoStreamAssetAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

Fields.Name: StreamAssetAttributeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the name of the attribute. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Asset_Attribute_Types for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

Fields.Name: StreamAssetAttributeValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: StreamAssetAttributeLimit
Fields.Description: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: NoStreamCalculationPeriodDates
Fields.Description: Number of calculation period dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationPeriodDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed calculation period date.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationPeriodDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of fixed calculation period date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationPeriodDatesXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this calculation period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationPeriodDatesXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another calculation period for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationBalanceOfFirstPeriod
Fields.Description: When specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date to the end of the calendar period in which the effective date falls (e.g. Jan 15 - Jan 31 if the calculation periods are one month long and effective date is Jan 15.). If 'N' or not specified, it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date for one whole period (e.g. Jan 15 to Feb 14 if the calculation periods are one month long and the effective date is Jan 15.).

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationCorrectionPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

Fields.Name: StreamCalculationCorrectionUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

Fields.Name: NoStreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the commodity delivery date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityBase
Fields.Description: Specifies the general base type of the commodity traded. Where possible, this should follow the naming convention used in the 2005 ISDA Commodity Definitions.
Fields.Elaboration: Examples of general commodity base types include: Metal, Bullion, Oil, Natural Gas, Coal, Electricity, Inter-Energy, Grains, Oils Seeds, Dairy, Livestock, Forestry, Softs, Weather, Emissions.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of commodity product. For coal see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-type for values. For metals see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-metal-product-type for values. For bullion see http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Bullion_Types for the external code list of bullion types.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySecurityID
Fields.Description: Specifies the market identifier for the commodity.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of the StreamCommoditySecurityIDSource(41253) value.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the commodity asset.

Fields.Name: EncodedStreamCommodityDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedStreamCommodityDesc(41257) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedStreamCommodityDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the StreamCommodityDesc(41255) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the StreamCommodityDesc(41255) field.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the commodity asset.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityCurrency
Fields.Description: Identifies the currency of the commodity asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityExchange
Fields.Description: Identifies the exchange where the commodity is traded.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information used for commodities. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Commodity_Rate_Source for code list of applicable sources.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityRateReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityRateReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: StreamDataProvider
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity data or information provider. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-information-provider for values.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityPricingType
Fields.Description: Specifies how the pricing or rate setting of the trade is to be determined or based upon. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Commodity_Rate_Pricing_Type for code list of applicable commodity pricing types.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityNearbySettlDayPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the nearby settlement day.
Fields.Elaboration: When the commodity transaction references a futures contract, the delivery or settlement dates are a nearby month or week. For example, for eighth nearby month use Period=8 and Unit=Mo.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityNearbySettlDayUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the nearby settlement day.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted commodity delivery date.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the commodity delivery date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted commodity delivery date.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlMonth
Fields.Description: Specifies a fixed single month for commodity delivery.
Fields.Elaboration: Use "1" for January, "2" for February, etc.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlDateRollPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the commodity delivery date roll.
Fields.Elaboration: For a commodity transaction that references a listed future via the delivery dates, this is the day offset on which the specified future will roll to the next nearby month when the referenced future expires.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlDateRollUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the commodity delivery date roll.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity delivery roll day type.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this stream commodity for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to a stream commodity elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: NoStreamCommodityAltIDs
Fields.Description: Number of alternate security identifers.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityAltID
Fields.Description: Alternate security identifier value for the commodity.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of the alternate commodity security identifier.

Fields.Name: NoStreamCommodityDataSources
Fields.Description: Number of data sources in the repeating group. The order of entry determines priority – first is the main source, second is fallback, third is second fallback.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityDataSourceID
Fields.Description: Data source identifier.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityDataSourceIDType
Fields.Description: Type of data source identifier.

Fields.Name: NoStreamCommoditySettlDays
Fields.Description: Number of days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlDay
Fields.Description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlTotalHours
Fields.Description: Sum of the hours specified in StreamCommoditySettlTimeGrp.

Fields.Name: NoStreamCommoditySettlTimes
Fields.Description: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlStart
Fields.Description: The start time for commodities settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlEnd
Fields.Description: The end time for commodities settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

Fields.Name: NoStreamCommoditySettlPeriods
Fields.Description: Number of commodity settlement periods in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlCountry
Fields.Description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlTimeZone
Fields.Description: Commodity delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Prevailing_Timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotional
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the settlement period frequency.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the settlement period frequency.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodPrice
Fields.Description: The settlement period price.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this settlement period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlPeriodXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another settlement period for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: StreamXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this Stream for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: PaymentLegRefID
Fields.Description: Identifies the instrument leg in which this payment applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

Fields.Name: StreamNotionalXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another Stream notional for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: StreamNotionalFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the swap stream's notional frequency.

Fields.Name: StreamNotionalFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the swap stream's notional frequency.

Fields.Name: StreamNotionalCommodityFrequency
Fields.Description: The commodity's notional or quantity delivery frequency.

Fields.Name: StreamNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery stream quantity unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: StreamTotalNotional
Fields.Description: Total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: StreamTotalNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) for the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: NoMandatoryClearingJurisdictions
Fields.Description: Number of mandatory clearing jurisdictions.

Fields.Name: MandatoryClearingJurisdiction
Fields.Description: Identifier of the regulatory jurisdiction requiring the trade to be cleared.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to the protection terms applicable to this entity or obligation. Contains the same XID named string value of the instance in the ProtectionTerms repeating group that applies to this Underlying.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to the cash or physical settlement terms applicable to this entity or obligation. Contains the same XID named string value of the instance in the appropriate repeating group that applies to this Underlying.

Fields.Name: NoLegAdditionalTermBondRefs
Fields.Description: Number of bonds in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondSecurityID
Fields.Description: Security identifier of the bond.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source scheme of the LegAdditionalTermBondSecurityID(41317) value.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the bond.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegAdditionalTermBondDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegAdditionalTermBondDesc(41321) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegAdditionalTermBondDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegAdditionalTermBondDesc(41319) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegAdditionalTermBondDesc(41319) field.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the bond value is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondIssuer
Fields.Description: Issuer of the bond.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegAdditionalTermBondIssuer(41325) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegAdditionalTermBondIssuer
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegAdditionalTermBondIssuer(41323) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegAdditionalTermBondIssuer(41323) field.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondSeniority
Fields.Description: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondCouponType
Fields.Description: Specifies the coupon type of the bond.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondCouponRate
Fields.Description: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
Fields.Description: The maturity date of the bond.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondParValue
Fields.Description: The par value of the bond.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
Fields.Description: Total issued amount of the bond.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermBondDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

Fields.Name: NoLegAdditionalTerms
Fields.Description: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionValue
Fields.Description: Applicable value for UnderlyingMarketDisruptionEvent(41865).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackValue
Fields.Description: Applicable value for UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackType(41867).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondRefs
Fields.Description: Number of bonds in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondSecurityID
Fields.Description: Security identifier of the bond.

Fields.Name: NoLegCashSettlDealers
Fields.Description: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDealer
Fields.Description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Dealer

Fields.Name: NoLegCashSettlTerms
Fields.Description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlAmount(41357) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegCasSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
Fields.Description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.
Fields.Elaboration: Associated with ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Date.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlValuationSubsequentBusinessDaysOffset
Fields.Description: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlNumOfValuationDates
Fields.Description: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of applicable valuation dates.
Fields.Elaboration: Associated with ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Date

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlValuationTime
Fields.Description: Time of valuation.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlQuoteAmount
Fields.Description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specifed, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Quotation Amount.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlQuoteAmount(41352) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
Fields.Description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevent obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Minimum Quotation Amount.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlQuoteMinimumAmount(41354) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlBusinessDays
Fields.Description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.
Fields.Elaboration: If a cash settlement amount is specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days following the calculation of the final price. If a cash settlement amount is not specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days after all conditions to settlement are satisfied. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Date.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlAmount
Fields.Description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.
Fields.Elaboration: If not specified this would typically be calculated as ((100 or the reference price) - reference obligation price) x floating rate payer calculation amount. Price values are all expressed as a percentage. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Amount.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlRecoveryFactor
Fields.Description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount calculated is (1 - LegCashSettlRecoveryFactor(41358)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlFixedTermIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in LegCashSettlAmount(41357). For cash settlement this specifies whether quotations should be obtained inclusive or not of accrued interest. For physical settlement this specifies whether the buyer should deliver the obligation with an outstanding principal balance that includes or excludes accrued interest.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Include/Exclude Accrued Interest.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlValuationMethod
Fields.Description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Method.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventAveragingObservations
Fields.Description: The number of averaging observations in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventAveragingObservationNumber
Fields.Description: Cross reference to the ordinal observation as specified either in the LegComplexEventScheduleGrp or LegComplexEventPeriodDateGrp components.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventAveragingWeight
Fields.Description: The weight factor to be applied to the observation.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventCreditEvents
Fields.Description: The number of credit events specified in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of credit event. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Types for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventValue
Fields.Description: The credit event value appropriate to LegComplexEventCreditEventType(41367). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Types for applicable event type values.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the applicable currency when LegComplexEventCreditEventCurrency(41368) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for complex credit events.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with complex credit events.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type for the complex credit events.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information used for credit events. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Rate_Source for code list of applicable sources.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventCreditEventQualifiers
Fields.Description: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventQualifier
Fields.Description: Specifies a complex event qualifier. Used to further qualify LegComplexEventCreditEventType(41367).

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventPeriodDateTimes
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the date-time repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPeriodDate
Fields.Description: Averaging date for an Asian option. Trigger date for a Barrier or Knock option.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPeriodTime
Fields.Description: Averaging time for an Asian option.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventPeriods
Fields.Description: Number of periods in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventPeriodType
Fields.Description: Specifies the period type.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center for adjusting dates and times in the schedule or date-time group. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventRateSources
Fields.Description: Number of rate sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX, the reference source to be used for the FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventRateSourceType
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the rate source specified is a primary or secondary source.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference page from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate is to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When LegComplexEventRateSource(41383) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEvenReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the event date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted complex event date.
Fields.Elaboration: For example the second expiration date for a calendar spread option strategy.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the complex event date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the event date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted complex event date.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventFixingTime
Fields.Description: The local market fixing time.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventFixingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center for determining the actual fixing times. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventCreditEventSources
Fields.Description: Number of event sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventCreditEventSource
Fields.Description: A newspaper or electronic news service that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

Fields.Name: NoLegComplexEventSchedules
Fields.Description: Number of schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventScheduleStartDate
Fields.Description: The start date of the schedule.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventScheduleEndDate
Fields.Description: The end date of the schedule.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventScheduleFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the schedule date frequency.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventScheduleFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the schedule date frequency.

Fields.Name: LegComplexEventScheduleRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the LegDateAdjustment component in InstrumentLeg.

Fields.Name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the quote source.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionCashSettlQuoteReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the quote source.

Fields.Name: NoLegDeliverySchedules
Fields.Description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery schedule.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleXID
Fields.Description: Identifier for this instance of delivery schedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleNotional
Fields.Description: Physical delivery quantity.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleNotionalCommodityFrequency
Fields.Description: The frequency of notional delivery.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41417). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: LegDeliverySchedulePositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41417). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleToleranceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleToleranceType
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlCountry
Fields.Description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeZone
Fields.Description: Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Prevailing_Timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery flow type.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

Fields.Name: NoLegDeliveryScheduleSettlDays
Fields.Description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlDay
Fields.Description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTotalHours
Fields.Description: The sum of the total hours specified in the LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeGrp component.

Fields.Name: NoLegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimes
Fields.Description: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlStart
Fields.Description: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41428).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlEnd
Fields.Description: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41428).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamPipeline
Fields.Description: The name of the oil delivery pipeline.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamEntryPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity will enter the delivery mechanism or pipeline.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamWithdrawalPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity product will be withdrawn prior to delivery.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product. For bullion, see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryRestriction
Fields.Description: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingency
Fields.Description: Specifies the electricity delivery contingency. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
Fields.Description: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
Fields.Description: Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Risk_Apportionment for the details of the external code list.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
Fields.Description: Specifies the title transfer location.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies the condition of title transfer.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
Fields.Description: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamToleranceOptionSide
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamTotalPositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%.).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%.).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
Fields.Description: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
Fields.Description: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.
Fields.Elaboration: Examples of transportation equipment or mode are barge, truck, railcar, etc.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamElectingPartySide
Fields.Description: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period e.g. a swing or interruptible contract.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamAssetAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

Fields.Name: LegStreamAssetAttributeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the name of the attribute. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Asset_Attribute_Types for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

Fields.Name: LegStreamAssetAttributeValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: LegStreamAssetAttributeLimit
Fields.Description: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: NoLegDeliveryStreamCycles
Fields.Description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
Fields.Description: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41459) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41457) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegLeg DeliveryStream(41457) field.

Fields.Name: NoLegDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
Fields.Description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamCommoditySource
Fields.Description: The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionProvision
Fields.Description: The consequences of market disruption events.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackProvision
Fields.Description: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionMaximumDays
Fields.Description: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2005 Commodity Definition.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionMaterialityPercentage
Fields.Description: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable to 2005 Commodity Definitions only.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionMinimumFuturesContracts
Fields.Description: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable to 1993 Commodity Definitions only.

Fields.Name: NoLegMarketDisruptionEvents
Fields.Description: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionEvent
Fields.Description: Specifies the market disruption event. For commodities see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values. For foreign exchange, see http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Market_Disruption_Event for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: NoLegMarketDisruptionFallbacks
Fields.Description: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of disruption fallback. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

Fields.Name: NoLegMarketDisruptionFallbackReferencePrices
Fields.Description: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierType
Fields.Description: The type of reference price underlier.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityID
Fields.Description: Specifies the identifier value of the security.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the class or source scheme of the security identifier.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Specifies the description of the underlying security.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc (41477) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackOpenUnits
Fields.Description: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketDivisor
Fields.Description: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

Fields.Name: LegExerciseDesc
Fields.Description: A description of the option exercise.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegExerciseDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegExerciseDesc(41483) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegExerciseDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field.

Fields.Name: LegAutomaticExerciseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

Fields.Name: LegAutomaticExerciseThresholdRate
Fields.Description: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

Fields.Name: LegExerciseConfirmationMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

Fields.Name: LegManualNoticeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegFallbackExerciseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

Fields.Name: LegLimitRightToConfirmIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

Fields.Name: LegExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

Fields.Name: NoLegOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise dates.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise dates.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseNominationDeadline
Fields.Description: The last date (adjusted) for establishing the option exercise terms.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first exercise date.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last exercise date.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestTime
Fields.Description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseLatestTime
Fields.Description: The latest exercise time. See also LegOptionExerciseEarliestTime(41509).

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise time, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegOptionExerciseDates
Fields.Description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted option exercise fixed date.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of option exercise date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: NoLegOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of exercise expiration dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the LegDateAdjustment component in InstrumentLeg.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The option exercise expiration time.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise expiration time, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegOptionExerciseExpirationDates
Fields.Description: Number of fixed exercise expiration dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted option exercise expiration fixed date.

Fields.Name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of option exercise expiration date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentScheduleFixingDays
Fields.Description: Number of fixing days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayOfWeek
Fields.Description: The day of the week on which fixing takes place.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayNumber
Fields.Description: The occurrence of the day of week on which fixing takes place.
Fields.Elaboration: For example, a fixing of the 3rd Friday would be DayOfWk=5 DayNum=3. If omitted every day of the week is a fixing day.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this LegPaymentSchedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to payment schedule elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the schedule rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The schedule rate unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateConversionFactor
Fields.Description: The number multipled by the derived floating rate of the leg's payment schedule in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the schedule rate conversion factor is 1.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpreadType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPrice
Fields.Description: The schedule settlement period price.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the schedule settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleStepUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The schedule step unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayDistribution
Fields.Description: The distribution of fixing days.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayCount
Fields.Description: The number of days over which fixing should take place.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the fixing lag duration.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the fixing lag duration.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.
Fields.Elaboration: If the first observation offset is specified, the observation period will start the specified interval prior to each calculation period - i.e. if the first observation offset is 4 months and the lag duration is 3 months, observations will be taken in months 4, 3 and 2 (but not 1) prior to each calculation period. If no first observation offset is specified, the observation period will end immediately preceding each calculation period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', the Flat Rate is the New Worldwide Tanker Nominal Freight Scale for the Freight Index Route taken at the trade date of the transaction "Fixed". If 'N' it is taken on each pricing date "Floating".

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFlatRateAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the actual monetary value of the flat rate when LegPaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator(41549) = 'Y'.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFlatRateCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the actual flat rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegStreamMaximumPaymentAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the limit on the total payment amount.

Fields.Name: LegStreamMaximumPaymentCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of total payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegStreamMaximumTransactionAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the limit on the payment amount that goes out in any particular calculation period.

Fields.Name: LegStreamMaximumTransactionCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the period payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixedAmountUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The fixed payment amount unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamTotalFixedAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the total fixed payment amount.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamWorldScaleRate
Fields.Description: The number of Worldscale points for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a wet voyage charter commodity swap.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamContractPrice
Fields.Description: The price per relevant unit for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a dry voyage charter or time charter commodity swap.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamContractPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of LegPaymentStreamContractPrice(41559). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the pricing dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2CurveUnit
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2CurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve.
Fields.Elaboration: May be used for a Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) with an average rate between two curve points.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexLocation
Fields.Description: Specifies the location of the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexLevel
Fields.Description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD index level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate index level.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamSettlLevel
Fields.Description: Specifies how weather index units are to be calculated.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamReferenceLevel
Fields.Description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD reference level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamReferenceLevelUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate reference level.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamReferenceLevelEqualsZeroIndicator
Fields.Description: When set to 'Y', it indicates that the weather reference level equals zero.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the floating rate spread. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the floating rate spread.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateConversionFactor
Fields.Description: The number to be multiplied by the derived floating rate of the leg's payment stream in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the floating rate conversion factor is 1.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLastResetRate
Fields.Description: The floating rate determined at the most recent reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRate
Fields.Description: The floating rate determined at the final reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCalculationLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the calculation lag duration.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCalculationLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the calculation lag duration.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.
Fields.Elaboration: If the first observation offset is specified, the observation period will start the specified interval prior to each calculation period - i.e. if the first observation offset is 4 months and the lag duration is 3 months, observations will be taken in months 4, 3 and 2 (but not 1) prior to each calculation period. If no first observation offset is specified, the observation period will end immediately preceding each calculation period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity pricing day type.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayDistribution
Fields.Description: The distribution of pricing days.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayCount
Fields.Description: The number of days over which pricing should take place.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCalendar
Fields.Description: Specifies the business calendar to use for pricing. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-business-calendar for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamRiskApportionmentSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the source or legal framework for the risk apportionment. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Risk_Apportionment_Source for the details of the external code list.

Fields.Name: StreamCommoditySettlTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the format of the commodities settlement start and end times.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamPaymentDates
Fields.Description: Number of payment dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed stream payment date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of payment date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamMasterAgreementPaymentDatesIndicator
Fields.Description: When set to 'Y', it indicates that payment dates are specified in the relevant master agreement.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamPricingDates
Fields.Description: Number of pricing dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadusted fixed stream pricing date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of pricing date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamPricingDays
Fields.Description: Number of pricing days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayOfWeek
Fields.Description: The day of the week on which pricing takes place..

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayNumber
