Fields.Description: The occurrence of the day of week on which pricing takes place.
Fields.Elaboration: For example a pricing day of the 3rd Friday would be DayOfWk=5 DayNum=3.

Fields.Name: NoLegPhysicalSettlTerms
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPhysicalSettlTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

Fields.Name: LegPhysicalSettlCurency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPhysicalSettlBusinessDays
Fields.Description: The number of business days used in the determination of physical settlement. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this is used.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Business Day.

Fields.Name: LegPhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
Fields.Description: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

Fields.Name: NoLegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery obligation applicable for physical settlement. See http://www.fixptradingcommunity.org/codelists#Deliverable_Obligation_Types for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

Fields.Name: LegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
Fields.Description: Physical settlement delivery obligation value appropriate to LegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(41605). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Deliverable_Obligation_Types for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

Fields.Name: NoLegPricingDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPricingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the pricing or fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPricingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted pricing or fixing date.

Fields.Name: LegPricingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the pricing or fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegPricingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted pricing or fixing date.

Fields.Name: LegPricingTime
Fields.Description: The local market pricing or fixing time.

Fields.Name: LegPricingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Specifies the business center for determining the pricing or fixing time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegProtectionTermEventNewsSources
Fields.Description: Number of event sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventNewsSource
Fields.Description: A newspaper or electronic news service that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

Fields.Name: NoLegProtectionTerms
Fields.Description: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced from UnderlyingLegProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermNotional
Fields.Description: The notional amount of protection coverage.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Floating Rate Payer Calculation Amount.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of LegProtectionTermNotional(41618). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermSellerNotifies
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. LegProtectionTermSellerNotifies(41620)=Y indicates that the seller notifies.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. LegProtectionTermBuyerNotifies(41621)=Y indicates that the buyer notifies.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermStandardSources
Fields.Description: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (LegProtectionTermStandardSources(41623)=Y) or not.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
Fields.Description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

Fields.Name: NoLegProtectionTermEvents
Fields.Description: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Event_Types for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the protection term event value appropriate to LegProtectionTermEventType(41626). See http:///www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Event_Types for applicable event type values.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventCurrency
Fields.Description: Applicable currency if the event value is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for protection term events.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with protection term events.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type for protection term events.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Rate source for events that specify a rate source, e.g. floating rate interest shortfall.

Fields.Name: NoLegProtectionTermEventQualifiers
Fields.Description: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermEventQualifier
Fields.Description: Specifies the protection term event qualifier. Used to further qualify LegProtectionTermEventType(41626).

Fields.Name: NoLegProtectionTermObligations
Fields.Description: Number of obligations in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermObligationType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of obligation applicable to the protection terms. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Obligation_Types for code list of applicable obligation types.

Fields.Name: LegProtectionTermObligationValue
Fields.Description: The value associated with the protection term obligation specified in LegProtectionTermObligationType(41636). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Obligation_Types for applicable obligation type values.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamCalculationPeriodDates
Fields.Description: Number of calculation period dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed calculation period date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of fixed calculation period date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodDatesXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this calculation period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodDatesXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another calculation period for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationBalanceOfFirstPeriod
Fields.Description: When specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date to the end of the calendar period in which the effective date falls (e.g. Jan 15 - Jan 31 if the calculation periods are one month long and effective date is Jan 15.). If 'N' or not specified, it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date for one whole period (e.g. Jan 15 to Feb 14 if the calculation periods are one month long and the effective date is Jan 15.).

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationCorrectionPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCalculationCorrectionUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the commodity delivery date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityBase
Fields.Description: Specifies the general base type of the commodity traded. Where possible, this should follow the naming convention used in the 2005 ISDA Commodity Definitions.
Fields.Elaboration: Examples of general commodity base types include: Metal, Bullion, Oil, Natural Gas, Coal, Electricity, Inter-Energy, Grains, Oils Seeds, Dairy, Livestock, Forestry, Softs, Weather, Emissions.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of commodity product. For coal see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-type for values. For metals see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-metal-product-type for values. For bullion see http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Bullion_Types for the external code list of bullion types.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySecurityID
Fields.Description: Specifies the market identifier for the commodity.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of the LegStreamCommoditySecurityIDSource(41650) value.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the commodity asset.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegStreamCommodityDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegStreamCommodityDesc(41654) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedLegStreamCommodityDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegStreamCommodityDesc(41652) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegStreamCommodityDesc(41652) field.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the commodity asset.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityCurrency
Fields.Description: Identifies the currency of the commodity asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityExchange
Fields.Description: Identifies the exchange where the commodity is traded.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information used for commodities. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Commodity_Rate_Source for code list of applicable sources.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityRateReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityRateReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: LegStreamDataProvider
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity data or information provider. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-information-provider for values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityPricingType
Fields.Description: Specifies how the pricing or rate setting of the trade is to be determined or based upon. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Commodity_Rate_Pricing_Type for code list of applicable commodity pricing types.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityNearbySettlDayPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the nearby settlement day.
Fields.Elaboration: When the commodity transaction references a futures contract, the delivery or settlement dates are a nearby month or week. For example, for eighth nearby month use Period=8 and Unit=Mo.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityNearbySettlDayUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the nearby settlement day.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted commodity delivery date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the commodity delivery date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted commodity delivery date.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlMonth
Fields.Description: Specifies a fixed single month for commodity delivery.
Fields.Elaboration: Use "1" for January, "2" for February, etc.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlDateRollPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the commodity delivery date roll.
Fields.Elaboration: For a commodity transaction that references a listed future via the delivery dates, this is the day offset on which the specified future will roll to the next nearby month when the referenced future expires.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlDateRollUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the commodity delivery date roll.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity delivery roll day type.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this stream commodity for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to a stream commodity elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamCommodityAltIDs
Fields.Description: Number of alternate security identifers.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityAltID
Fields.Description: Alternate security identifier value for the commodity.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of the alternate commodity security identifier.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamCommodityDataSources
Fields.Description: Number of data sources in the repeating group. The order of entry determines priority – first is the main source, second is fallback, third is second fallback.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityDataSourceID
Fields.Description: Specifies the data source identifier.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityDataSourceIDType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of data source identifier.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamCommoditySettlDays
Fields.Description: Number of days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlDay
Fields.Description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlTotalHours
Fields.Description: Sum of the hours specified in LegStreamCommoditySettlTimeGrp.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamCommoditySettlTimes
Fields.Description: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlStart
Fields.Description: The start time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlEnd
Fields.Description: The end time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

Fields.Name: NoLegStreamCommoditySettlPeriods
Fields.Description: Number of commodity settlement periods in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlCountry
Fields.Description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlTimeZone
Fields.Description: Commodity delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Prevailing_Timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotional
Fields.Description: Delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the settlement period frequency.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the settlement period frequency.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPrice
Fields.Description: The settlement period price.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this settlement period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another settlement period for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: LegStreamXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this LegStream for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source scheme of the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondSecurityID(41341) value.

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotionalXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another LegStream notional for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotionalFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the swap stream's notional frequency.

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotionalFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the swap stream's notional frequency.

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotionalCommodityFrequency
Fields.Description: The commodity's notional or quantity delivery frequency.

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: LegStreamTotalNotional
Fields.Description: Specifies the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: LegStreamTotalNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) for the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the bond.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDesc(41711) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDesc(41709) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDesc(41709) field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the bond value is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventAveragingObservations
Fields.Description: The number of averaging observations in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventAveragingObservationNumber
Fields.Description: Cross reference to the ordinal observation as specified either in the UnderlyingComplexEventScheduleGrp or UnderlyingComplexEventPeriodDateGrp components.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventAveragingWeight
Fields.Description: The weight factor to be applied to the observation.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventCreditEvents
Fields.Description: The number of credit events specified in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of credit event. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Types for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventValue
Fields.Description: The credit event value appropriate to UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventType(41717). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Types for applicable event type values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the applicable currency when UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventValue(41718) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for complex credit events.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with complex credit events.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type for the complex credit events.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information used for credit events. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Credit_Event_Rate_Source for code list of applicable sources.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventQualifiers
Fields.Description: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventQualifier
Fields.Description: Specifies a complex event qualifier. Used to further qualify UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventType(41717).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventPeriodDateTimes
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the date-time repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPeriodDate
Fields.Description: The averaging date for an Asian option. The trigger date for a Barrier or Knock option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPeriodTime
Fields.Description: The averaging time for an Asian option.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventPeriods
Fields.Description: Number of periods in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventPeriodType
Fields.Description: Specifies the period type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center for adjusting dates and times in the schedule or date-time group. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventRateSources
Fields.Description: Number of rate sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information.
Fields.Elaboration: For FX, the reference source to be used for the FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventRateSourceType
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the rate source specified is a primary or secondary source.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference page from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate is to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When UnderlyingComplexEventRateSource(41733) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar is used to adjust the event date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted complex event date.
Fields.Elaboration: For example the second expiration date for a calendar spread option strategy.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the complex event date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the event date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted complex event date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventFixingTime
Fields.Description: The local market fixing time.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventFixingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center for determining the actual fixing times. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventSources
Fields.Description: Number of event sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventCreditEventSource
Fields.Description: A newspaper or electronic news service that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventSchedules
Fields.Description: Number of schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventScheduleStartDate
Fields.Description: The start date of the schedule.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventScheduleEndDate
Fields.Description: The end date of the schedule.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventScheduleFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the schedule date frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventScheduleFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the schedule date frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingComplexEventScheduleRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component in UnderlyingInstrument.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDeliverySchedules
Fields.Description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery schedule.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleXID
Fields.Description: Identifier for this instance of delivery schedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleNotional
Fields.Description: Physical delivery quantity.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleNotionalCommodityFrequency
Fields.Description: The frequency of notional delivery.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41765). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliverySchedulePositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41765). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleToleranceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleToleranceType
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlCountry
Fields.Description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeZone
Fields.Description: Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Prevailing_Timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery flow type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlDays
Fields.Description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlDay
Fields.Description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTotalHours
Fields.Description: The sum of the total hours specified in the UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeGrp component.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimes
Fields.Description: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlStart
Fields.Description: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41776).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlEnd
Fields.Description: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41776).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamPipeline
Fields.Description: The name of the oil delivery pipeline.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamEntryPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity will enter the delivery mechanism or pipeline.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamWithdrawalPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity product will be withdrawn prior to delivery.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
Fields.Description: The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product. For bullion see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryRestriction
Fields.Description: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingency
Fields.Description: Specifies the electricity delivery contingency. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
Fields.Description: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
Fields.Description: Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Risk_Apportionment for the details of the external code list.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
Fields.Description: Specifies the title transfer location.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
Fields.Description: Specifies the title transfer condition.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
Fields.Description: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41793). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41793). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceType
Fields.Description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceOptionSide
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTotalPositiveTolerance
Fields.Description: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%.).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
Fields.Description: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%.).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
Fields.Description: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
Fields.Description: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.
Fields.Elaboration: Examples of transportation equipment or mode are barge, truck, railcar, etc.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamElectingPartySide
Fields.Description: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period e.g. a swing or interruptible contract.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamAssetAttributes
Fields.Description: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamAssetAttributeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the name of the attribute. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Asset_Attribute_Types for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamAssetAttributeValue
Fields.Description: Specifies the value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamAssetAttributeLimit
Fields.Description: The limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycles
Fields.Description: Number of delivery cycles in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
Fields.Description: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41807) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41805) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41805) field.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
Fields.Description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamCommoditySource
Fields.Description: The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExerciseDesc
Fields.Description: A description of the option exercise.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingExerciseDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingExerciseDesc(41812) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingExerciseDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingExerciseDesc(41810) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingExerciseDesc(41810) field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAutomaticExerciseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAutomaticExerciseThresholdRate
Fields.Description: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExerciseConfirmationMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingManualNoticeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingFallbackExerciseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingLimitedRightToConfirmIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the Expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative earliest exercise date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise dates.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise dates.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseNominationDeadline
Fields.Description: The last date (adjusted) for establishing the option exercise terms.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first exercise date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last exercise date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseEarliestTime
Fields.Description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseLatestTime
Fields.Description: Latest exercise time. See also UnderlyingOptionExerciseEarliestTime(41838).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise time, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingOptionExerciseDates
Fields.Description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted option exercise fixed date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of option exercise date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of exercise expiration dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component in UnderlyingInstrument.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The option exercise expiration time.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise expiration time, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDates
Fields.Description: Number of fixed exercise expiration dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted option exercise expiration fixed date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionExerciseExpirationDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of option exercise expiration date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionProvision
Fields.Description: The consequences of market disruption events.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackProvision
Fields.Description: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionMaximumDays
Fields.Description: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2005 Commodity Definition.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionMaterialityPercentage
Fields.Description: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable to 2005 Commodity Definitions only.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionMinimumFuturesContracts
Fields.Description: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.
Fields.Elaboration: Applicable to 1993 Commodity Definitions only.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingMarketDisruptionEvents
Fields.Description: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionEvent
Fields.Description: Specifies the market disruption event. For commodities see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values. For foreign exchange, see http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Market_Disruption_Event for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbacks
Fields.Description: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of disruption fallback. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackReferencePrices
Fields.Description: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierType
Fields.Description: The type of reference price underlier.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityID
Fields.Description: Specifies the identifier value of the security.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Specifies the class or source scheme of the security identifier.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Specifies the description of underlying security.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41874) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41872) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41872).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackOpenUnits
Fields.Description: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketDivisor
Fields.Description: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDays
Fields.Description: Number of fixing days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDayOfWeek
Fields.Description: The day of the week on which fixing takes place.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDayNumber
Fields.Description: The occurrence of the day of week on which fixing takes place.
Fields.Elaboration: For example, a fixing of the 3rd Friday would be DayOfWk=5 DayNum=3. If omitted every day of the week is a fixing day.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this UnderlyingPaymentSchedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to payment schedule elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the schedule rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The schedule rate unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateConversionFactor
Fields.Description: The number to be multiplied by the derived floating rate of the underlying's payment schedule in order to arrive at the payment rate. If ommitted, the schedule rate conversion factor is 1.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSpreadType
Fields.Description: Specifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPrice
Fields.Description: The schedule settlement period price.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the schedule settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The schedule step unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDayDistribution
Fields.Description: The distribution of fixing days.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDayCount
Fields.Description: The number of days over which fixing should take place.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the fixing lag duration.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the fixing lag duration.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.
Fields.Elaboration: If the first observation offset is specified, the observation period will start the specified interval prior to each calculation period - i.e. if the first observation offset is 4 months and the lag duration is 3 months, observations will be taken in months 4, 3 and 2 (but not 1) prior to each calculation period. If no first observation offset is specified, the observation period will end immediately preceding each calculation period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator
Fields.Description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', the Flat Rate is the New Worldwide Tanker Nominal Freight Scale for the Freight Index Route taken at the Trade Date of the transaction "Fixed". If 'N' it is taken on each Pricing Date "Floating".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFlatRateAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the actual monetary value of the flat rate when UnderlyingPaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator(41897) = 'Y'.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFlatRateCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the actual flat rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMaximumPaymentAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the limit on the total payment amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMaximumPaymentCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of total payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMaximumTransactionAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the limit on the payment amount that goes out in any particular calculation period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMaximumTransactionCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the period payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixedAmountUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Fixed payment amount unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamTotalFixedAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the total fixed payment amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamWorldScaleRate
Fields.Description: The number of Worldscale points for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a wet voyage charter commodity swap.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamContractPrice
Fields.Description: The price per relevant unit for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a dry voyage charter or time charter commodity swap.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamContractPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of UnderlyingPaymentStreamContractPrice(41907). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2CurveUnit
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit associated with the payment stream’s floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2CurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Secondary time unit multiplier for the payment stream’s floating rate index curve.
Fields.Elaboration: May be used for a Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) with an average rate between two curve points.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexLocation
Fields.Description: Specifies the location of the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexLevel
Fields.Description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD index level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate index level.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamSettlLevel
Fields.Description: Specifies how weather index units are to be calculated.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamReferenceLevel
Fields.Description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD reference level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamReferenceLevelUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate reference level.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamReferenceLevelEqualsZeroIndicator
Fields.Description: When set to 'Y', it indicates that the weather reference level equals zero.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the floating rate spread. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the floating rate spread.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateConversionFactor
Fields.Description: The number to be multiplied by the derived floating rate of the underlying's payment stream in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the floating rate conversion factor is 1.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLastResetRate
Fields.Description: The floating rate determined at the most recent reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalRate
Fields.Description: The floating rate determined at the final reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCalculationLagPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the calculation lag duration.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCalculationLagUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the calculation lag duration.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.
Fields.Elaboration: If the first observation offset is specified, the observation period will start the specified interval prior to each calculation period - i.e. if the first observation offset is 4 months and the lag duration is 3 months, observations will be taken in months 4, 3 and 2 (but not 1) prior to each calculation period. If no first observation offset is specified, the observation period will end immediately preceding each calculation period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity pricing day type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayDistribution
Fields.Description: The distribution of pricing days.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayCount
Fields.Description: The number of days over which pricing should take place.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCalendar
Fields.Description: Specifies the business calendar to use for pricing. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-business-calendar for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommoditySettlTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the format of the commodity settlement start and end times.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the format of the commodity settlement start and end times.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDates
Fields.Description: Number of payment dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed stream payment date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of payment date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMasterAgreementPaymentDatesIndicator
Fields.Description: When set to 'Y', it indicates that payment dates are specified in the relevant master agreement.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDates
Fields.Description: Number of pricing dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDate
Fields.Description: An adjusted or unadjusted fixed pricing date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of pricing date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDays
Fields.Description: Number of pricing days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayOfWeek
Fields.Description: The day of the week on which pricing takes place.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayNumber
Fields.Description: The occurrence of the day of week on which pricing takes place.
Fields.Elaboration: For example a pricing day of the 3rd Friday would be DayOfWk=5 DayNum=3.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPricingDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPricingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the pricing or fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPricingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted pricing or fixing date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPricingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the pricing or fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPricingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted pricing or fixing date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPricingTime
Fields.Description: The local market pricing or fixing time.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPricingTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Specifies the business center for determining the pricing or fixing time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDates
Fields.Description: Number of calculation period dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDate
Fields.Description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed calculation period date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of fixed calculation period date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDatesXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this calculation period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDatesXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another calculation period for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationBalanceOfFirstPeriod
Fields.Description: When specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date to the end of the calendar period in which the effective date falls (e.g. Jan 15 - Jan 31 if the calculation periods are one month long and effective date is Jan 15.). If 'N' or not specified, it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date for one whole period (e.g. Jan 15 to Feb 14 if the calculation periods are one month long and the effective date is Jan 15.).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationCorrectionPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationCorrectionUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the commodity delivery date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityBase
Fields.Description: Specifies the general base type of the commodity traded. Where possible, this should follow the naming convention used in the 2005 ISDA Commodity Definitions.
Fields.Elaboration: Examples of general commodity base types include:Metal, Bullion, Oil, Natural Gas, Coal, Electricity, Inter-Energy, Grains, Oils Seeds, Dairy, Livestock, Forestry, Softs, Weather, Emissions.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of commodity product. For coal see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-type for values. For metals see http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-metal-product-type for values. For bullion see http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Bullion_Types for the external code list of bullion types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySecurityID
Fields.Description: Specifies the market identifier for the commodity.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySecurityIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of the UnderlyingStreamCommoditySecurityIDSource(41966) value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the commodity asset.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingStreamCommodityDescLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc(41970) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc(41968) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc(41968) field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the commodity asset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityCurrency
Fields.Description: Identifies the currency of the commodity asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityExchange
Fields.Description: Identifies the exchange where the commodity is traded.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityRateSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information used for commodities. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Commodity_Rate_Source for code list of applicable sources.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityRateReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityRateReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamDataProvider
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity data or information provider. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-information-provider for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityPricingType
Fields.Description: Specifies how the pricing or rate setting of the trade is to be determined or based upon. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Commodity_Rate_Pricing_Type for code list of applicable commodity pricing types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityNearbySettlDayPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the nearby settlement day.
Fields.Elaboration: When the commodity transaction references a futures contract, the delivery or settlement dates are a nearby month or week. For example, for eighth nearby month use Period=8 and Unit=Mo.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityNearbySettlDayUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the nearby settlement day.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted commodity delivery date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the commodity delivery date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted commodity delivery date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlMonth
Fields.Description: Specifies a fixed single month for commodity delivery.
Fields.Elaboration: Use "1" for January, "2" for February, etc.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateRollPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the commodity delivery date roll.
Fields.Elaboration: For a commodity transaction that references a listed future via the delivery dates, this is the day offset on which the specified future will roll to the next nearby month when the referenced future expires.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateRollUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the commodity delivery date roll.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity delivery roll day type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this stream commodity for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to a stream commodity elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommodityAltIDs
Fields.Description: Number of alternate security identifers.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityAltID
Fields.Description: Alternate security identifier value for the commodity.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityAltIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of the alternate commodity security identifier.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommodityDataSources
Fields.Description: Number of commodity data sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDataSourceID
Fields.Description: Data source identifier.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDataSourceIDType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of data source identifier.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDays
Fields.Description: Number of days in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDay
Fields.Description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTotalHours
Fields.Description: Sum of the hours specified in UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeGrp.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimes
Fields.Description: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlStart
Fields.Description: The start time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlEnd
Fields.Description: The end time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriods
Fields.Description: Number of commodity settlement periods in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlCountry
Fields.Description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeZone
Fields.Description: Commodity delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Prevailing_Timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotional
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the settlement period frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the settlement period frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPrice
Fields.Description: The settlement period price.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of the settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
Fields.Description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this settlement period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another settlement period for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamXID
Fields.Description: Identifier of this UnderlyingStream for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer
Fields.Description: Issuer of the bond.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalXIDRef
Fields.Description: Cross reference to another UnderlyingStream notional for duplicating its properties.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the swap stream's notional frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the swap stream's notional frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalCommodityFrequency
Fields.Description: The commodity's notional or quantity delivery frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotional
Fields.Description: Specifies the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotionalUnitOfMeasure
Fields.Description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) for the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42026) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondSeniority
Fields.Description: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponType
Fields.Description: Coupon type of the bond.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponRate
Fields.Description: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
Fields.Description: The maturity date of the bond.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondParValue
