Fields.Description: The par value of the bond.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
Fields.Description: Total issued amount of the bond.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDayCount
Fields.Description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingAdditionalTerms
Fields.Description: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlDealers
Fields.Description: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDealer
Fields.Description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Dealer

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlTerms
Fields.Description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
Fields.Description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.
Fields.Elaboration: Associated with ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationSubsequentBusinessDaysOffset
Fields.Description: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement.
Fields.Elaboration: Associated with ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlNumOfValuationDates
Fields.Description: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of applicable valuation dates.
Fields.Elaboration: Associated with ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationTime
Fields.Description: Time of valuation.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount
Fields.Description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specifed, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Quotation Amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
Fields.Description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevent obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Minimum Quotation Amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessDays
Fields.Description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.
Fields.Elaboration: If a cash settlement amount is specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days following the calculation of the final price. If a cash settlement amount is not specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days after all conditions to settlement are satisfied. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlAmount
Fields.Description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.
Fields.Elaboration: If not specified this would typically be calculated as ((100 or the reference price) - reference obligation price) x floating rate payer calculation amount. Price values are all expressed as a percentage. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor
Fields.Description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount is calculated is (1 - UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor(42055)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlFixedTermIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054). For cash settlement this specifies whether quotations should be obtained inclusive or not of accrued interest. For physical settlement this specifies whether the buyer should deliver the obligation with an outstanding principal balance that includes or excludes accrued interest.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Include/Exclude Accrued Interest.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationMethod
Fields.Description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Method

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlTermXID
Fields.Description: Name referenced from UnderlyingSettlementTermXIDRef(41315).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlTerms
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlBusinessDays
Fields.Description: A number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Business Day.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
Fields.Description: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlementTermXIDRef(41315).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of delivery obligation applicable for physical settlement. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Deliverable_Obligation_Types for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
Fields.Description: Physical settlement delivery obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(42066). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Deliverable_Obligation_Types for applicable obligation type values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTerms
Fields.Description: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional
Fields.Description: The notional amount of protection coverage for a floating rate.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Floating Rate Payer Calculation Amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency of UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional(42069). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermSellerNotifies
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. UnderlyingProtectionTermSellerNotifies(42071)=Y indicates that the seller notifies.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
Fields.Description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. UnderlyingProtectionTermBuyerNotifies(42072)=Y indicates that the buyer notifies.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources
Fields.Description: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources(42074)=Y) or not.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
Fields.Description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.
Fields.Elaboration: ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermXID
Fields.Description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEvents
Fields.Description: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Event_Types for code list of applicable event types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue
Fields.Description: Protection term event value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(42078). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Event_Types for applicable event type values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventCurrency
Fields.Description: Applicable currency if UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue(42079) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for protection term events.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with protection term events.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventDayType
Fields.Description: Day type for events that specify a period and unit.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventRateSource
Fields.Description: Rate source for events that specify a rate source, e.g. Floating rate interest shortfall.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifiers
Fields.Description: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifier
Fields.Description: Protection term event qualifier. Used to further qualify UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(43078).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermObligations
Fields.Description: Number of obligations in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of obligation applicable to the protection terms. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Obligation_Types for code list of applicable obligation types.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationValue
Fields.Description: Protection term obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType(42088). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Protection_Term_Obligation_Types for applicable obligation type values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSources
Fields.Description: Number of event news sources in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSource
Fields.Description: Newspaper or electronic news service or source that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
Fields.Description: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
Fields.Description: Last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
Fields.Description: Number of UnderlyingProvision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
Fields.Description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(42101).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of quote information.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the quote source.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTime
Fields.Description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
Fields.Description: Number of UnderlyingProvision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
Fields.Description: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(42114).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
Fields.Description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
Fields.Description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convnetion used to adjust the underlying instrument provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisions
Fields.Description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionType
Fields.Description: Type of provision.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted date of the provision.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent
Fields.Description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent(42156) or in the underlying provision parties component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
Fields.Description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
Fields.Description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
Fields.Description: The instrument provision's exercise style.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
Fields.Description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
Fields.Description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
Fields.Description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
Fields.Description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
Fields.Description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
Fields.Description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlMethod
Fields.Description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionText
Fields.Description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingProvisionTextLen
Fields.Description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingProvisionText(42712) field.

Fields.Name: EncodedUnderlyingProvisionText
Fields.Description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionPartyIDs
Fields.Description: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyID
Fields.Description: The party identifier for the payment settlement party.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyIDSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of the UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) value.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyRole
Fields.Description: Identifies the type or role of UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) specified.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionPartySubIDs
Fields.Description: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionPartySubID
Fields.Description: Underlying provision party sub-identifier, if applicable for UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionPartySubIDType
Fields.Description: The type of UnderlyingProvisionPartySubID(42178).

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryPointSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41062).

Fields.Name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryPointDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the delivery point identified in DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41062).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41433).

Fields.Name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the delivery point identified in LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41433).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the class or source of UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41781).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointDesc
Fields.Description: Description of the delivery point identified in UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41781).

Fields.Name: NoLegContractualDefinitions
Fields.Description: Number of financing definitions in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegContractualDefinition
Fields.Description: Specifies which contract definition, such as those published by ISDA, will apply for the terms of the trade. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-definitions for values.

Fields.Name: NoLegFinancingTermSupplements
Fields.Description: Number of financing terms supplements in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegFinancingTermSupplementDesc
Fields.Description: Identifies the applicable contractual supplement. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-supplement for values.

Fields.Name: LegFinancingTermSupplementDate
Fields.Description: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the contractual supplement.

Fields.Name: NoLegContractualMatrices
Fields.Description: Number of contractual matrices in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegContractualMatrixSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the applicable contract matrix. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/matrix-type-1-0.xml for values.

Fields.Name: LegContractualMatrixDate
Fields.Description: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the contract matrix. If not specified, the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

Fields.Name: LegContractualMatrixTerm
Fields.Description: Specifies the applicable key into the relevent contract matrix. In the case of 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions, the LegContractualMatrixTerm(42206) is not applicable and is to be omitted. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-matrix-transaction-type for values.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted cash settlement date.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the Instrument component.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted cash settlement date.

Fields.Name: NoCashSettlDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: CashSettlDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: CashSettlPriceSource
Fields.Description: The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

Fields.Name: CashSettlPriceDefault
Fields.Description: The default election for determining settlement price.

Fields.Name: DividendFloatingRateIndex
Fields.Description: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

Fields.Name: DividendFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: DividendFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: DividendFloatingRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: DividendFloatingRateSpread
Fields.Description: The basis points spread from the index specified in DividendFloatingRateIndex(42218).

Fields.Name: DividendFloatingRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: DividendFloatingRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: DividendCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: DividendCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: DividendCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: DividendFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: DividendFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: DividendFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: DividendInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: DividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

Fields.Name: DividendFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: DividendAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

Fields.Name: DividendNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: NoDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the DividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenterGrp.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymeentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted accrual payment date.

Fields.Name: DividendReinvestmentIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

Fields.Name: DividendEntitlementEvent
Fields.Description: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

Fields.Name: DividendAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

Fields.Name: DividendUnderlierRefID
Fields.Description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: ExtraordinaryDividendPartySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

Fields.Name: ExtraordinaryDividendAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

Fields.Name: ExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: DividendAccrualFixedRate
Fields.Description: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: DividendCompoundingMethod
Fields.Description: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

Fields.Name: DividendNumOfIndexUnits
Fields.Description: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

Fields.Name: DividendCashPercentage
Fields.Description: Declared cash dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: DividendCashEquivalentPercentage
Fields.Description: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: NonCashDividendTreatment
Fields.Description: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

Fields.Name: DividendComposition
Fields.Description: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

Fields.Name: SpecialDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: MaterialDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: OptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: AdditionalDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: AllDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

Fields.Name: DividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit

Fields.Name: DividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

Fields.Description: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

Fields.Name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted

Fields.Name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

Fields.Name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

Fields.Name: DividendPeriodXID
Fields.Description: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

Fields.Name: NoDividendPeriodBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the DividendPeriodBusinessCenterGrp.

Fields.Name: DividendPeriodBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoExtraordinaryEvents
Fields.Description: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: ExtraordinaryEventType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to the reference entity. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Extraordinary_Event_Type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

Fields.Name: ExtraordinaryEventValue
Fields.Description: The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to ExtraordinaryEventType(42297). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Extraordinary_Event_Type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted cash settlement date.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the InstrumentLeg component.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted cash settlement date.

Fields.Name: NoLegCashSettlDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlPriceSource
Fields.Description: The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

Fields.Name: LegCashSettlPriceDefault
Fields.Description: The default election for determining settlement price.

Fields.Name: NoLegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenterGrp.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloatingRateIndex
Fields.Description: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloatingRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloatingRateSpread
Fields.Description: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegDividendFloatingRateIndex(42312).

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloatingRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloatingRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: LegDividendCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegDividendCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegDividendCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegDividendInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegDividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

Fields.Name: LegDividendNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted accrual payment date.

Fields.Name: LegDividendReinvestmentIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

Fields.Name: LegDividendEntitlementEvent
Fields.Description: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

Fields.Name: LegDividendUnderlierRefID
Fields.Description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: LegExtraordinaryDividendPartySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

Fields.Name: LegExtraordinaryDividendAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

Fields.Name: LegExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: LegDividendAccrualFixedRate
Fields.Description: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegDividendCompoundingMethod
Fields.Description: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

Fields.Name: LegDividendNumOfIndexUnits
Fields.Description: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

Fields.Name: LegDividendCashPercentage
Fields.Description: Declared cash dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegDividendCashEquivalentPercentage
Fields.Description: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegNonCashDividendTreatment
Fields.Description: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

Fields.Name: LegDividendComposition
Fields.Description: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

Fields.Name: LegSpecialDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: LegMaterialDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: LegOptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: LegAdditionalDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: LegAllDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted FX trigger date.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted FX trigger date.

Fields.Name: NoLegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the LegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenterGrp.

Fields.Name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegDividendPeriods
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the LegDividendPeriodGrp component.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodSequence
Fields.Description: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodUnderlierRefID
Fields.Description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodStrikePrice
Fields.Description: Specifies the fixed strike price of the dividend period.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The dividend period dates business day convention.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted dividend period valuation date.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period valuation date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted dividend period payment date.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodXID
Fields.Description: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

Fields.Name: NoLegDividendPeriodBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: The number of entries in the LegDividendPeriodBusinessCentersGrp component.

Fields.Name: LegDividendPeriodBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegExtraordinaryEvents
Fields.Description: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegExtraordinaryEventType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to the reference entity. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Extraordinary_Event_Type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

Fields.Name: LegExtraordinaryEventValue
Fields.Description: The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to LegExtraordinaryEventType(42389). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Extraordinary_Event_Type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectingPartySide
Fields.Description: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

Fields.Name: LegMakeWholeDate
Fields.Description: The date through which option cannot be exercised without penalty.

Fields.Name: LegMakeWholeAmount
Fields.Description: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the LegMakeWholeDate(42392).

Fields.Name: LegMakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
Fields.Description: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegMakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
Fields.Description: The point on the floating rate index curve. Sample values: M = combination of a number between 1-12 and an "M" for month, e.g. 3M Y = combination of number between 1-100 and a "Y" for year, e.g. 10Y 10Y-OLD = see above, then add "-OLD" when appropriate INTERPOLATED = the point is mathematically derived 2/2031 5 3/8 = the point is stated via a combination of maturity month / year and coupon.

Fields.Name: LegMakeWholeRecallSpread
Fields.Description: Spread over the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegMakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
Fields.Description: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

Fields.Name: LegMakeWholeInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
Fields.Description: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
Fields.Description: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
Fields.Description: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
Fields.Description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDate
Fields.Description: The compounding date. Type of date is specified in LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42407).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The compounding dates business day convention.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted compounding end date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted compounding end date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
Fields.Description: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
Fields.Description: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42427).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted compounding start date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted compounding start date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
Fields.Description: Length in bytes of the LegPaymentStreamFormulaImage(42452) field.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaImage
Fields.Description: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted final price payment date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted final price payment date.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamFixingDates
Fields.Description: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDate
Fields.Description: The fixing date. Type of date is specified in LegPaymentStreamFixingDateType(42461).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted initial price observation date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
Fields.Description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateNotionalReset
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
Fields.Description: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
Fields.Description: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
Fields.Description: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
Fields.Description: For a variance swap specifies how LegPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42472) is expressed.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
Fields.Description: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination. For a variation swap stream all observations above this price level will be excluded from the variance calculation. For a correlation swap stream the maximum boundary is a percentage of the strike price.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
