Fields.Description: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination. For a variation swap stream all observations below this price level will be excluded from the variance calculation. For a correlation swap stream the minimum boundary is a percentage of the strike price.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
Fields.Description: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
Fields.Description: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
Fields.Description: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
Fields.Description: Vega Notional represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realized volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Payment_Amount_Relative_To for code list of reference amounts.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStreamFormulas
Fields.Description: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFormula
Fields.Description: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaDesc
Fields.Description: A description of the math formula in LegPaymentStreamFormula(42486).

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted stub end date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The stub end date business day convention.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the stub end date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative stub end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative stub end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted stub end date.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub end date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted stub start date.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The stub start date business day convention.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the stub start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative stub start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative stub start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted stub start date.

Fields.Name: NoLegPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub start date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionBreakFeeElection
Fields.Description: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

Fields.Name: LegProvisionBreakFeeRate
Fields.Description: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: NoLegReturnRateDates
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate date repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateDateMode
Fields.Description: Specifies the valuation type applicable to the return rate date.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationFrequencyRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of return rate valuation dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

Fields.Name: NoLegReturnRateFXConversions
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateFXRate
Fields.Description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in LegReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(42531).

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateFXRateCalc
Fields.Description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in LegReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(42531).

Fields.Name: NoLegReturnRates
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRatePriceSequence
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateCommissionBasis
Fields.Description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateCommissionAmount
Fields.Description: The commission amount.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateCommissionCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateTotalCommissionPerTrade
Fields.Description: The total commission per trade.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateAmountRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Amount_Relative_To for code list of relative amounts.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteUnits
Fields.Description: Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteTime
Fields.Description: The time when the quote is to be generated.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteDate
Fields.Description: The date when the quote is to be generated.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with LegReturnRateQuoteTimeType(42547) or LegReturnRateQuoteTime(42548) and LegReturnRateQuoteDate(42549), e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuoteExchange
Fields.Description: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateQuotePricingModel
Fields.Description: Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateCashFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationTime
Fields.Description: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with LegReturnRateValuationTimeType(42555) or LegReturnRateValuationTime(42556), e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationPriceOption
Fields.Description: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
Fields.Description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

Fields.Name: NoLegReturnRateInformationSources
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate information source repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateInformationSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When LegReturnRateInformationSource(42561) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: NoLegReturnRatePrices
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRatePriceBasis
Fields.Description: The basis of the return price.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRatePrice
Fields.Description: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRatePriceCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the price of the leg swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRatePriceType
Fields.Description: Specifies whether the LegReturnRatePrice(42566) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

Fields.Name: NoLegReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date business center repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoLegReturnRateValuationDates
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDate
Fields.Description: The return rate valuation date. The type of date is specified in LegReturnRateValuationDateType(42573).

Fields.Name: LegReturnRateValuationDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted settlement method election date.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The settlement method election date adjustment business day convention.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the settlement method election date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative settlement method election date offset.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative settlement method election date offset.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative settlement method election date offset.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted settlement method election date.

Fields.Name: NoLegSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the settlement method election unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamVersion
Fields.Description: The stream version identifier when there have been modifications to the contract over time. Helps signal when there are embedded changes.

Fields.Name: LegStreamVersionEffectiveDate
Fields.Description: The effective date of the LegStreamVersion(42583).

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotionalDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: LegStreamNotionalAdjustments
Fields.Description: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

Fields.Name: StreamCommodityDeliveryPricingRegion
Fields.Description: The delivery or pricing region associated with the commodity swap. See http://www.ecfr.gov/cgi-bin/text-idx?SID=660d6a40f836aa6ddf213cba080c5b22&node=ap17.2.43_17.e&rgn=div9 for the external code list.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of CFTC Part 43 Appendix E requirement this represents the specific delivery point or pricing point associated with publicly reportable commodity swap transactions.

Fields.Name: LegStreamCommodityDeliveryPricingRegion
Fields.Description: The delivery or pricing region associated with the commodity swap. See http://www.ecfr.gov/cgi-bin/text-idx?SID=660d6a40f836aa6ddf213cba080c5b22&node=ap17.2.43_17.e&rgn=div9 for the external code list.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of CFTC Part 43 Appendix E requirement this represents the specific delivery point or pricing point associated with publically reportable commodity swap transactions.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDeliveryPricingRegion
Fields.Description: The delivery or pricing region associated with the commodity swap. See http://www.ecfr.gov/cgi-bin/text-idx?SID=660d6a40f836aa6ddf213cba080c5b22&node=ap17.2.43_17.e&rgn=div9 for the external code list.
Fields.Elaboration: In the context of CFTC Part 43 Appendix E requirement this represents the specific delivery point or pricing point associated with publically reportable commodity swap transactions.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectingPartySide
Fields.Description: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

Fields.Name: MakeWholeDate
Fields.Description: The date through which option cannot be exercised without penalty.

Fields.Name: MakeWholeAmount
Fields.Description: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the MakeWholeDate(42591).

Fields.Name: MakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
Fields.Description: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

Fields.Name: MakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
Fields.Description: The point on the floating rate index curve. Sample values: M = combination of a number between 1-12 and an "M" for month, e.g. 3M Y = combination of number between 1-100 and a "Y" for year, e.g. 10Y 10Y-OLD = see above, then add "-OLD" when appropriate INTERPOLATED = the point is mathematically derived 2/2031 5 3/8 = the point is stated via a combination of maturity month / year and coupon.

Fields.Name: MakeWholeRecallSpread
Fields.Description: Spread over the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: MakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
Fields.Description: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

Fields.Name: MakeWholeInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

Fields.Name: PaymentAmountRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the reference amount when the payment amount is relative to another amount in the message. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Payment_Amount_Relative_To for code list of relative amounts.

Fields.Name: PaymentAmountDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method by which a payment amount is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
Fields.Description: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
Fields.Description: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
Fields.Description: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
Fields.Description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDate
Fields.Description: The compounding date. The type of date is specified in PaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42608).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The compounding dates business day convention.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted compounding end date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted compounding end date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
Fields.Description: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
Fields.Description: The basis points spread from the index specified in PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42628).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted compounding start date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted compounding start date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
Fields.Description: Length in bytes of the PaymentStreamFormulaImage(42563) field.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFormulaImage
Fields.Description: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted final price payment date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetfPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted final price payment date.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamFixingDates
Fields.Description: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDate
Fields.Description: The fixing date. The type of date is specified in PaymentStreamFixingDateType(42662).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFixingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted initial price observation date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
Fields.Description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateNotionalReset
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
Fields.Description: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
Fields.Description: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
Fields.Description: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
Fields.Description: For a variance swap specifies how PaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42673) is expressed.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
Fields.Description: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination. For a variation swap stream all observations above this price level will be excluded from the variance calculation. For a correlation swap stream the maximum boundary is a percentage of the strike price.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
Fields.Description: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination. For a variation swap stream all observations below this price level will be excluded from the variance calculation. For a correlation swap stream the minimum boundary is a percentage of the strike price.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
Fields.Description: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
Fields.Description: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
Fields.Description: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
Fields.Description: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
Fields.Description: "Vega Notional" represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStreamFormulas
Fields.Description: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFormula
Fields.Description: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFormulaDesc
Fields.Description: A description of the math formula in PaymentStreamFormula(42684).

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
Fields.Description: Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Payment_Amount_Relative_To for code list of reference amounts.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted stub end date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The stub end date business day convention.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the stub end date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub end date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative stub end date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative stub end date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted stub end date.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub end date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted stub start date.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The stub start date business day convention.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the stub start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub start date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative stub start date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative stub start date offset.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted stub start date.

Fields.Name: NoPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: PaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub start date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ProvisionBreakFeeElection
Fields.Description: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

Fields.Name: ProvisionBreakFeeRate
Fields.Description: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: NoReturnRateDates
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate date repeating group.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateDateMode
Fields.Description: Specifies the valuation type applicable to the return rate date.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation start date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationFrequencyRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of return rate valuation dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

Fields.Name: NoReturnRateFXConversions
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateFXRate
Fields.Description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in ReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(42732).

Fields.Name: ReturnRateFXRateCalc
Fields.Description: Specifies whether ReturnRateFXRate(42733) should be multiplied or divided.

Fields.Name: NoReturnRates
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

Fields.Name: ReturnRatePriceSequence
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateCommissionBasis
Fields.Description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateCommissionAmount
Fields.Description: The commission amount.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateCommissionCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateTotalCommissionPerTrade
Fields.Description: The total commission per trade.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateAmountRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Payment_Amount_Relative_To for code list of relative amounts.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteUnits
Fields.Description: Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteTime
Fields.Description: The time when the quote is to be generated.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteDate
Fields.Description: The date when the quote is to be generated.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteExpirationTime
Fields.Description: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with ReturnRateQuoteTimeType(42748) or ReturnRateQuoteTime(42749) and ReturnRateQuoteDate(42750), e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuoteExchange
Fields.Description: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateQuotePricingModel
Fields.Description: Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateCashFlowType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationTimeType
Fields.Description: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationTime
Fields.Description: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationTimeBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with ReturnRateValuationTimeType(42756) or ReturnRateValuationTime(42757), e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationPriceOption
Fields.Description: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
Fields.Description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

Fields.Name: NoReturnRateInformationSources
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate information source repeating group.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateInformationSource
Fields.Description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateReferencePage
Fields.Description: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When ReturnRateInformationSource(42762) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

Fields.Name: ReturnRateReferencePageHeading
Fields.Description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

Fields.Name: NoReturnRatePrices
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

Fields.Name: ReturnRatePriceBasis
Fields.Description: The basis of the return price.

Fields.Name: ReturnRatePrice
Fields.Description: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

Fields.Name: ReturnRatePriceCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency of the price of the underlying swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: ReturnRatePriceType
Fields.Description: Specifies whether the ReturnRatePrice(42767) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

Fields.Name: NoReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date business center repeating group.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoReturnRateValuationDates
Fields.Description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDate
Fields.Description: The return rate valuation date. Type of date is specified in ReturnRateValuationDateType(42774).

Fields.Name: ReturnRateValuationDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: NoSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the settlement method election unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted settlement method election date.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The settlement method election date adjustment business day convention.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the settlement method election date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative settlement method election date offset.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative settlement method election date offset.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative settlement method election date offset.

Fields.Name: SettlMethodElectionDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted settlement method election date.

Fields.Name: StreamVersion
Fields.Description: The stream version identifier when there have been modifications to the contract over time. Helps signal when there are embedded changes.

Fields.Name: StreamVersionEffectiveDate
Fields.Description: The effective date of the StreamVersion(42784).

Fields.Name: StreamNotionalDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: StreamNotionalAdjustments
Fields.Description: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted cash settlement date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted cash settlement date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlPriceSource
Fields.Description: The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingCashSettlPriceDefault
Fields.Description: The default election for determining settlement price.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenterGrp.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndex
Fields.Description: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateMultiplier
Fields.Description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateSpread
Fields.Description: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndex(42801).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateSpreadPositionType
Fields.Description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateTreatment
Fields.Description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendCapRate
Fields.Description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRate
Fields.Description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateBuySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateSellSide
Fields.Description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendInitialRate
Fields.Description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRatePrecision
Fields.Description: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAveragingMethod
Fields.Description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendNegativeRateTreatment
Fields.Description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted accrual payment date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendReinvestmentIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendEntitlementEvent
Fields.Description: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendUnderlierRefID
Fields.Description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in a separate instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendPartySide
Fields.Description: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendAmountType
Fields.Description: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
Fields.Description: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
Fields.Description: Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined. See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualFixedRate
Fields.Description: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendCompoundingMethod
Fields.Description: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendNumOfIndexUnits
Fields.Description: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendCashPercentage
Fields.Description: Declared cash dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendCashEquivalentPercentage
Fields.Description: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

Fields.Name: UnderlyingNonCashDividendTreatment
Fields.Description: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendComposition
Fields.Description: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSpecialDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMaterialDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingOptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAdditionalDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingAllDividendsIndicator
Fields.Description: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted FX trigger date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted FX trigger date.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenterGrp.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDividendPayments
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentDate
Fields.Description: Specifies the date that the dividend or coupon payment is due.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount
Fields.Description: The amount of the dividend or coupon payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentCurrency
Fields.Description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount(42857) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendAccruedInterest
Fields.Description: Accrued interest on the dividend or coupon payment.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutRatio
Fields.Description: Specifies the actual dividend payout ratio associated with the equity or bond underlier.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutConditions
Fields.Description: Specifies the dividend payout conditions that will be applied in the case where the actual ratio is not known, typically because of regulatory or legal uncertainties.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDividendPeriods
Fields.Description: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendPeriodGrp component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodSequence
Fields.Description: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodUnderlierRefID
Fields.Description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStrikePrice
Fields.Description: Specifies the fixed strike price of the dividend period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The dividend period dates business day convention.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted dividend period valuation date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period valuation date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted dividend period payment date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period payment date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodXID
Fields.Description: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of entries in UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenterGrp.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingExtraordinaryEvents
Fields.Description: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType
Fields.Description: Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Extraordinary_Event_Type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventValue
Fields.Description: The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885). See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Extraordinary_Event_Type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectingPartySide
Fields.Description: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMakeWholeDate
Fields.Description: The date through which the option cannot be exercised without penalty.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMakeWholeAmount
Fields.Description: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the UnderlyingMakeWholeDate(42888).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
Fields.Description: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
Fields.Description: The point on the floating rate index curve. Sample values: M = combination of a number between 1-12 and an "M" for month, e.g. 3M Y = combination of number between 1-100 and a "Y" for year, e.g. 10Y 10Y-OLD = see above, then add "-OLD" when appropriate INTERPOLATED = the point is mathematically derived 2/2031 5 3/8 = the point is stated via a combination of maturity month / year and coupon.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMakeWholeRecallSpread
Fields.Description: Spread over the floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
Fields.Description: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingMakeWholeInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
Fields.Description: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
Fields.Description: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
Fields.Description: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
Fields.Description: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
Fields.Description: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
Fields.Description: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
Fields.Description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDate
Fields.Description: The compounding date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42903).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
Fields.Description: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
Fields.Description: The compounding dates business day convention.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
Fields.Description: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
Fields.Description: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

Fields.Name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters
Fields.Description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
Fields.Description: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO". See http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
Fields.Description: The unadjusted compounding end date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
Fields.Description: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date. See http://www.fixtradingcommunity.org/codelists#Relative_To_Date for values.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
Fields.Description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
Fields.Description: The adjusted compounding end date.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
Fields.Description: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
Fields.Description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
Fields.Description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

Fields.Name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
